SL01.name: Undocumented field (SL01)
SL01.description: Opaque SL-family feature bit with no descriptive suffix. BMW ships this name verbatim with no further documentation; purpose not determined from available sources.

SL02_ES.name: Spanish/ES market variant flag (SL02_ES)
SL02_ES.description: SL-family flag with suffix 'ES', indicating a Spanish or ES-market variant feature. Active when FA option 807 (Japanese version) is set — suggesting this flag enables certain ES-variant features even on Japan-spec vehicles. Token suffix 'ES' is the authoritative market designator from the firmware descriptor.

ENT_COVERFLOW.name: Cover Flow album browser (entertainment)
ENT_COVERFLOW.description: Enables the Cover Flow album-art browsing mode in the entertainment system. Active when Professional navigation (609) is not fitted and the car is not the China country-control variant (8LH).

ENT_COVERFLOW_USB.name: Cover Flow via USB
ENT_COVERFLOW_USB.description: Enables Cover Flow album-art browsing specifically for media played from a USB device. Companion bit to ENT_COVERFLOW; same FA gate (excludes 609 Professional nav and 8LH).

SL05.name: Undocumented feature flag (SL05)
SL05.description: Opaque SL-family bit with no descriptive suffix and only NICHT_AKTIV (not active) as its documented state. Purpose not determined from available sources.

SL06_IBA_1.name: Speed lock: owner's manual, part 1
SL06_IBA_1.description: Locks part of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving; it is the first of three such locks. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SL07_IBA_2.name: Speed lock: owner's manual, part 2
SL07_IBA_2.description: Locks part of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving; it is the second of three such locks. Enabled at the factory for the Japanese, Australian, Canadian and Chinese versions (S807, S810, S838 or S8AA). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SL08_NUMMEREINGABE.name: Manual number entry (SL08_NUMMEREINGABE)
SL08_NUMMEREINGABE.description: Enables manual number/digit entry input mode in the HMI, typically for entering phone numbers or codes via the iDrive controller. Active for Japanese market (807).

SL10.name: Undocumented feature flag (SL10)
SL10.description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.

SL11.name: Undocumented feature flag (SL11)
SL11.description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.

SL12.name: Undocumented feature flag (SL12)
SL12.description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.

SL13.name: Undocumented feature flag (SL13)
SL13.description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.

SL14.name: Undocumented feature flag (SL14)
SL14.description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.

SL15.name: Undocumented feature flag (SL15)
SL15.description: Opaque SL-family bit, Purpose not determined from available sources.

SL16_ADD_CEDEVICE.name: Allow adding CE devices (SL16_ADD_CEDEVICE)
SL16_ADD_CEDEVICE.description: SL-family flag enabling the option to add consumer-electronics (CE) devices such as additional Bluetooth or media accessories. Active for Japan, Australia, Canada, China markets, and certain vehicle type-key groups.

VIDEO_SPEEDLOCK_CONDITION.name: Standstill rule for video
VIDEO_SPEEDLOCK_CONDITION.description: Sets what counts as stopped before video can play on the central display: parking brake set, transmission in Park, both, or either. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SL20_OPP_TRANSFER.name: OPP (opportunistic) transfer (SL20_OPP_TRANSFER)
SL20_OPP_TRANSFER.description: SL-family flag enabling OPP (Object Push Profile / opportunistic Bluetooth) file transfer. Active for Japanese market (807) only.

SL21_IBA_3.name: Speed lock: owner's manual, part 3
SL21_IBA_3.description: Locks part of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving; it is the third of three such locks. Enabled at the factory for the Japanese, Australian, Canadian and Chinese versions (S807, S810, S838 or S8AA). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SERVICE_HISTORY.name: Service history display
SERVICE_HISTORY.description: Shows the service history on the central display: a list of the maintenance work carried out and recorded for the car.

IBA.name: Integrated Owner's Manual
IBA.description: Turns on the Integrated Owner's Manual, the owner's handbook built into iDrive, including the context help that opens the matching page from other menus and messages.

CDMM_AUX_HU.name: Auxiliary head-unit media connection (CDMM AUX)
CDMM_AUX_HU.description: Enables an auxiliary media connection (AUX-in) routed through the CDMM (CD/Media Module). When active, an external audio source can be connected to the head unit.

ENT_GEN_META_DATA.name: Media metadata generation
ENT_GEN_META_DATA.description: Setting for generating track details (metadata) in the media player.

COMPASS.name: Compass display
COMPASS.description: Enables a compass bearing display in the instrument cluster or head-unit status bar.

ENT_HU_DRIVE_COVER.name: Head-unit optical drive cover enabled
ENT_HU_DRIVE_COVER.description: Enables the drive slot/cover UI for the head-unit's built-in optical drive. Active by default; disabled for the 8LH China country-control variant (which lacks the drive).

VIDEO_HANDBRAKE.name: Video only with parking brake set
VIDEO_HANDBRAKE.description: Allows video on the central display only while the parking brake is set. Enabled at the factory for the Australian version (S810), the Great Britain and Ireland version (S812) and the Canadian version (S838). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

ENT_HU_DRIVE_WIND_SPEED.name: Wind speed display (drive information)
ENT_HU_DRIVE_WIND_SPEED.description: Enables the wind speed readout in the head-unit drive information / efficiency display. Variant 1 = one display layout, Variant 2 = alternate layout.

VIDEO_FRONT_LOCKED.name: Video lock: central display
VIDEO_FRONT_LOCKED.description: Locks video playback on the central display up front. Enabled at the factory for some markets (S8LH). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

ENT_RSE_EXT_OPTIONS.name: Rear-seat entertainment extended options
ENT_RSE_EXT_OPTIONS.description: 3-bit field selecting extended RSE (Rear-Seat Entertainment) option variants for special equipment configurations.

ENT_CHANGER_INSTALLED.name: CD/DVD changer installed
ENT_CHANGER_INSTALLED.description: Declares that an external CD/DVD changer (6-disc, SA 696) is physically connected to the head unit. Enables changer-related UI and media source switching.

ENT_CHANGER_COVER.name: CD/DVD changer cover UI
ENT_CHANGER_COVER.description: Enables the UI element (cover/slot graphic) for an external CD/DVD changer. allowing the changer interface to be shown even if no changer is connected.

ENT_PERSONALRADIO.name: Personal Radio (Online Entertainment)
ENT_PERSONALRADIO.description: Shows Personal Radio in the media menu, a streaming radio feature of BMW Online Entertainment. Using it needs the Online Entertainment service and a data connection.

ENT_MULTICHANNEL.name: Multichannel audio (surround sound)
ENT_MULTICHANNEL.description: Enables multichannel/surround audio processing in the entertainment system.

OE_LOGIN_SL.name: OE login / service-level access
OE_LOGIN_SL.description: Enables OE (Original Equipment) login or service-level coding access for authorised dealers/tools. Controls whether the service login entry point is shown in the HMI.

ENT_VIDEO.name: Video playback
ENT_VIDEO.description: Turns on video playback in the media menu. Video while driving follows the head unit's speed-lock rules, and rules on driver distraction vary by country.

ENT_MIRACAST.name: Miracast screen mirroring
ENT_MIRACAST.description: Enables Wi-Fi Miracast wireless screen mirroring from a compatible Android device to the head-unit display.

ENT_VIDEO_DVD_AREA_CODE.name: DVD region code
ENT_VIDEO_DVD_AREA_CODE.description: Sets the DVD region code for the built-in optical drive. Determines which geographic region's DVDs can be played.

ENT_VIDEO_BLUERAYD_AREA_CODE.name: Blu-ray region code
ENT_VIDEO_BLUERAYD_AREA_CODE.description: Sets the Blu-ray region code for the head-unit's optical drive. Determines which geographic region's Blu-ray discs can be played.

values.2: Region B (Europe, Africa, Middle East, Australia)

ENT_MC_WLAN_STREAM_DMP_COVERART.name: WLAN/DLNA media server cover art
ENT_MC_WLAN_STREAM_DMP_COVERART.description: Enables album cover art display when streaming audio from a WLAN DLNA media server (DMP = Digital Media Player).

ENT_MC_WLAN_STREAM_DMP_VIDEO.name: WLAN/DLNA video streaming
ENT_MC_WLAN_STREAM_DMP_VIDEO.description: Enables video playback from a WLAN DLNA media server (DMP) on the head-unit display.

ENT_BTAS_IAP_COVERART.name: Bluetooth/iPod cover art (BTAS/iAP)
ENT_BTAS_IAP_COVERART.description: Enables album cover art display for music played via Bluetooth Audio Streaming (BTAS) or Apple iAP (iPod Accessory Protocol).

CDMM_TV_EPG_PRES_SCOPE.name: TV electronic programme guide (EPG) presentation
CDMM_TV_EPG_PRES_SCOPE.description: Sets the scope/mode of the TV Electronic Programme Guide display. Standard mode vs. Advanced/extended mode.

ENT_COVERFLOW_ES.name: Cover Flow for Professional navigation
ENT_COVERFLOW_ES.description: Enables the Cover Flow album-art browser specifically for vehicles with Professional navigation (609). Companion to ENT_COVERFLOW, active when 609 is fitted.

ENT_COVERFLOW_VERTICAL.name: Cover Flow vertical scroll
ENT_COVERFLOW_VERTICAL.description: Enables vertical scrolling mode for the Cover Flow album browser (as opposed to horizontal/coverflow swipe). Active by default.

ENT_RSE_DRIVE.name: RSE optical drive type
ENT_RSE_DRIVE.description: Specifies the optical drive type fitted in the rear-seat entertainment (RSE) system.

ENT_HU_DRIVE.name: Head-unit optical drive type
ENT_HU_DRIVE.description: Specifies the type of optical drive fitted in the head unit itself.

ENT_VIDEO_HMI.name: Video HMI mode
ENT_VIDEO_HMI.description: Controls the HMI presentation mode for the video player: either the standard DVD-style on-screen interface or a track/title list view.

OE_ENABLED.name: Online Entertainment
OE_ENABLED.description: Turns on Online Entertainment, BMW's in-car music streaming service, in the media menu. Using it needs an active service and a data connection.

OE_RSE_ENABLED.name: OE rear-seat entertainment features enabled
OE_RSE_ENABLED.description: Enable flag for OE (dealer) rear-seat entertainment feature extensions.

MOMENTANVERBRAUCHSANZEIGE.name: Instantaneous fuel consumption display
MOMENTANVERBRAUCHSANZEIGE.description: Enables the real-time (instantaneous) fuel consumption readout in the vehicle information / efficiency display on the head unit.

RHMI_LIST_SPEEDLOCK_LEVEL.name: Speed lock: connected app text lists
RHMI_LIST_SPEEDLOCK_LEVEL.description: Sets how many lines a long text list in a connected app (one whose screens come from a phone or an online service) can show on the central display while the car is moving, for apps that don't set their own limit. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

CHARGING_POWER_REDUCTION_HU.name: Charging power reduction (HU)
CHARGING_POWER_REDUCTION_HU.description: Enables head-unit-managed reduction of battery charging power, typically for plug-in hybrid/EV charge management.

STT_SPELLER_INPUT.name: Speech-to-text speller input level
STT_SPELLER_INPUT.description: Configures which speech-to-text (STT) speller input confidence levels are made available to the user. Higher = more input options; Hoch+Mittel+Gering = high+medium+low confidence inputs.

SCR_ANZEIGE.name: AdBlue range display
SCR_ANZEIGE.description: Shows the AdBlue (diesel exhaust fluid) status in “Vehicle status” on diesel models with selective catalytic reduction (SCR) and sets the highest remaining range it shows as a number. Above that limit it shows the limit with a “>” sign. With miles as the display unit, the limits are 6,000 and 4,500 mi.

ENTRIEGELN_NACH_FAHRTENDE.name: Automatic unlock after journey end
ENTRIEGELN_NACH_FAHRTENDE.description: Enables automatic unlocking of the vehicle doors when the ignition is turned off and the journey ends.

HMI_GOODBYE_NICHTSENDEFAEHIGKEIT.name: Goodbye screen: hide non-transmission-capable info
HMI_GOODBYE_NICHTSENDEFAEHIGKEIT.description: When enabled, the goodbye/farewell screen suppresses information that cannot be transmitted (Nichtsendefaehigkeit) — i.e. content that requires connectivity not available at shutdown.

AC_LADEN_SCHNELL.name: AC fast charging
AC_LADEN_SCHNELL.description: Enables AC fast charging capability declaration in the HMI (for plug-in hybrid/EV).

WEEKLY_TIMER.name: Weekly departure timer
WEEKLY_TIMER.description: Enables the weekly repeating departure timer for pre-conditioning (climate/charge).

CLIMATE_DEPARTURE.name: Climate departure timer
CLIMATE_DEPARTURE.description: Enables the one-shot or weekly departure timer for pre-conditioning the vehicle climate before driving.

DAC2_KONFIGURATION.name: DAC2 configuration
DAC2_KONFIGURATION.description: Configuration setting for the DAC vehicle function in the head unit's car menus. Best left unchanged.

NFC_BT_PAIRING_SPEEDLOCK.name: NFC Bluetooth pairing speed-lock
NFC_BT_PAIRING_SPEEDLOCK.description: When enabled, NFC-triggered Bluetooth device pairing is restricted to when the vehicle is stationary (speed-locked).

NFC_BEAM_SPEEDLOCK.name: NFC beam speed-lock
NFC_BEAM_SPEEDLOCK.description: When enabled, NFC beam (data transfer via NFC tap) is restricted to when the vehicle is stationary.

FADER_EINSTELLUNG.name: Fader front/rear balance setting
FADER_EINSTELLUNG.description: Enables the front/rear audio fader adjustment in the sound settings menu.

ENT_GRACENOTE_ACCESS.name: Gracenote album info features
ENT_GRACENOTE_ACCESS.description: Chooses which Gracenote album information features the media options offer: the album information screen, which shows Gracenote details for an album, and the online lookup that updates those details from the Gracenote service. The online lookup is reached from the album information screen.

ENT_MC_ACTIV.name: Media Centre active
ENT_MC_ACTIV.description: Enables the Media Centre (internal hard-disk music library / ripped CD storage) feature. Requires Professional navigation (609).

ENT_MC_COVER.name: Media Centre album art cover display
ENT_MC_COVER.description: Enables album cover art display in the Media Centre (internal HDD library) browser. Active when Professional navigation (609) is NOT fitted.

ENT_MC_VIDEO_SUPPORT.name: Media Centre video support
ENT_MC_VIDEO_SUPPORT.description: Enables video file storage and playback from the Media Centre internal hard drive.

ENT_MC_PLAYLIST_IMPORT.name: Media Centre playlist import
ENT_MC_PLAYLIST_IMPORT.description: Enables importing of playlists (e.g. M3U files from USB) into the Media Centre internal library.

ENT_MC_ASIA_INPUT.name: Media Centre Asia character input
ENT_MC_ASIA_INPUT.description: Enables Asian character set input (CJK) for Media Centre music search.

ENT_MC_AUTO_RIP_IMPORT.name: Media Centre auto-rip (CD to HDD)
ENT_MC_AUTO_RIP_IMPORT.description: Enables automatic ripping of inserted audio CDs to the Media Centre internal hard drive.

ENT_MC_AUTO_BACKUPRESTORE.name: Media Centre auto backup/restore
ENT_MC_AUTO_BACKUPRESTORE.description: Enables automatic backup and restore of the Media Centre (HDD music library) to/from an external source.

ENT_MC_WLAN_STREAM_DMP.name: Media Centre WLAN/DLNA streaming
ENT_MC_WLAN_STREAM_DMP.description: Enables streaming audio from a WLAN DLNA media server (DMP) directly into the Media Centre.

IPCE_WEBSERVER.name: Web server for online services
IPCE_WEBSERVER.description: Turns on the head unit's built-in web server, which BMW's online services use to show their content on the central display. Enabled at the factory with BMW Live (S6AL) or TeleServices (S6AE).

ENT_MC_DELETE_MUSICSEARCH.name: Media Centre: allow deleting music search index
ENT_MC_DELETE_MUSICSEARCH.description: Enables the user option to delete the music search/metadata index in the Media Centre.

ENT_MC_SONG_BOOKMARKS.name: Media Centre song bookmarks
ENT_MC_SONG_BOOKMARKS.description: Enables the ability to bookmark individual songs/tracks in the Media Centre library.

ENT_MC_TIMESHIFT_REC.name: Media Centre time-shift recording
ENT_MC_TIMESHIFT_REC.description: Enables time-shift recording (pause/rewind live media) in the Media Centre.

ENT_MC_PIA.name: Music collection: driver profile link
ENT_MC_PIA.description: Setting that links the music collection with the driver profiles, the personal settings the head unit keeps for each key. Best left unchanged.

ENT_MC_COVER_SCALE.name: Media Centre album art scale/fit
ENT_MC_COVER_SCALE.description: Enables scaled/fitted display of album cover art in the Media Centre (filling the display rather than displaying at native size).

ENT_GRACENOTE_INSTALLED.name: Gracenote database installed
ENT_GRACENOTE_INSTALLED.description: Declares that the Gracenote music recognition database is installed on the head unit (on internal storage).

GESTURE_CAMERA.name: Gesture control
GESTURE_CAMERA.description: Turns on gesture control for cars with the gesture camera: hand movements in front of the central display can change the volume, accept or reject calls and more.

X_VIEW.name: X-View 3D camera view
X_VIEW.description: Enables the X-View (360-degree / 3D surround camera view) feature on the head-unit display.

ENT_GRACENOTE_USB.name: Gracenote database via USB
ENT_GRACENOTE_USB.description: Enables loading/updating the Gracenote music database from a USB drive.

ENT_GRACENOTE_MLT.name: Gracenote music lookup (MLT / over-the-air)
ENT_GRACENOTE_MLT.description: Enables Gracenote MLT (Music Label Tagging / online music recognition lookup) for identifying and tagging music.

ENT_GRACENOTE_SERVICE.name: Gracenote music service
ENT_GRACENOTE_SERVICE.description: Enables the Gracenote music metadata service (artist/album/track tag lookup) in the entertainment system.

ENT_CODEC_OGG.name: Ogg audio playback
ENT_CODEC_OGG.description: Lets the head unit play Ogg audio files, such as Ogg Vorbis music, from connected media.

ENT_CODEC_XVID.name: Xvid video playback
ENT_CODEC_XVID.description: Lets the head unit play video files encoded with Xvid, a common MPEG-4 video format.

ENT_CODEC_VCD.name: Video CD playback
ENT_CODEC_VCD.description: Lets the head unit play Video CDs (VCD), an older disc format for movies and music videos.

SWITCH_MLS_MI.name: MLS/MI language switching mode
SWITCH_MLS_MI.description: Enables or configures the MLS (Multi-Language Support) / MI (Market Interface) language and interface mode switch.

KOMBI_AR_PRES.name: Navigation in cluster: AR presentation
KOMBI_AR_PRES.description: Setting for how the navigation map is presented in the instrument cluster (AR presentation). Best left unchanged.

SDARS_MODUL.name: Satellite radio module generation (SDARS)
SDARS_MODUL.description: Specifies the generation of the SDARS (Satellite Digital Audio Radio Service, e.g. SiriusXM) module.

HDMI_MHL_AUX_IN.name: HDMI/MHL AUX video input
HDMI_MHL_AUX_IN.description: Enables an HDMI or MHL (Mobile High-Definition Link) auxiliary video input port connection to the head unit.

SETTINGS_INFO_DISPLAY_DISTANCE.name: Distance unit setting in vehicle info
SETTINGS_INFO_DISPLAY_DISTANCE.description: Enables the distance unit (km/miles) selector in the vehicle information / settings display.

OIL_QUANTITY_HIGH.name: High-capacity oil quantity (3L) display
OIL_QUANTITY_HIGH.description: Enables display logic for vehicles with a high-capacity engine oil reservoir (e.g. 3-litre / large engine oil quantities).

SETTINGS_INFO_DISPLAY_DATE.name: Date display in vehicle info
SETTINGS_INFO_DISPLAY_DATE.description: Enables the current date readout in the vehicle information / settings display.

NFC_STATUS.name: NFC status display
NFC_STATUS.description: Enables display of the NFC (Near-Field Communication) module status in the settings/connectivity menu.

ZBE_HARDKEY_LAYOUT_NEW.name: iDrive controller (ZBE) new hard-key layout
ZBE_HARDKEY_LAYOUT_NEW.description: Enables the newer iDrive controller (ZBE) hard-key button layout. Required when a newer ZBE controller with a revised button arrangement is fitted (e.g. with touch surface or revised media buttons). Active when TV function (601), Business nav (606), or Professional nav (609) is fitted.

MFL_SKIP_MINI.name: Steering wheel buttons: MINI skip variant
MFL_SKIP_MINI.description: Enables the MINI-variant skip/seek button mapping for the MFL (Multi-Function steering wheel / Lenkrad) buttons. not MINI).

LAUTSPRECHERBELEUCHTUNG.name: Speaker lighting
LAUTSPRECHERBELEUCHTUNG.description: Shows the setting for the illuminated speaker covers installed with some high-end sound systems, such as Bang & Olufsen.

EV_IMPORT.name: Navigation: EV import
EV_IMPORT.description: Setting for the navigation system's electric-vehicle data, used in its energy consumption calculations. Best left unchanged.

ARMREST_FRONT_CONTROL.name: Front armrest control panel
ARMREST_FRONT_CONTROL.description: Enables the front centre armrest control panel (touch/button controls in the armrest).

ENT_INDEX_LIST.name: Entertainment list index mode
ENT_INDEX_LIST.description: Selects how the entertainment list browser indexes and displays entries: no index, read-only mode, or read/write mode.

LIGHT_CARPET.name: Light carpet
LIGHT_CARPET.description: Shows the light carpet setting in the exterior lighting menu. The light carpet lights up the ground beside the doors when you unlock the car or open a door.

DOOR_HANDLE_LIGHTS.name: Door handle lighting
DOOR_HANDLE_LIGHTS.description: Offers the door handle lighting setting in the exterior lighting menu, for cars with illuminated door handles.

BENENNUNG_COLOUR_SWITCH_ENSEMBLE.name: Ambient light colour switch ensemble
BENENNUNG_COLOUR_SWITCH_ENSEMBLE.description: Selects the variant of the ambient light colour-switch button/ensemble in the interior. Controls whether the ambient lighting colour controls are in the default layout, colour switch, or colour switch with panoramic roof.

BENENNUNG_DEAKTIVIERUNGSMOEGLICHKEIT_AMB.name: Ambient light deactivation: follow interior lighting
BENENNUNG_DEAKTIVIERUNGSMOEGLICHKEIT_AMB.description: Controls whether the ambient lighting (Ambilight) deactivation option is in default mode or coupled to the interior lighting. When set to Interior lighting (1), the ambilight turns off and on together with the interior room lighting.

values.0: Default (ambient light behavior not coupled to interior lighting)
values.1: Interior lighting (ambient light follows interior lighting on/off)

CAPTAINCHAIR.name: Captain's chair seating
CAPTAINCHAIR.description: Declares that the vehicle has captain's chair rear seating (individual rear bucket seats rather than a bench). Adjusts applicable HMI seat control menus.

SEAT_MULTIFUNCTION.name: Seat multi-function controls
SEAT_MULTIFUNCTION.description: Enables the seat multi-function control menu (e.g. massage, memory, ventilation combined control).

HMI_CHECKBOX_COMFORT_EXIT.name: Comfort exit seat adjustment
HMI_CHECKBOX_COMFORT_EXIT.description: Enables the comfort exit feature — when a door is opened, the seat slides back to ease exit. Shows a checkbox in the HMI settings.

SEAT_AUTO_CLIMATE.name: Seat auto-climate
SEAT_AUTO_CLIMATE.description: Enables automatic seat climate control (heated/ventilated seat that adjusts automatically based on cabin conditions).

SEAT_VENTILATION_REAR.name: Rear seat ventilation
SEAT_VENTILATION_REAR.description: Enables rear seat ventilation control in the HMI.

DUFT_IONISATOR.name: Fragrance ioniser
DUFT_IONISATOR.description: Enables the interior fragrance/ioniser system control in the HMI (e.g. BMW ambient air fragrance diffuser).

SETTINGS_TIME_AUTOMATIC.name: Automatic time synchronisation source
SETTINGS_TIME_AUTOMATIC.description: Selects whether the head-unit clock is synchronised automatically, and from which source (offline/not active, online ConnectedDrive, or GPS navigation).

REGEN_SCHLIESSEN.name: Automatic window close in rain
REGEN_SCHLIESSEN.description: Enables the feature that automatically closes windows/convertible roof when rain is detected.

ALWAYS_OPEN_HMI.name: Always open HMI (bypass speed-lock)
ALWAYS_OPEN_HMI.description: Forces the HMI to remain open/accessible at all times regardless of speed-lock rules.

SETTINGS_COLOUR_SWITCH_MINI.name: MINI colour switch setting
SETTINGS_COLOUR_SWITCH_MINI.description: Enables the MINI-variant interior colour selector setting in the HMI. not MINI).

A4A_XL.name: Smartphone apps: XL layout
A4A_XL.description: Tells connected smartphone apps that they can use the XL (large-format) layout, so supported apps fill more of the central display.

A4A_KML.name: Smartphone apps: map content
A4A_KML.description: Tells connected smartphone apps that the head unit can show their map content, so supported apps can offer maps on the central display. Takes effect only when “Central display type” (`3001/57/11111111b`) is the wide display or the display with cover flap.

A4A_PIA.name: Smartphone apps: profiles (PIA)
A4A_PIA.description: Tells connected smartphone apps whether the head unit offers PIA, its personal profile feature, so supported apps can use it. Enabled at the factory with Apps (S6NR) or TeleServices (S6AE). Best left unchanged.

RANGE_MAX.name: Maximum navigation range display
RANGE_MAX.description: 4-bit numeric field selecting the maximum displayed range value in the EV / hybrid range indicator. encoded as a step index, not a direct km value.

CDMM_USB_PORTS.name: USB ports installed
CDMM_USB_PORTS.description: Tells the head unit which USB ports the car has and whether a snap-in adapter (phone cradle) is connected, so the matching media sources appear. Check only what the car has.

HMI_VERSION.name: HMI generation version
HMI_VERSION.description: Selects the iDrive HMI generation: ID4++ (iDrive 4 enhanced, older NBT Evo interface) or ID5 (iDrive 5 style, newer interface with tile/widget home screen).

ENT_JAPAN_SEARCH_READING.name: Japanese music search reading (kana/romaji)
ENT_JAPAN_SEARCH_READING.description: Enables the Japanese phonetic reading (kana or romaji) input mode for music search in the entertainment system. Active for Japanese market (807).

ENT_JAPAN_SPELLER_VARIANT.name: Japanese speller input variant
ENT_JAPAN_SPELLER_VARIANT.description: Selects the Japanese speller keyboard variant (with or without phonetic mapping for kana input). Active for Japanese market (807).

ENT_TAIWAN_SEARCH_READING.name: Taiwan music search reading (zhuyin/pinyin)
ENT_TAIWAN_SEARCH_READING.description: Enables the Taiwan phonetic reading input mode for music search. Active for Taiwan country-control (8LT) variant.

ENT_TAIWAN_SPELLER_VARIANT.name: Taiwan speller input variant
ENT_TAIWAN_SPELLER_VARIANT.description: Selects the Taiwan speller keyboard variant (with or without phonetic mapping for zhuyin/bopomofo input). Active for Taiwan country-control (8LT) variant.

HIGH_END_AUDIO_B_UND_W.name: Bowers & Wilkins high-end audio system menu
HIGH_END_AUDIO_B_UND_W.description: Selects the B&W (Bowers & Wilkins) high-end audio system's light staging / 'Surround Sound Experience' presentation mode shown in the HMI. Controls whether a menu is shown and what level of ambient light staging accompanies the audio.

JOHN_COOPER_WORKS_HMI.name: John Cooper Works HMI theme
JOHN_COOPER_WORKS_HMI.description: Enables the John Cooper Works (JCW) branded HMI theme/graphics for MINI JCW models. not MINI JCW).

EDRIVE_POPUP_DEACTIVATE.name: eDrive popup suppression
EDRIVE_POPUP_DEACTIVATE.description: Suppresses the eDrive mode popup/notification that appears when switching electric drive modes (for plug-in hybrid/EV).

EDRIVE_TOGGLE_AVAILABLE.name: eDrive mode toggle available
EDRIVE_TOGGLE_AVAILABLE.description: Enables the eDrive (electric drive) mode toggle button/option in the driving experience controls.

MMI_STATISTIK.name: iDrive usage statistics
MMI_STATISTIK.description: Records statistics on how the iDrive menus and controls are used.

LOGIC7_SYMBOL.name: Logic 7 audio system branding icon
LOGIC7_SYMBOL.description: Shows the Logic 7 surround-sound system branding symbol/icon in the audio settings menu.

CONNECTED_DRIVE.name: ConnectedDrive services
CONNECTED_DRIVE.description: Enables the BMW ConnectedDrive online services menu and framework.

HYBRID.name: Hybrid vehicle mode
HYBRID.description: Declares the vehicle as a hybrid (plug-in or full hybrid), enabling hybrid-specific HMI elements such as eDrive displays and charge indicators.

HEADLIGHT_SETTING.name: Headlight settings menu
HEADLIGHT_SETTING.description: Shows the headlight settings in the exterior lighting menu, such as daytime running lights and the setting for driving on the other side of the road.

APPLE_ENHANCEMENTS.name: Apple enhancements (BMW Apps / CarPlay prep)
APPLE_ENHANCEMENTS.description: Enables Apple-specific enhancements in the HMI, primarily the BMW Apps (A4A/PIA) Apple integration layer. Required together with 6NR Apps SA for Siri/Apple app features. Active when 6NR Apps is fitted.

SPEECH_FEEDBACK_CHANNEL.name: Speech feedback audio channel
SPEECH_FEEDBACK_CHANNEL.description: Enables a dedicated audio feedback channel for speech recognition (voice commands are acknowledged via a separate audio path rather than interrupting the main audio). Active when 6NR Apps is fitted.

IGNORE_ENGINE_RUN_TOURIST.name: Tourist light change with engine on
IGNORE_ENGINE_RUN_TOURIST.description: Lets you change the headlight setting for driving on the other side of the road (tourist function) while the engine is running. When disabled, it can be changed only with the engine off.

SERVICE_HISTORY_WHO.name: Service history: who can access/edit
SERVICE_HISTORY_WHO.description: Controls who has access to view or modify the service history records. Default = dealer/BMW access; value 1 = owner/driver access also allowed.

WCA.name: WCA (wireless charging area) display
WCA.description: Enables the WCA (Wireless Charging Area) status and settings in the HMI connectivity menu.

ARMREST_ALL_CONTROL.name: Armrest all-zone control
ARMREST_ALL_CONTROL.description: Enables HMI control of an electric armrest covering all zones. When active, an armrest adjustment menu is shown.

RSE_SERVING_SETTINGS.name: RSE media serving mode
RSE_SERVING_SETTINGS.description: Configures what the rear-seat entertainment (RSE) system can do when browsing media: basic playback only, skipping tracks, or full library browsing.

SLD.name: Speed-dependent volume (SLD) available
SLD.description: Enables speed-dependent volume (Geschwindigkeitsabhaengige Lautstaerkeanpassung / SLD) function in the audio settings.

KEY_CONF_TAILGATE.name: Doors/Key menu: tailgate options
KEY_CONF_TAILGATE.description: Shows the tailgate options in the “Doors/Key” menu, which set how the tailgate unlocks with the remote key.

KEY_CONF_COMFORT.name: Doors/Key menu: Comfort Access
KEY_CONF_COMFORT.description: Shows the Comfort Access options in the “Doors/Key” settings, for cars that unlock and lock when you touch the door handle with the key nearby.

KEY_CONF_COMFORT_TAILGATE.name: Doors/Key menu: Comfort Access tailgate
KEY_CONF_COMFORT_TAILGATE.description: Shows the tailgate options that belong to Comfort Access in the “Doors/Key” menu, for cars whose tailgate can be opened with the key nearby.

KEY_CONF_COMFORT_COOLING.name: Doors/Key menu: comfort cooling
KEY_CONF_COMFORT_COOLING.description: Shows a cooling option among the Comfort Access settings in the “Doors/Key” menu.

KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_SMALL.name: Doors/Key menu: second rear opening
KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_SMALL.description: Shows the options for a second, smaller rear opening, such as a rear window that opens on its own, in the “Doors/Key” menu.

SPECIAL_VEHICLE.name: Special vehicle type
SPECIAL_VEHICLE.description: Identifies special/authority vehicle designation. Used for vehicles fitted with special authority markings.

KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_NAME.name: Doors/Key menu: tailgate name
KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_NAME.description: Chooses what the “Doors/Key” menu calls the car's rear opening: rear window, tailgate, front gate or split doors. Match it to the car's body style.

OFFROADMETER.name: Off-road gauge (Offroadmeter)
OFFROADMETER.description: Enables the off-road gauges/display in the instrument cluster or HMI for off-road capable vehicles.

MACRO_CARWASH.name: Car wash button
MACRO_CARWASH.description: Shows a car wash button in the parking and camera menu, which switches the camera system into its car wash mode.

AIRQUALITY_POPUP.name: Air quality popup notification
AIRQUALITY_POPUP.description: Enables a popup notification for the air quality sensor reading. Active on Chinese-market variants (8AA) and certain vehicle body-type groups.

KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_SMALL_NAME.name: Doors/Key menu: second opening name
KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_SMALL_NAME.description: Chooses what the “Doors/Key” menu calls the second, smaller rear opening: rear window, tailgate or front gate.

KEY_CONF_UNLOCK_VEHICLE.name: Doors/Key menu: unlock options
KEY_CONF_UNLOCK_VEHICLE.description: Shows the unlock options in the “Doors/Key” menu, where you choose whether the remote key first unlocks only the driver's door or all doors.

KEY_CONF_COMFORT_HOMELIGHT.name: Doors/Key menu: home lights
KEY_CONF_COMFORT_HOMELIGHT.description: Shows a home lights option among the Comfort Access settings in the “Doors/Key” menu.

X_VIEW_GRAPHIC_SLOP.name: 3D view graphic slope interpolation
X_VIEW_GRAPHIC_SLOP.description: Sets the interpolation curve for the slope (pitch) axis in the 3D vehicle graphic (X-View). LINEAR=direct proportional, TRAJECTORY variants use non-linear curves.

X_VIEW_GRAPHIC_ROLL.name: 3D view graphic roll interpolation
X_VIEW_GRAPHIC_ROLL.description: Sets the interpolation curve for the roll axis in the 3D vehicle graphic (X-View).

SEAT_VENTILATION_FRONT.name: Front seat ventilation
SEAT_VENTILATION_FRONT.description: Enables front seat ventilation control in the HMI settings menu.

SEAT_HEATING_REAR.name: Rear seat heating
SEAT_HEATING_REAR.description: Enables rear seat heating control in the HMI.

SEAT_HEATING_FRONT.name: Front seat heating
SEAT_HEATING_FRONT.description: Enables front seat heating control in the HMI.

SEAT_TRAINING.name: Seat training / posture program
SEAT_TRAINING.description: Enables an automatic seat position training/exercise program that periodically adjusts the seat for ergonomics.

SEAT_FRONT_LORDOSE.name: Front seat lumbar support
SEAT_FRONT_LORDOSE.description: Enables lumbar support (Lordose) adjustment in the front seat settings menu.

SEAT_FRONT_MASSAGE.name: Front seat massage
SEAT_FRONT_MASSAGE.description: Enables the front seat massage function in the HMI.

SEAT_REAR_MASSAGE.name: Rear seat massage
SEAT_REAR_MASSAGE.description: Enables the rear seat massage function in the HMI.

SEAT_REAR_MULTIFUNCTION.name: Rear seat multifunction controls
SEAT_REAR_MULTIFUNCTION.description: Enables the rear seat multifunction control panel (e.g. recliner, legrest, individual climate) in the HMI.

DEAKTIVIERBARKEIT_SBA.name: Deactivatable seat-belt alert (SBA)
DEAKTIVIERBARKEIT_SBA.description: Allows the seat-belt reminder alert (SBA) to be turned off by the driver in settings.

DEAKTIVIERBARKEIT_PBA.name: Deactivatable parking brake alert (PBA)
DEAKTIVIERBARKEIT_PBA.description: Allows the parking brake alert (PBA) to be deactivated by the user through settings.

CLIMATE_AUTORECIRCULATION.name: Automatic climate recirculation (AUC)
CLIMATE_AUTORECIRCULATION.description: Specifies whether automatic air recirculation (AUC = Automatische Umluftsteuerung) is fitted, which closes the fresh air intake when poor outside air quality is detected.

CLIMATE_INDIRECTVENTILATION.name: Indirect ventilation (diffuse air mode)
CLIMATE_INDIRECTVENTILATION.description: Indicates whether indirect/diffuse ventilation (deflecting air from vents) is available in the climate system.

HVAC_STRA_MENUE.name: HVAC steering/operation mode (STRA menu)
HVAC_STRA_MENUE.description: Sets how the HVAC system is operated in the iDrive HMI: display-only (sense/touch or rotary), full MMI control, or MMI control in 1-zone mode.

LCI.name: LCI (facelift) variant
LCI.description: Flags this vehicle as an LCI (Life Cycle Impulse / facelift) model. Enables LCI-specific menus and display elements.

GESTURE_CAMERA_TWO_GESTURE.name: Gesture control: two-finger gesture
GESTURE_CAMERA_TWO_GESTURE.description: Turns on the two-finger gesture, whose action you choose in the gesture settings (such as opening the main menu or muting audio), in the standard version or the version for China.

HMI_ID_VERSION.name: HMI ID version / iDrive generation
HMI_ID_VERSION.description: Selects the iDrive HMI interface generation/version loaded for this vehicle. Determines the overall HMI look and feature set.

ERFS.name: Tire settings in tire pressure menu
ERFS.description: Adds a tire settings screen to the tire pressure menu, where you select the tires installed and how heavily the car is loaded, so the monitor checks against the right pressures. The extended version adds tire identification.

SPEEDLOCK_CAR_STANDSTILL.name: Speed lock: car standstill condition
SPEEDLOCK_CAR_STANDSTILL.description: Defines what vehicle condition is required to unlock speed-restricted functions (handbrake, gearbox in P, or a combination).

ENT_MIRACAST_DISPLAY_SETTINGS.name: Miracast display in settings
ENT_MIRACAST_DISPLAY_SETTINGS.description: Shows the Miracast wireless display option in the entertainment settings menu.

ENT_USB_DISPLAY_SETTINGS.name: USB display in settings
ENT_USB_DISPLAY_SETTINGS.description: Shows the USB display/mirroring option in the entertainment settings menu.

ENT_HDMI_DISPLAY_SETTINGS.name: HDMI display in settings
ENT_HDMI_DISPLAY_SETTINGS.description: Shows the HDMI input option in the entertainment settings menu.

MFL.name: Multifunction steering wheel (MFL)
MFL.description: Enables HMI integration of multifunction steering wheel (MFL = Multifunktionslenkrad) buttons.

SPEEDLOCK_SPELLER_INPUT.name: Speed lock: speller/keyboard input restriction
SPEEDLOCK_SPELLER_INPUT.description: Controls how text/address input via the speller or touchpad is locked while the vehicle is moving.

SPEEDLOCK_TEXT_LENGTH.name: Speed lock: destination text display length
SPEEDLOCK_TEXT_LENGTH.description: Sets how much of a destination/address text string is shown while the vehicle is in motion.

SPEEDLOCK_MOVING_PICTURES.name: Speed lock: video playback restriction
SPEEDLOCK_MOVING_PICTURES.description: Enables restriction of video (moving picture) playback while driving.

SPEEDLOCK_PICTURE_ADD.name: Speed lock: additional picture display restriction
SPEEDLOCK_PICTURE_ADD.description: Restricts access to picture/image viewing while the vehicle is moving.

SPEEDLOCK_INTERACTIVE_MAP_ADD.name: Speed lock: interactive map (additional) restriction
SPEEDLOCK_INTERACTIVE_MAP_ADD.description: Restricts use of additional interactive map features while driving.

SPEEDLOCK_INTERACTIVE_MAP_MAIN.name: Speed lock: interactive map (main) restriction
SPEEDLOCK_INTERACTIVE_MAP_MAIN.description: Restricts main interactive map use while the vehicle is in motion.

SPEEDLOCK_IBA_ACCESS_CCM.name: Speed lock: owner's manual from Check Control
SPEEDLOCK_IBA_ACCESS_CCM.description: Blocks opening the Integrated Owner's Manual from a Check Control message while the car is moving. Enabled at the factory for some markets, such as the Japanese, Australian, Canadian and Chinese versions (S807, S810, S838, S8AA or S8LH). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SPEEDLOCK_IBA_SHORT.name: Speed lock: owner's manual short form
SPEEDLOCK_IBA_SHORT.description: Blocks the short form of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving. Enabled at the factory for some markets, such as the Japanese, Australian, Canadian and Chinese versions (S807, S810, S838, S8AA or S8LH). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SPEEDLOCK_IBA_INDEX.name: Speed lock: owner's manual index
SPEEDLOCK_IBA_INDEX.description: Blocks the index of the Integrated Owner's Manual while the car is moving. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

AKT_AUTO_SITZE_FRONT.name: Automatic seat climate: front
AKT_AUTO_SITZE_FRONT.description: Chooses which seat climate functions the head unit offers in automatic mode for the front seats. A checked item is offered; check only what the front seats have.

AKT_AUTO_SITZE_FOND.name: Automatic seat climate: rear
AKT_AUTO_SITZE_FOND.description: Chooses which seat climate functions the head unit offers in automatic mode for the rear seats. A checked item is offered; check only what the rear seats have.

AKT_AUTO_LENKRADHEIZUNG.name: Active automatic steering wheel heating
AKT_AUTO_LENKRADHEIZUNG.description: Enables automatic steering wheel heating control via the HMI.

GESTURE_CAMERA_DEFAULT_STATE.name: Gesture control on by default
GESTURE_CAMERA_DEFAULT_STATE.description: Sets whether gesture control starts out switched on or off, for example on a new car or after the gesture settings are reset.

SETUP_WIZARD.name: Setup wizard on first boot
SETUP_WIZARD.description: Enables an initial setup wizard that runs the first time the vehicle is started or after a factory reset, guiding the driver through key settings.

M_VEHICLE_35UP.name: M model on 35up platform
M_VEHICLE_35UP.description: Tells the head unit the car is a BMW M model built on the 35up vehicle architecture, so it offers the M-specific menus for those cars. Enable it only on such a car.

M_MENUE.name: M-specific menu
M_MENUE.description: Enables the M-specific settings and drive menu in the iDrive HMI (M Drive / M Setup menus).

M_ALLRAD.name: M xDrive settings
M_ALLRAD.description: Shows the M xDrive settings on M models with M xDrive, where the driver picks the all-wheel-drive mode, such as 4WD or 4WD Sport.

M_INSZENIERUNG.name: M launch/staging animation (Inszenierung)
M_INSZENIERUNG.description: Enables the M-specific startup/launch staging animation or choreography in the HMI.

M_SHIFTLIGHTS.name: M shift lights
M_SHIFTLIGHTS.description: Enables the M shift lights feature (RPM-based shift indicator lights) shown in the instrument cluster or HMI.

BATTERY_CONTROL_AVAILABILITY.name: Battery charge control available
BATTERY_CONTROL_AVAILABILITY.description: Indicates whether the user-adjustable battery charge control (setting the target state-of-charge) is available on this vehicle.

BATTERY_CONTROL_SOC_TARGET_STEP.name: Battery charge target: step size
BATTERY_CONTROL_SOC_TARGET_STEP.description: Sets the increment step size (in percent) for the user-selectable battery charge target SOC (state of charge).

BATTERY_CONTROL_SOC_TARGET_MAX.name: Battery charge target: maximum SOC
BATTERY_CONTROL_SOC_TARGET_MAX.description: Sets the maximum selectable target state of charge (SOC) percentage for battery charge control.

BATTERY_CONTROL_SOC_TARGET_MIN.name: Battery charge target: minimum SOC
BATTERY_CONTROL_SOC_TARGET_MIN.description: Sets the minimum selectable target state of charge (SOC) percentage for battery charge control.

ENT_MIRACAST_MULTIPLE_STREAMS.name: Miracast: multiple simultaneous streams
ENT_MIRACAST_MULTIPLE_STREAMS.description: Enables support for multiple simultaneous Miracast wireless display streams (e.g. front and rear screens independently).

ESL.name: Charging preferences: ESL
ESL.description: Setting used by the charging preferences of plug-in hybrid and electric models. Best left unchanged.

OFFICE_MENUS_ACTIVE.name: Office (connected apps) menus active
OFFICE_MENUS_ACTIVE.description: Enables the BMW Connected Drive 'Office' menu group (messages, calendar, tasks, notes) in the iDrive HMI.

BATTERY_CONTROL_CONFIGURABLE_WOHNEN.name: Battery charge control: configurable home/residential mode
BATTERY_CONTROL_CONFIGURABLE_WOHNEN.description: Enables a user-configurable home/residential charging energy mode (Wohnen = home usage scenario). Firmware enum only names value 0 as NICHT_AKTIV (not active).

OIL_QUANTITY_HIGH_3L.name: High oil capacity (3+ litre sump)
OIL_QUANTITY_HIGH_3L.description: Flags that the engine has a large oil sump capacity (>=3 litres above standard), affecting oil condition display intervals.

NFC_HOTSPOT_PAIRING.name: NFC hotspot pairing
NFC_HOTSPOT_PAIRING.description: Enables NFC tap-to-pair for the vehicle Wi-Fi hotspot, allowing a phone to join the hotspot by touching an NFC sensor.

SETTINGS_AUTOMATIC_EXT_MIRROR_FOLDING.name: Automatic exterior mirror folding setting
SETTINGS_AUTOMATIC_EXT_MIRROR_FOLDING.description: Shows the automatic exterior mirror folding option in the vehicle settings menu.

TASTE_BEDUFTER_KLIMAMENUE.name: Ambient fragrance: climate menu button type
TASTE_BEDUFTER_KLIMAMENUE.description: Configures whether and which type of button is shown in the climate menu for the ambient fragrance (Beduefter) system.

ORIENTATION_FRAGRANCE_CARTRIDGE_HOLDER.name: Fragrance cartridge holder orientation
ORIENTATION_FRAGRANCE_CARTRIDGE_HOLDER.description: Sets the physical orientation of the fragrance cartridge holder in the vehicle (vertical or horizontal install).

POSITION_ADBLUE_TANK.name: AdBlue filler position
POSITION_ADBLUE_TANK.description: Specifies where the AdBlue (diesel exhaust fluid) filler cap is located on the vehicle.

CLIMATE_INDIRECTVENTILATION_2ZONES.name: Indirect ventilation: 2-zone climate
CLIMATE_INDIRECTVENTILATION_2ZONES.description: Enables indirect ventilation control for a 2-zone (driver + passenger) climate system.

GESTURE_CAMERA_ENABLE_SPEECH_CTRL.name: Gesture control: voice dialogs
GESTURE_CAMERA_ENABLE_SPEECH_CTRL.description: Lets gesture control act on voice control dialogs, for example a swipe gesture while a voice dialog is open. Works only when “Gesture control” (`3000/14/10000000b`) is enabled.

WCA_POSITION.name: Wireless charging pad position
WCA_POSITION.description: Specifies the physical location of the wireless charging area (WCA = Wireless Charging Area) in the vehicle.

ENT_BTAS_BROWSING_COVER.name: Bluetooth audio cover art browsing
ENT_BTAS_BROWSING_COVER.description: Enables album cover art display and browsing when using Bluetooth audio (BT Audio Source / BTAS).

EV_CONF_STARTUP_MODE.name: eDrive startup mode
EV_CONF_STARTUP_MODE.description: Shows a setting that lets the driver choose which eDrive mode a plug-in hybrid starts in.

SPEEDLOCK_SEE_ALL.name: Speed lock: see all (unrestricted view)
SPEEDLOCK_SEE_ALL.description: When active, allows all menu items to be visible while driving (not hidden by speed lock), though interaction may still be restricted.

ENT_HU_EXT_DRIVE.name: External HU drive (entertainment)
ENT_HU_EXT_DRIVE.description: Enables an external storage drive connected directly to the head unit for entertainment (media storage/playback).

M_ALLRAD_2WD.name: M xDrive 2WD mode
M_ALLRAD_2WD.description: Enables the 2WD (rear-wheel drive only) mode selector for M vehicles with xDrive.

CURSORPOSITION_PMA_AUSRICHTUNG.name: PMA cursor orientation (longitudinal/lateral)
CURSORPOSITION_PMA_AUSRICHTUNG.description: Sets the axis orientation of the Park Distance Control (PMA = Parkmanoeuvrerassistent) cursor on the HMI display.

KEY_CONF_LEVEL_CHANGE_VEHICLE.name: Key memory: vehicle level change
KEY_CONF_LEVEL_CHANGE_VEHICLE.description: Enables or disables the vehicle suspension level change option in the key memory configuration.

ENT_DRIVE_HU_EXT_AVAILABLE.name: External HU drive type (entertainment)
ENT_DRIVE_HU_EXT_AVAILABLE.description: Specifies what kind of external drive is available for entertainment content connected to the head unit.

SEAT_SOCCER_MUM.name: Soccer Mum / easy-access seat
SEAT_SOCCER_MUM.description: Enables the 'Soccer Mum' easy-entry/exit seat feature for the rear seats, simplifying rear passenger egress (seat slides back).

ALEV4_STATUS_SELECTION.name: Bus network generation (ALEV4)
ALEV4_STATUS_SELECTION.description: Identifies the vehicle bus architecture generation. Determines whether this is an NBT Evo BN2015 or BN2018 network generation.

ERFS_ECO_BELADUNG.name: Eco load in tire settings
ERFS_ECO_BELADUNG.description: Adds an Eco option to the load choices on the tire settings screen of the tire pressure menu, so the tire pressure monitor (RDC) can be set for that load condition.

CARPLAY_FULLSCREEN.name: CarPlay/projection fullscreen mode
CARPLAY_FULLSCREEN.description: Enables fullscreen display mode for CarPlay or other phone projection sources, expanding them to fill the entire display instead of a windowed view.

RR_OFFROAD_AVL.name: Rolls-Royce off-road mode available
RR_OFFROAD_AVL.description: Flags availability of the RR (Rolls-Royce) off-road terrain mode. Not applicable to standard BMW variants.

CKT_DOOR_LOCK_UNLOCK.name: Comfort key: door lock/unlock
CKT_DOOR_LOCK_UNLOCK.description: Enables the comfort key (CKT) door lock/unlock function (auto-lock on walk away, unlock on approach).

KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_REAR_WINDOW_DEACTIVATE.name: Key memory: tailgate rear window deactivate
KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_REAR_WINDOW_DEACTIVATE.description: Configures whether the tailgate rear window deactivation can be saved to key memory.

SETTINGS_SEATS_HEADREST_ADJUSTABLE_IN_HE.name: Seat headrest height adjustment available
SETTINGS_SEATS_HEADREST_ADJUSTABLE_IN_HE.description: Indicates that the front seat headrests are electrically adjustable in height, enabling the relevant menu in seat settings.

LOW_VOLTAGE_RECUP_SYSTEM.name: Low-voltage recuperation system
LOW_VOLTAGE_RECUP_SYSTEM.description: Enables the low-voltage recuperation/energy recovery system (e.g. belt starter-generator in mild-hybrid variants).

SMO_CONFIG.name: Panoramic roof / sunroof motor config (SMO)
SMO_CONFIG.description: Configures the powered roof motor operation mode: open only, open and close, or close only.

SCR_ANZEIGE_NEU.name: SCR display variant (AdBlue indicator style)
SCR_ANZEIGE_NEU.description: Selects the display style/variant for the SCR (Selective Catalytic Reduction / AdBlue) system status indicator in the HMI.

RSE_NO_REMOTECONTROL.name: RSE: no remote control
RSE_NO_REMOTECONTROL.description: Disables the physical remote control for the rear-seat entertainment (RSE) system.

RSL_ILLUMINATED_FRONTGRILL.name: RSL illuminated front grille
RSL_ILLUMINATED_FRONTGRILL.description: Enables and configures the illuminated front grille feature (RSL = Rolls-Royce Spirit of Ecstasy Illuminated). Not applicable to standard BMW.

ERWEITERTE_LICHTENSEMBLES.name: Extended ambient light ensembles
ERWEITERTE_LICHTENSEMBLES.description: Enables extended/additional ambient lighting ensembles (predefined colour scenes) in the ambient light settings.

PMALQ_BEDIENUNG.name: PMA long-press operation mode
PMALQ_BEDIENUNG.description: Sets whether the Park Distance Control display acknowledgement (PMALQ) requires a long press/hold to dismiss.

RR_OFFROAD_PREVIEW_ADD_INFO.name: Rolls-Royce off-road preview additional info
RR_OFFROAD_PREVIEW_ADD_INFO.description: Enables additional informational content in the RR off-road mode preview screen. Not applicable to standard BMW.

ZBE_HARDKEY_LAYOUT_VARIANT.name: iDrive controller (ZBE) hard key layout
ZBE_HARDKEY_LAYOUT_VARIANT.description: Selects the hard key layout variant of the iDrive rotary controller (ZBE = Zentrales Bediengeraet).

MACRO_RCP_EINPARKEN.name: Remote Control Parking button
MACRO_RCP_EINPARKEN.description: Tells the head unit which generation of Remote Control Parking the car has. Only generation 1 adds the “Remote controlled parking” button to the control bar of the parking view. Set it to match the car's parking equipment.

GUIDING_PLUS.name: Junction views (Guiding Plus)
GUIDING_PLUS.description: Shows enlarged views of complex intersections and highway exits during route guidance, so you can see the way through before you reach them.

HIGH_END_AUDIO_MENUE.name: High-end audio menu / staging level
HIGH_END_AUDIO_MENUE.description: Controls the depth of the high-end audio (e.g. Bang & Olufsen / HiFi) settings menu shown in the HMI, from no menu to full staging with light animation.

OFFICE_MENUS_SMS_EIN_AUS.name: Office: SMS/text messaging menu
OFFICE_MENUS_SMS_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the SMS/text messaging option in the BMW Connected Drive Office menu.

OFFICE_MENUS_EMAIL_EIN_AUS.name: Office: email menu
OFFICE_MENUS_EMAIL_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the email option in the BMW Connected Drive Office menu.

OFFICE_MENUS_CALENDAR_EIN_AUS.name: Office: calendar menu
OFFICE_MENUS_CALENDAR_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the calendar option in the BMW Connected Drive Office menu. Requires Professional Navigation (609).

OFFICE_MENUS_TASK_EIN_AUS.name: Office: tasks menu
OFFICE_MENUS_TASK_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the task management option in the BMW Connected Drive Office menu. Requires Professional Navigation (609).

OFFICE_MENUS_NOTES_EIN_AUS.name: Office: notes menu
OFFICE_MENUS_NOTES_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the notes/memo pad option in the BMW Connected Drive Office menu.

SEAT_SEAT_MEMORY_POPUP.name: Seat memory popup on key change
SEAT_SEAT_MEMORY_POPUP.description: Shows a popup prompt offering to load a seat memory position when a different key is detected.

SEAT_LIMIT_POPUP.name: Seat limit popup
SEAT_LIMIT_POPUP.description: Enables a popup notification when seat movement has reached a configured limit (e.g. child safety zone).

SEAT_MEMORY_POPUP.name: Seat memory popup
SEAT_MEMORY_POPUP.description: Enables a popup to appear offering seat memory recall when entering the vehicle.

HVAC_REMOTE_ENGINE_START.name: HVAC remote engine start
HVAC_REMOTE_ENGINE_START.description: Enables remote engine start with climate pre-conditioning from the BMW Connected Drive app or key fob.

WATER_INJECTION.name: Water injection system
WATER_INJECTION.description: Enables HMI support for the BMW M water injection system (water/methanol injection for charge cooling on M performance engines).

CHARGING_PLUG_LOCK.name: Charging plug lock (EV)
CHARGING_PLUG_LOCK.description: Enables the charging plug/cable lock control in the HMI for electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles.

PIM_SUPPORTED_FEATURES_POPUP.name: PIM supported features popup
PIM_SUPPORTED_FEATURES_POPUP.description: Enables a popup informing the user which Personal Information Management (PIM) features are available via Connected Drive.

TOURISTLIGHT_RIGHTHANDDRIVE.name: Tourist light / right-hand drive market
TOURISTLIGHT_RIGHTHANDDRIVE.description: Sets the default traffic-side for the tourist/driving-on-right headlamp assistant. Relevant for UK/Japan/Australia markets.

TEXTKUERZUNG.name: Text abbreviation / truncation
TEXTKUERZUNG.description: Enables automatic abbreviation/truncation of long text strings in the HMI where space is limited.

DAYDRIVING_LIGHT.name: Daytime light behavior
DAYDRIVING_LIGHT.description: Sets the daytime running lights to always off, always on or the standard behavior. The always-off and always-on values also change the daytime running lights entry in the exterior lighting menu.

WELCOME_LIGHT.name: Welcome light
WELCOME_LIGHT.description: Enables the welcome/coming-home light function that illuminates exterior lights when the vehicle is unlocked.

TRAFFIC_MODE.name: Traffic mode
TRAFFIC_MODE.description: Enables a special driving mode optimised for heavy traffic conditions.

TRAFFIC_MODE_AUTO.name: Automatic traffic mode
TRAFFIC_MODE_AUTO.description: Enables automatic activation of traffic mode based on detected traffic conditions.

MAXGLOBALREMOTECOMMANDS.name: App voice commands: global limit
MAXGLOBALREMOTECOMMANDS.description: Limits how many global voice commands connected apps can register with the car's voice control. Best left unchanged.

MAXLOCALREMOTECOMMANDS.name: App voice commands: local limit
MAXLOCALREMOTECOMMANDS.description: Limits how many local voice commands connected apps can register with the car's voice control. Best left unchanged.

A4A_PROD_MONTH.name: Smartphone apps: production date (month)
A4A_PROD_MONTH.description: Production month the head unit reports to connected smartphone apps, together with the year setting.

A4A_PROD_YEAR.name: Smartphone apps: production date (year)
A4A_PROD_YEAR.description: Production year the head unit reports to connected smartphone apps, together with the month setting.

RSE.name: Rear seat entertainment (RSE) type
RSE.description: Specifies the type of rear-seat entertainment system fitted: none, mid-level, or high-end.

RSE_KLEER.name: RSE wireless system (Kleer)
RSE_KLEER.description: Specifies the Kleer wireless audio/headphone system configuration for RSE.

SVS_PAL.name: Video system: PAL format
SVS_PAL.description: Enables PAL video format support for the rear screen video system (SVS = Seat Video System).

SVS_VOICE.name: Voice control (SVS/iDrive speech)
SVS_VOICE.description: Enables the iDrive voice control system. Active when navigation (606/609) or multifunction steering wheel (249) is fitted.

RSE_BLUETOOTH.name: RSE Bluetooth type
RSE_BLUETOOTH.description: Specifies the Bluetooth keyboard/trackball type for the RSE system.

REDUZIERT_BEI_FAHRT.name: Reduced functionality while driving
REDUZIERT_BEI_FAHRT.description: Enables a mode where some HMI features are reduced or simplified while the vehicle is in motion.

EXT_MUSIC_MANAGEMENT.name: External music management
EXT_MUSIC_MANAGEMENT.description: Enables external/third-party music management on the head unit. When active, allows the HMI to expose extended music library management controls beyond the built-in player.

ONE_SHOT_DEST_INPUT.name: One-shot destination input
ONE_SHOT_DEST_INPUT.description: Enables single-step destination entry mode in navigation, allowing the user to enter a destination without stepping through address fields individually.

CDMM_TV_AUTOSTORE.name: TV tuner auto-store channels
CDMM_TV_AUTOSTORE.description: Enables automatic channel storage (auto-store) for the CDMM television tuner module. When active, the TV tuner automatically scans and stores available channels.

TVM_VARIANTEN.name: TV tuner variant
TVM_VARIANTEN.description: Selects which television tuner variant (TVM) is installed. Controls which tuner hardware the CDMM module communicates with.

CDMM_TV_BML.name: TV tuner BML (basic menu list)
CDMM_TV_BML.description: Enables the Basic Menu List for the television tuner, providing a simplified channel list UI for the CDMM TV module.

CDMM_TV_TELETEXT.name: TV tuner teletext
CDMM_TV_TELETEXT.description: Enables the teletext feature for the CDMM television tuner, allowing the display of broadcast text pages.

SPEEDLOCK_FREISCHALTMENU.name: Speed-lock unlock menu (Japan)
SPEEDLOCK_FREISCHALTMENU.description: Enables the speed-lock unlock menu, which is a Japanese-market feature allowing the operator to access a menu to suppress speed-dependent function restrictions.

CDMM_USB_COMPOSER_MSD.name: USB MSD Composer support
CDMM_USB_COMPOSER_MSD.description: Enables CDMM support for USB Mass Storage Device (MSD) with the Composer metadata library. When active, the USB port can browse music via the Composer-generated database.

CDMM_TV_SUBTITLES.name: TV tuner subtitles
CDMM_TV_SUBTITLES.description: Enables subtitle display for the CDMM television tuner, allowing broadcast subtitle tracks to be shown on screen.

CDMM_TV_PAY_BROWSER_LIST.name: TV tuner pay-TV browser list
CDMM_TV_PAY_BROWSER_LIST.description: Enables the pay-TV / conditional-access channel browser list in the CDMM television tuner menu.

CDMM_TV_FOLLOWING.name: TV tuner channel following
CDMM_TV_FOLLOWING.description: Enables automatic channel-following in the CDMM TV tuner: when the current channel becomes unavailable, the tuner automatically switches to the best available alternative.

CDMM_TV_PRESETLIST.name: TV tuner preset list
CDMM_TV_PRESETLIST.description: Enables the preset/favourite channel list in the CDMM television tuner, showing stored channels in the channel browser.

CDMM_TV_AUDIOTRACK.name: TV tuner audio track selection
CDMM_TV_AUDIOTRACK.description: Enables the audio track selection feature for the CDMM television tuner, allowing the user to choose from multiple broadcast audio tracks (e.g. language, commentary).

CDMM_TV_EPG.name: TV tuner EPG (electronic programme guide)
CDMM_TV_EPG.description: Enables the Electronic Programme Guide in the CDMM television tuner, showing broadcast schedules and programme information on-screen.

M_DIGITAL_TACHO_EINH.name: M digital speedometer units
M_DIGITAL_TACHO_EINH.description: Controls the measurement units for the M-mode digital speedometer display (Einheit=unit). Determines whether the digital tacho reads in km/h or mph.

MDRIVE_CONFIG.name: M Drive setups: one or two
MDRIVE_CONFIG.description: Sets whether the M Drive menu offers two stored setups (M Drive 1 and M Drive 2) or a single one. Match it to the car's M Drive buttons.

M_DIGITAL_TACHO.name: M digital speedometer
M_DIGITAL_TACHO.description: Enables the M-mode digital speedometer display in the head unit HMI, showing a large digital speed readout during sporty driving.

MDRIVE.name: M Drive menu
MDRIVE.description: Shows the M Drive menu, where the driver stores a preferred mix of engine, chassis, steering and stability control settings to call up with the M Drive button.

NFC_SMART_ACCESS.name: NFC access (digital key)
NFC_SMART_ACCESS.description: Shows the NFC access settings in the “Doors/Key” menu, where phones or cards set up as keys for the car are managed.

DSC_OFF.name: DSC Off menu
DSC_OFF.description: Enables the DSC (Dynamic Stability Control) Off option in the driving mode/settings menu, allowing the driver to fully disable DSC. When not active, the DSC Off option is hidden.

DSC_MENUE.name: DSC settings menu
DSC_MENUE.description: Enables the DSC (Dynamic Stability Control) settings sub-menu in the HMI, providing access to DSC mode selection and related options.

EDC_CIC.name: EDC suspension menu (CIC)
EDC_CIC.description: Enables the Electronic Damper Control (EDC) menu in the HMI for vehicles with adaptive suspension. Provides the user-facing damper mode selector.

COMFORT_OPENING.name: Comfort access (window/sunroof opening)
COMFORT_OPENING.description: Enables the comfort opening feature, which allows windows and/or the sunroof to be opened by holding the unlock button on the key fob. Not available on Canadian-spec cars.

OELSTANDSMENUE.name: Oil level menu
OELSTANDSMENUE.description: Shows the electronic oil level check in the vehicle status menu, so you can measure and read the engine oil level on the central display.

OELSTAND_OENS.name: Oil level sensor (OENS) support
OELSTAND_OENS.description: Enables support for the oil level sensor (OENS = Ölstand-Echtzeitmessung, real-time oil level measurement), required for the oil level readout to function.

CDMM_TV_CAS_MENUE.name: TV tuner conditional-access (CAS) menu
CDMM_TV_CAS_MENUE.description: Enables the Conditional Access System (CAS) menu for the CDMM television tuner, providing access to pay-TV smart-card/subscription management.

CDMM_ANALOG_AUX.name: Analog AUX input
CDMM_ANALOG_AUX.description: Enables the analog AUX audio input source in the CDMM media manager, making the AUX IN socket selectable as an audio source in the media menu.

EV_AUXILIARY_CONSUMERS.name: Auxiliary consumers display (EV)
EV_AUXILIARY_CONSUMERS.description: Shows the auxiliary consumers screen for electrified models, which lists how much power comfort features such as climate control are drawing.

HMI_HANDWRITING_RECOGNITION.name: Handwriting recognition input
HMI_HANDWRITING_RECOGNITION.description: Enables handwriting/gesture recognition as an input method on the iDrive touchpad, allowing the user to draw letters to enter destinations or search terms.

INDUCTIVECHARGING.name: Inductive car charging
INDUCTIVECHARGING.description: Turns on support for inductive (wireless) charging of the car's battery, for cars with the system installed. Adds a button in the parking menu, charging station settings and a positioning guide that helps you stop over the charging pad.

RSE_DRIVER_DISTRACTION_RELEVANT.name: RSE driver distraction relevant
RSE_DRIVER_DISTRACTION_RELEVANT.description: Marks the rear-seat entertainment (RSE) system as driver-distraction-relevant, enabling speed-dependent content restrictions on the RSE screens when viewed from the front.

ACOUSTIC_TOUCH_FEEDBACK.name: Acoustic touch feedback
ACOUSTIC_TOUCH_FEEDBACK.description: Enables acoustic (audible click) feedback when the touchscreen or touchpad is tapped, providing haptic-style audio confirmation of touch inputs.

SEATBELTREMINDER_MENU_AVAILABLE.name: Seat belt reminder menu type
SEATBELTREMINDER_MENU_AVAILABLE.description: Selects the type of seat belt reminder notification available to the driver/passenger. Controls whether the reminder shows a simple OK button or a deeper settings menu link.

SEATBELTREMINDER_MIDDLE_SEAT.name: Seat belt reminder middle seat
SEATBELTREMINDER_MIDDLE_SEAT.description: Enables seat belt reminder monitoring and notification for the rear middle seat position, in addition to the standard outer seat positions.

CARSHARING.name: Car sharing mode
CARSHARING.description: Enables car-sharing mode in the HMI, which adapts the system for flexible multi-driver use (e.g. anonymising personalisation, enabling guest profiles). Active when car-sharing preparation (5GC) is coded.

HYBRID_EFFICIENCY_GRAPHIC.name: Hybrid efficiency graphic
HYBRID_EFFICIENCY_GRAPHIC.description: Enables the hybrid-specific energy flow / efficiency graphic display in the HMI, showing battery charge state, regeneration, and power flow for hybrid models.

RSE_SEAT_LONGITUDINAL_POSITION_DR_THRESH.name: RSE seat longitudinal position threshold (driver)
RSE_SEAT_LONGITUDINAL_POSITION_DR_THRESH.description: Sets the driver-seat forward/rearward position threshold for RSE screen visibility restriction. When the driver seat is forward of this position, RSE screens may be restricted to prevent distraction.

RSE_SEAT_LONGITUDINAL_POSITION_PS_THRESH.name: RSE seat longitudinal position threshold (passenger)
RSE_SEAT_LONGITUDINAL_POSITION_PS_THRESH.description: Sets the passenger-seat forward/rearward position threshold for RSE screen restriction. When the passenger seat is within this position range, RSE screen access rules apply.

RSE_SEAT_BACKREST_TILT_PS_THRESHOLD.name: RSE seat backrest tilt threshold (passenger)
RSE_SEAT_BACKREST_TILT_PS_THRESHOLD.description: Sets the passenger seat backrest recline angle threshold for RSE screen visibility. When the backrest is reclined beyond this angle, RSE restrictions may change.

RR_RSE_KISI_ACTIVATION.name: Rolls-Royce RSE KISI activation
RR_RSE_KISI_ACTIVATION.description: Enables the RSE KISI (Kino Sitz Infotainment = cinema seat infotainment) feature for Rolls-Royce vehicles with rear-seat entertainment systems.

CLOCK_CHANGE_AUTOMATIC.name: Automatic clock change (DST/GPS sync)
CLOCK_CHANGE_AUTOMATIC.description: Enables automatic clock adjustment for daylight saving time transitions and/or GPS time synchronisation. When active, the clock updates automatically without user intervention.

SETTINGS_SPIRITOFECSTASY.name: Spirit of Ecstasy settings (Rolls-Royce)
SETTINGS_SPIRITOFECSTASY.description: Enables settings related to the Spirit of Ecstasy retractable bonnet mascot on Rolls-Royce vehicles, providing HMI controls for the feature.

ZBE_TOUCH_INTERACTIVE_MAP.name: ZBE Touch interactive map
ZBE_TOUCH_INTERACTIVE_MAP.description: Enables touch-based interactive map control via the ZBE (iDrive controller) touchpad, allowing the user to pan and zoom the navigation map by swiping on the iDrive dial surface.

ZBE_TOUCH_SPELLER.name: ZBE Touch speller input
ZBE_TOUCH_SPELLER.description: Enables the touchpad gesture speller on the ZBE iDrive controller, allowing the user to draw letters on the dial surface for text entry.

ZBE_TOUCH_BROWSER.name: ZBE Touch browser swipe
ZBE_TOUCH_BROWSER.description: Enables touch-based list browsing via the ZBE iDrive controller touchpad, allowing the user to swipe through menus and lists by sliding a finger on the dial.

LICHTSCHWERT.name: Interior light bar
LICHTSCHWERT.description: Shows the setting for the interior light bar (Lichtschwert, light sword) in the interior lighting menu, for cars with one installed.

INDIVIDUAL_AMBIENTELICHT.name: Individual ambient lighting colour
INDIVIDUAL_AMBIENTELICHT.description: Enables the individual colour selection for interior ambient lighting, allowing the driver to choose from a custom colour palette rather than a preset colour set.

AMBIENTELICHT_PERMANENTANZEIGE_FES.name: Ambient lighting permanent display (FES)
AMBIENTELICHT_PERMANENTANZEIGE_FES.description: Enables a permanent-on ambient lighting display mode for FES (Fahrerlebnisschalter / driving experience switch) variants, keeping the ambient light visible at all times regardless of other settings.

REMOTE_HMI.name: Remote HMI access level
REMOTE_HMI.description: Sets the access level for Remote HMI (remote head-unit display/control, e.g. BMW Connected app mirroring or ConnectedDrive remote services).

A4A.name: A4A (Apps for Auto) enabled
A4A.description: Master enable bit for the Apps for Auto (A4A) smartphone integration framework. When active, the HMI exposes the A4A app infrastructure for connected smartphone apps.

A4A_REMOTE_APPS.name: A4A remote apps enabled
A4A_REMOTE_APPS.description: Enables remote app execution within the A4A framework, allowing approved smartphone apps to run on or through the head unit via the connected phone.

TERMINAL_UI.name: Terminal UI
TERMINAL_UI.description: Enables the Terminal UI feature, a screen-mirroring / remote-display interface allowing an external device to render its UI on the iDrive screen.

DEAKTIVIERUNGSMOEGLICHKEIT_AMBILIGHT.name: Ambient lighting deactivation option (brand)
DEAKTIVIERUNGSMOEGLICHKEIT_AMBILIGHT.description: Selects the brand-specific option for whether ambient lighting can be deactivated by the user, and which brand's implementation to use (BMW or MINI style).

TERMINAL_UI_PORT.name: Terminal UI port
TERMINAL_UI_PORT.description: Selects which physical port(s) the Terminal UI remote-display feature operates over (SIA, KUZU, or both interfaces).

CDMM_AUX_SIMPLE_1.name: Simple AUX input 1
CDMM_AUX_SIMPLE_1.description: Enables the first simplified AUX audio input channel in the CDMM media manager, typically used for a basic analog audio line input without full metadata support.

CDMM_AUX_SIMPLE_2.name: Simple AUX input 2
CDMM_AUX_SIMPLE_2.description: Enables the second simplified AUX audio input channel in the CDMM media manager.

SPEEDLOCK_HMI_TUNER.name: Speed lock: tuner/radio functions
SPEEDLOCK_HMI_TUNER.description: Controls whether tuner/radio functions (e.g. station search, frequency input) are locked above a certain speed. When active, these HMI interactions are blocked while driving.

RSE_BRIGHTNESS.name: RSE display brightness control
RSE_BRIGHTNESS.description: Enables the brightness adjustment control for rear-seat entertainment (RSE) screens in the HMI, allowing the driver or passengers to change RSE screen brightness.

COLOUR_SWITCH.name: Ambient/UI colour switch (model line)
COLOUR_SWITCH.description: Enables the model-line-specific colour theme switch for the HMI and ambient lighting. When active, the system uses the colour scheme associated with the vehicle's line (Sport, Urban, Modern, Luxury).

HELLIGKEIT_AMBILIGHT.name: Ambient lighting brightness control
HELLIGKEIT_AMBILIGHT.description: Enables the ambient lighting brightness adjustment option in the HMI settings, allowing the driver to dim or brighten interior ambient light strips.

COLOUR_SWITCH_LINES.name: Colour switch line assignment
COLOUR_SWITCH_LINES.description: Sets which vehicle design line's colour theme is applied. Determines the colour accent used in the iDrive UI and ambient lighting for Sport, Urban, Modern, or Luxury Line variants.

HIGH_BEAM_ASSISTANT.name: High beam assistant (city lights)
HIGH_BEAM_ASSISTANT.description: Enables the High Beam Assistant (automatic main beam control) feature in the HMI, providing the on/off setting and status display for the automatic high-beam system.

ACOUSTICAL_LOCK_CONFIRM.name: Audible lock confirmation
ACOUSTICAL_LOCK_CONFIRM.description: Offers a setting for a sound that confirms the car has locked when you lock it with the remote key. Enabled at the factory with the alarm system (S302) and set per market and model.

MOMENTDISTRIBUTION_MENU.name: Torque distribution menu (xDrive/4WD)
MOMENTDISTRIBUTION_MENU.description: Enables the torque moment distribution menu in the HMI, showing the current xDrive torque split between front and rear axles.

NANP_FORMAT.name: NANP phone number format
NANP_FORMAT.description: Enables North American Numbering Plan (NANP) phone number formatting in the HMI contact and call display, using the 10-digit +1 (NXX-NXX-XXXX) format.

ENABLE_SW_INFO_REQUEST.name: Software version info request enabled
ENABLE_SW_INFO_REQUEST.description: Enables the ability to request and display software version information from within the HMI diagnostic/about screens.

HDC.name: Hill descent control (HDC) menu
HDC.description: Enables the Hill Descent Control (HDC) menu entry in the HMI driving aids settings, allowing the driver to activate and configure the hill descent speed assist.

PANORAMADACH.name: Panoramic sunroof menu
PANORAMADACH.description: Enables the panoramic sunroof control entry in the HMI comfort/settings menu, providing shade and opening controls for the panoramic roof.

DATUMSFORMAT_AR_ASIA.name: Arabic/Asian date format
DATUMSFORMAT_AR_ASIA.description: Enables the Arabic or Asian date display format variant in the HMI clock and calendar displays, using the appropriate regional format instead of the Western day/month/year convention.

RR_RSE_NEW_CONCEPT_INFOTAINMENT.name: Rolls-Royce RSE new infotainment concept
RR_RSE_NEW_CONCEPT_INFOTAINMENT.description: Selects the RSE (Rear-Seat Entertainment) infotainment system concept type for Rolls-Royce vehicles, enabling a new-generation RSE display architecture.

HMI_MAIN_MENU_VERSION.name: HMI main menu version/layout
HMI_MAIN_MENU_VERSION.description: Selects the main menu layout version for the iDrive HMI. Different values select alternative home-screen arrangements.

A4A_LEGAL_DISCLAIMER.name: A4A legal disclaimer
A4A_LEGAL_DISCLAIMER.description: Enables the legal disclaimer screen that is displayed when the A4A (Apps for Auto / smartphone projection) session starts. Required for certain markets (Japan) and when TeleServices are active.

MESSAGE_DICTATION.name: Voice message dictation
MESSAGE_DICTATION.description: Enables the voice dictation feature for composing messages (e.g. SMS, email) using the voice control system, transcribing spoken words into text.

MAX_DICTATION_TIME_SEC.name: Maximum voice dictation duration
MAX_DICTATION_TIME_SEC.description: Sets the maximum duration in seconds allowed for a single voice dictation recording session. Higher values allow longer spoken messages.

TERMINAL_UI_LINK.name: Terminal UI link (screen mirroring link)
TERMINAL_UI_LINK.description: Enables the Terminal UI link function, establishing the connection between the Terminal UI remote display client and the iDrive screen rendering pipeline.

ECO_SLOPE_ON_OFF.name: ECO Pro slope guidance on/off
ECO_SLOPE_ON_OFF.description: Enables the ECO Pro slope/gradient driving guidance feature, which adjusts acceleration and deceleration coaching on hills to maximise fuel economy.

ECO_CURVE_ON_OFF.name: ECO Pro curve guidance on/off
ECO_CURVE_ON_OFF.description: Enables the ECO Pro curve/cornering guidance feature, providing coaching to lift off the accelerator before bends to save fuel.

ECO_TRANS_ON_OFF.name: ECO Pro transmission guidance on/off
ECO_TRANS_ON_OFF.description: Enables the ECO Pro transmission (gearshift) coaching guidance, advising the driver when to upshift for optimal fuel economy.

ECO_AUX_ON_OFF.name: ECO Pro auxiliary consumers guidance on/off
ECO_AUX_ON_OFF.description: Enables ECO Pro coaching for auxiliary electrical consumers (climate, seat heating, etc.), advising the driver to reduce consumption to improve efficiency.

ECO_FERRY_CONS.name: ECO PRO route: ferry consumption factor
ECO_FERRY_CONS.description: Sets the factor that the navigation's ECO PRO (energy-saving) route calculation applies to ferry sections when it estimates a route's fuel or energy use, from 0 to 4 times.

ECO_TIPS_LAYOUT_NEW.name: ECO Pro tips new layout
ECO_TIPS_LAYOUT_NEW.description: Enables the new-generation ECO Pro tips/coaching screen layout, replacing the legacy layout with an updated visual design.

ECO_TIPPS_ONEPADDLEDRIVE.name: ECO Pro one-pedal drive tips
ECO_TIPPS_ONEPADDLEDRIVE.description: Enables ECO Pro coaching tips specific to one-pedal driving technique (lift-off coasting/regeneration), relevant for hybrid and EV models.

DOOR_LOCK_AFTER_DRIVING_AWAY.name: Auto door lock when driving away
DOOR_LOCK_AFTER_DRIVING_AWAY.description: Enables automatic door locking when the vehicle reaches a set speed after pulling away, without requiring the driver to manually lock the doors.

A4A_VOICE_APP_SUPPORT.name: A4A voice app support
A4A_VOICE_APP_SUPPORT.description: Enables voice command integration for A4A (Apps for Auto) smartphone apps, allowing connected apps to be controlled via the vehicle's voice recognition system.

DEPARTURE_TIME_CLIMATE.name: Departure time climate pre-conditioning
DEPARTURE_TIME_CLIMATE.description: Enables the departure time pre-conditioning feature, allowing the user to schedule the climate control to reach the desired temperature before entering the vehicle.

COVER_FLOW.name: Cover Flow album browser
COVER_FLOW.description: Enables the Cover Flow album artwork browser in the audio/media player, displaying album art in a horizontally-scrollable 3D carousel view.

HMI_BRAND.name: Brand theme
HMI_BRAND.description: Sets which brand's look the head unit uses, including logos, colors and menu styling. Set it to match the car's brand.

M_VEHICLE.name: M model
M_VEHICLE.description: Tells the head unit the car is a BMW M model, so it offers M-specific menus and graphics. Enable it only on an M model.

M_DRIVE_SYSTEMS.name: M Drive systems enable
M_DRIVE_SYSTEMS.description: Enables the full M Drive Systems integration, activating M-specific powertrain and chassis control displays and settings menus (M differential, M suspension modes, etc.).

TRACTION_DEMAND_CONTROL.name: Traction demand control menu
TRACTION_DEMAND_CONTROL.description: Enables the traction demand control menu in the HMI, which may allow selection of traction/all-wheel-drive demand mode settings for compatible drivetrains.

BARGEIN.name: Voice control barge-in
BARGEIN.description: Enables the voice control barge-in feature, allowing the driver to start speaking a voice command without pressing a button, even while audio is playing. Requires navigation and steering wheel buttons.

GOOGLE_LOCAL_VOICE_SEARCH.name: Google local voice search
GOOGLE_LOCAL_VOICE_SEARCH.description: Enables Google-powered local voice search integration, allowing the user to search for points of interest and information using Google voice recognition.

EWS.name: Emergency warning broadcasts
EWS.description: Shows emergency warning messages that broadcasters send over digital radio or TV as a pop-up on the central display, in markets where such warnings are broadcast.
