A4A_STT_SPELLER_INPUT.name: A4A speech-to-text speller input
A4A_STT_SPELLER_INPUT.description: Enables speech-to-text (STT) input for the A4A speller, allowing the user to dictate text into A4A connected app text fields using the vehicle's microphone.

A4A_STATUS_BAR_NOTIFICATION.name: A4A status bar notifications
A4A_STATUS_BAR_NOTIFICATION.description: Enables notification display from A4A connected smartphone apps in the iDrive status bar, showing app alerts and incoming notifications.

A4A_CALENDER_WIDGET.name: A4A calendar widget
A4A_CALENDER_WIDGET.description: Enables the calendar/agenda widget for A4A connected apps, displaying upcoming appointments from the connected smartphone's calendar on the iDrive home screen.

COLOUR_SWITCH_ENSEMBLE.name: Ambient/UI colour ensemble (Rolls-Royce)
COLOUR_SWITCH_ENSEMBLE.description: Selects the ambient lighting and UI colour ensemble for Rolls-Royce vehicles, corresponding to the vehicle's interior colour scheme option.

OFFICE_MESSAGES_SPEEDLOCK_CONDITION.name: Standstill rule for Office messages
OFFICE_MESSAGES_SPEEDLOCK_CONDITION.description: Sets the standstill condition the head unit checks before it lifts the driving lock on Office messages: none, the parking brake set, the transmission in Park, both or either one. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

MYINFO_DRIVING_TEXT_LENGTH.name: Text while driving: My Info messages
MYINFO_DRIVING_TEXT_LENGTH.description: Limits how much of a My Info message the head unit shows while the car is moving: no details, the first page or the whole text. Set per market at the factory, as rules on driver distraction vary by country.

AKD_DRIVING_TEXT_LENGTH.name: Text while driving: AKD messages
AKD_DRIVING_TEXT_LENGTH.description: Limits how much of an AKD message the head unit shows while the car is moving: no details, the first page or the whole text. Set per market at the factory, as rules on driver distraction vary by country.

BMWINFO_DRIVING_TEXT_LENGTH.name: Text while driving: BMW Info messages
BMWINFO_DRIVING_TEXT_LENGTH.description: Limits how much of a BMW Info message (a message BMW sends to the car) the head unit shows while the car is moving: no details, the first page or the whole text. Set per market at the factory, as rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SERVICES_MESSAGES_SPEEDLOCK_CONDITION.name: Standstill rule for Services messages
SERVICES_MESSAGES_SPEEDLOCK_CONDITION.description: Sets the standstill condition the head unit checks before it lifts the driving lock on messages in the Services area: none, the parking brake set, the transmission in Park, both or either one. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_1.name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 1
INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_1.description: First map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay. When the navigation map reaches this zoom level, the inductive charging position indicator behaviour changes.

INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_2.name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 2
INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_2.description: Second map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay.

INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_3.name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 3
INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_3.description: Third map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay.

INDUCTIVECHARGING_POSXCPM.name: Wireless charging tray X position (CPM)
INDUCTIVECHARGING_POSXCPM.description: Sets the X-axis position of the wireless charging tray indicator overlay on the camera/map view, in centimetres relative to the charging position marker (CPM).

INDUCTIVECHARGING_POSYCPM.name: Wireless charging tray Y position (CPM)
INDUCTIVECHARGING_POSYCPM.description: Sets the Y-axis position of the wireless charging tray indicator overlay on the camera/map view, in centimetres relative to the charging position marker.

SPEEDLOCK_SPEEDVALUE_MIN.name: Speed lock: lower speed threshold
SPEEDLOCK_SPEEDVALUE_MIN.description: Sets the speed the car must slow to before the speed locks on the central display are lifted again; at 0 km/h they stay on until the car stops. Keep it below “Speed lock: upper speed threshold” (`3000/147/00111111b`). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SPEEDLOCK_SPEEDVALUE_MAX.name: Speed lock: upper speed threshold
SPEEDLOCK_SPEEDVALUE_MAX.description: Sets the speed above which the speed locks on the central display take effect. They are lifted again once the car slows to “Speed lock: lower speed threshold” (`3000/146/00011111b`). If this value isn't above the lower threshold, the head unit uses the lower threshold plus 1 km/h. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

IONISATOR.name: Air ioniser
IONISATOR.description: Enables the interior air ioniser function in the HMI, providing the control menu for the cabin air ionisation system.

INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_4.name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 4
INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_4.description: Fourth map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay.

INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_5.name: Wireless charging zoom threshold 5
INDUCTIVECHARGING_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_5.description: Fifth map zoom level threshold for the wireless charging tray camera overlay.

FBM_ENT.name: FBM: Entertainment shortcut
FBM_ENT.description: Controls whether the Entertainment shortcut appears in the favorites/function-bar menu (FBM = Favoritenband-Menü). When active, a direct-access button for the audio/entertainment source is shown.

FBM_TEL.name: FBM: Telephone shortcut
FBM_TEL.description: Controls whether the Phone shortcut appears in the favorites/function-bar menu.

FBM_NAVI.name: FBM: Navigation shortcut
FBM_NAVI.description: Controls whether the Navigation shortcut appears in the favorites/function-bar menu.

FBM_IBA.name: FBM: BMW Apps (IBA) shortcut
FBM_IBA.description: Controls whether the BMW Apps (IBA = Integrierte BMW Applikationen) shortcut appears in the favorites bar menu.

FBM_MENUJUMPS.name: FBM: Menu jumps enabled
FBM_MENUJUMPS.description: Enables direct menu-jump shortcuts in the favorites bar, allowing single-press navigation to sub-menus.

FBM_OTHER.name: FBM: Other shortcuts enabled
FBM_OTHER.description: Enables the "Other" catch-all shortcut slot in the favorites/function-bar menu.

FBM_SHORT_INFO.name: FBM: Short info bar visible
FBM_SHORT_INFO.description: Controls display of a condensed information bar (short-info overlay) within the favorites menu context.

FBM_DETAILED_INFO.name: FBM: Detailed info view enabled
FBM_DETAILED_INFO.description: Enables the expanded/detailed-information view in the favorites menu context.

FBM_DEFAULT.name: FBM: Default menu layout active
FBM_DEFAULT.description: Sets the default menu layout mode for the favorites/function-bar; when set, the out-of-box default layout is used.

FBM_SELECTION.name: FBM: Button layout selection
FBM_SELECTION.description: Selects the number of buttons displayed in the function bar/favorites menu. Determines whether 8-button or 6-button layout is used.

RDC.name: Tyre pressure monitor (RDC) fitted
RDC.description: Indicates that a direct tyre-pressure monitoring system (RDC = Reifendruckkontrolle) is installed. Enables the RDC display in the HU. FA-gated by 2VB.

RDC_SAFETY.name: Tyre pressure safety mode
RDC_SAFETY.description: Enables a safety-mode variant of the RDC display (e.g. mandatory pressure warnings).

RPA.name: Run-flat indicator (RPA) fitted
RPA.description: Enables the run-flat / flat-tyre indicator (RPA = Reifenpannenanzeige) in the HU menu. Appears when no RDC sensor ring is installed but a wheel deflation sensor is.

HVAC_INDEPENDENT_AIR.name: Independent air-conditioning mode available
HVAC_INDEPENDENT_AIR.description: Enables the independent auxiliary air-conditioning mode (Standklima) in the climate control menus. FA-gated by 534 (automatic climate control).

HVAC_FOND_ACTIVATION.name: Rear climate control activation
HVAC_FOND_ACTIVATION.description: Activates the rear-seat (fond) climate control zone functionality.

HVAC_INDEPENDENT_HEATING.name: Independent auxiliary heater available
HVAC_INDEPENDENT_HEATING.description: Enables the Zuheizer/Standheizung independent heater mode in climate menus.

HVAC_MSA_EFFICIENCY.name: Climate efficiency display (MSA)
HVAC_MSA_EFFICIENCY.description: Enables efficiency/eco readout related to the MSA (Mehrfachsteuergerät Aussentemperatur / multi-stage aircon) in the climate view.

ASSIST_REMOTE_HVAC.name: Remote climate pre-conditioning
ASSIST_REMOTE_HVAC.description: Enables remote pre-conditioning of the climate system via BMW ConnectedDrive / Assist services.

CTA_FREQUENZ.name: Cross-traffic alert flash rate
CTA_FREQUENZ.description: Sets how fast the cross-traffic alert markers pulse in the parking view on the central display while traffic approaches from the side.

SPEEDLIMIT_INFO.name: Speed limit information display
SPEEDLIMIT_INFO.description: Enables speed limit sign recognition and display in the instrument cluster / HU (requires camera-based KAFAS or map data, FA-gated by 8TH).

AKTIVIERUNG_FONDMONITOR.name: Rear monitor activation method
AKTIVIERUNG_FONDMONITOR.description: Sets how the rear-seat RSE monitor is activated: via a momentary button (TASTER) or latching switch (SCHALTER).

PDC_FLANKENSCHUTZ.name: PDC flank protection (side sensors)
PDC_FLANKENSCHUTZ.description: Enables lateral/flank obstacle detection via PDC side sensors (PMA). FA-gated by 5DP (ParkMaster).

USB_AVAILABLE.name: USB port fitted
USB_AVAILABLE.description: Indicates that USB connectivity is available in this vehicle. Enables USB source selection and charging in the HU. Multiple FA options trigger this.

MACRO_PDC.name: PDC system fitted
MACRO_PDC.description: Master macro flag indicating that a Park Distance Control system (PDC) is installed. Enables PDC display, graphics and audio. FA-gated by 508/5DP/507.

PDC_SENSOR_VORN.name: PDC front sensor count
PDC_SENSOR_VORN.description: Specifies the number of PDC ultrasonic sensors fitted at the front of the vehicle. KEIN_SENSOR = no front sensors.

SETTINGS_INFO_DISPLAY.name: Settings info display available
SETTINGS_INFO_DISPLAY.description: Enables an information/settings display sub-page within the HU settings menu.

BACKDOOR_OPENINGANGLE.name: Powered tailgate opening angle setting
BACKDOOR_OPENINGANGLE.description: Enables adjustment of the maximum opening angle for an electrically-powered tailgate/boot lid.

CAM_ECU.name: Camera module video connection
CAM_ECU.description: Tells the head unit how the camera module's video (rear view, top view and side view cameras) is wired: which video input it arrives on, directly or through an external video switch, and whether the rear-seat screens get it too. For cars with the rear-view camera (S3AG). Set it to match the car's wiring; a mismatch can keep the camera picture from reaching the screen.

NVC.name: Night vision video connection
NVC.description: Tells the head unit how the night vision camera's video is wired: which video input it arrives on and whether the rear-seat screens get it too. Set it to match the car's wiring; a mismatch can keep the night vision picture from reaching the screen.

MMC.name: MMC unit video connection
MMC.description: Tells the head unit how the MMC unit's video is wired: which of the head unit's analog video inputs it uses, directly or through an external video switch. Set it to match the car's equipment; a mismatch can keep its picture from reaching the screens.

TV.name: TV tuner video connection
TV.description: Tells the head unit how the TV tuner's video is wired: which of the head unit's analog video inputs it uses, directly or through an external video switch. Set it to match the car's equipment; a mismatch can keep the TV picture from reaching the screens.

KAFAS.name: Windshield camera (KAFAS) video connection
KAFAS.description: Tells the head unit how video from the camera-based driver assistance unit (KAFAS) behind the windshield is wired into the car's video network. Best left unchanged.

HU_INTERNAL_VIDEO_PLAYBACK.name: Head unit video playback
HU_INTERNAL_VIDEO_PLAYBACK.description: Sets how video from the head unit's own sources (disc, hard drive, USB, browser, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and DMB TV) and its first AUX video input is routed to the screens. With “None”, the head unit has no video route for them. Best left unchanged.

RSE_INTERNAL_VIDEO_PLAYBACK.name: Rear-seat video playback
RSE_INTERNAL_VIDEO_PLAYBACK.description: Sets how video from the rear-seat entertainment system's own sources (its disc drive and USB port) is routed to the screens. With “None”, the head unit has no video route for them. Best left unchanged.

AUX2_IN_RSE.name: AUX input 2 (rear-seat entertainment)
AUX2_IN_RSE.description: Tells the head unit how the second auxiliary (AUX) video input of the rear-seat entertainment system is wired, so its picture can be switched to the rear screens. It reaches the rear screens only, not the central display. With “None”, it has no video route.

AUX3_IN_RSE.name: AUX input 3 (rear-seat entertainment)
AUX3_IN_RSE.description: Tells the head unit how the third auxiliary (AUX) video input of the rear-seat entertainment system is wired, so its picture can be switched to the rear screens. It reaches the rear screens only, not the central display. With “None”, it has no video route.

GATEWAYTABLE.name: CAN gateway routing table selection
GATEWAYTABLE.description: Selects which CAN gateway routing table is loaded for inter-bus message forwarding. Determines which signals are bridged between CAN buses.

MACRO_PMA_EINPARKEN.name: Parking Assistant: park-in version
MACRO_PMA_EINPARKEN.description: Tells the head unit which generation of the Parking Assistant, which steers the car into a parking space, is installed, so the parking screens match it. For cars with the Parking Assistant (S5DP). The two second-generation values differ in whether the parking settings offer the Parking Assistant sound, a signal when a space is found; generation 3 always offers it.

PDC_GENERATION.name: PDC module generation
PDC_GENERATION.description: Tells the head unit which generation of Park Distance Control (PDC) module the car has. With generation 1, the distance display is laid out from the sensor counts in “PDC sensors, front” (`3001/3/00110000b`) and “PDC sensors, rear” (`3001/18/00000110b`); generation 2 does not use the counts. Set it to match the car's hardware.

ICAM2_STRUKTURVERFORMUNG.name: iCam2 structural deformation detection
ICAM2_STRUKTURVERFORMUNG.description: Enables the iCam2 camera structural-deformation detection feature (checks camera mounting integrity). NICHT_AKTIV = not active.

HVAC_FOND_DEFAULT.name: Rear climate control default state
HVAC_FOND_DEFAULT.description: Sets the default on/off state for rear-seat climate control zones at vehicle start-up.

HVAC_ZBF_DUFT.name: Ambient scent/fragrance system (ZBF Duft)
HVAC_ZBF_DUFT.description: Enables the ambient fragrance system control via the climate control HMI (ZBF = Zusatz-Belüftungsfunktion).

KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_UNLOCKGUARD.name: Key config: tailgate unlock guard
KEY_CONF_TAILGATE_UNLOCKGUARD.description: Prevents unintentional remote-key unlocking of the tailgate/boot lid. Controls whether a guard mode is active.

RDC_BELADUNG_DESIGN.name: Tyre load / seating configuration
RDC_BELADUNG_DESIGN.description: Specifies the vehicle seating/load configuration for RDC calibration purposes (e.g. 5-seat vs 7-seat, affects pressure thresholds per axle). 3-bit numeric field; raw values 0-7 observed, no symbolic enum names in firmware.

TVC_WIDTH.name: Top-view camera display width
TVC_WIDTH.description: Sets the top-view/surround-view camera display panel width in pixels. Used to select between narrow (400px), standard (440px), and wide (520px) display variants.

MACRO_NV_C.name: Macro: Night Vision Camera fitted
MACRO_NV_C.description: Master macro flag indicating Night Vision Camera (NVC) is installed. Enables NVC source in HU.

MACRO_TV_C.name: Macro: TV tuner fitted
MACRO_TV_C.description: Master macro flag indicating TV tuner is installed. Enables TV source in HU.

MACRO_RV_C.name: Macro: Rear-view camera fitted
MACRO_RV_C.description: Master macro flag indicating rear-view camera is installed. Enables camera display and PDC overlay. FA-gated by 3AG.

MACRO_SV_C.name: Macro: Side-view camera fitted
MACRO_SV_C.description: Master macro flag indicating a side-view (surround) camera is installed.

MACRO_K_C.name: Macro: Camera system active
MACRO_K_C.description: Master flag enabling the combined camera system (top-view/surround) functions.

SMG.name: Sequential M Gearbox (SMG/DCT) fitted
SMG.description: Indicates a Sequential Manual Gearbox (SMG) or M Double Clutch Transmission (DCT) is installed. Enables DCT/Drivelogic HMI features. FA-gated by 2MK.

ACC_SGN.name: ACC speed limit sign recognition (SGN)
ACC_SGN.description: Enables speed-limit sign-recognition integration with Active Cruise Control (ACC + camera-based sign reading).

ACC_CIC.name: Active Cruise Control (ACC) fitted
ACC_CIC.description: Master flag indicating Active Cruise Control (ACC) is installed, enabling ACC HMI, set-speed display, and related settings. FA-gated by 5DF or type-key.

DCC.name: Dynamic Cruise Control (DCC) fitted
DCC.description: Enables the Dynamic Cruise Control (DCC / Tempomat with braking function) HMI. NICHT_AKTIV = not currently in use despite being FA-gated active.

CTA.name: CTA pedestrian alert fitted
CTA.description: Selects the CTA (Close-range Transit Alarm) acoustic pedestrian-warning variant fitted: rear, or both front and rear.

PDC_ABSTAENDE_VERSION.name: PDC distance display version
PDC_ABSTAENDE_VERSION.description: Selects the PDC graphical distance-bar display version: ALT = legacy/old layout, NEU = current layout.

PDC_DIRECTION.name: PDC graphic orientation
PDC_DIRECTION.description: Sets whether the PDC distance graphic is shown in vertical or horizontal orientation on screen.

HVAC_SEATHEAT_DISTR_FRONT.name: Seat heating distribution: front
HVAC_SEATHEAT_DISTR_FRONT.description: Configures which front seats have seat heating control elements displayed in the climate HMI.

HVAC_SEATHEAT_DISTR_FOND.name: Seat heating distribution: rear
HVAC_SEATHEAT_DISTR_FOND.description: Configures which rear/fond seats have seat heating control elements displayed in the climate HMI.

CLIMATE_ACT_ONE_TIMER.name: Climate one-timer activation
CLIMATE_ACT_ONE_TIMER.description: Enables the single-timer climate pre-conditioning activation (one scheduled start time). NICHT_AKTIV = not fitted.

PDC_SENSOR_HINTEN.name: PDC rear sensor count
PDC_SENSOR_HINTEN.description: Specifies the number of PDC ultrasonic sensors fitted at the rear of the vehicle. KEIN_SENSOR = no sensors.

VIDEO_WATCHDOG_SIDEVIEW.name: Video watchdog: side-view camera
VIDEO_WATCHDOG_SIDEVIEW.description: Enables the video-signal watchdog monitoring for the side-view camera feed. When active, loss of signal triggers an alert/fallback.

VIDEO_WATCHDOG_REARVIEW.name: Video watchdog: rear-view camera
VIDEO_WATCHDOG_REARVIEW.description: Enables the video-signal watchdog monitoring for the rear-view camera feed.

VIDEO_WATCHDOG_TOPVIEW.name: Video watchdog: top-view camera
VIDEO_WATCHDOG_TOPVIEW.description: Enables the video-signal watchdog for the top/surround-view camera feed.

VIDEO_WATCHDOG_NIGHTVISION.name: Video watchdog: night vision camera
VIDEO_WATCHDOG_NIGHTVISION.description: Enables the video-signal watchdog for the night-vision camera feed.

VIDEO_WATCHDOG_KAFAS.name: Video watchdog: KAFAS front camera
VIDEO_WATCHDOG_KAFAS.description: Enables the video-signal watchdog for the KAFAS stereo front-camera feed.

EARLY_VIDEO_LEGALDISCL.name: Early video legal disclaimer state
EARLY_VIDEO_LEGALDISCL.description: Controls whether a legal disclaimer is shown during the early-video (EarlyVideoApp / KAFAS camera) display before the main HMI is ready. INITWERT = initial unset state.

USB_HUB_AVAIL.name: USB hub
USB_HUB_AVAIL.description: Tells the head unit whether a USB hub is connected and to which of its USB ports. “USB charging current limit” (`3001/20/00011100b`) applies to that port. Set at the factory to match Telephony with wireless charging (S6NW).

USB_MAX_CHARGING_CURRENT.name: USB charging current limit
USB_MAX_CHARGING_CURRENT.description: Sets the most current the USB port with the hub (see “USB hub” (`3001/20/00000011b`)) supplies for charging a connected device. The 1500 mA choice supplies 1000 mA. With no hub, or with the port default, port 1 supplies 1000 mA and port 2 supplies 500 mA.

PARK_PRIO.name: Parking priority mode
PARK_PRIO.description: Selects parking-function HMI priority/routing for specific market variants (Korea, India, type-key groups). 2-bit numeric field; no symbolic enum names in firmware.

VEH_DIM_CAR_NET_TO_REAR_X1.name: Car size: reference point to rear
VEH_DIM_CAR_NET_TO_REAR_X1.description: Declares the car's length from its reference point to the rear end.

VEH_DIM_MAX_WIDTH_WITHOUT_WINGMIRROR_W10.name: Car size: width without mirrors
VEH_DIM_MAX_WIDTH_WITHOUT_WINGMIRROR_W10.description: Declares the car's greatest body width, not counting the side mirrors.

VEH_DIM_CAR_NET_TO_FRONT_X2.name: Car size: reference point to front
VEH_DIM_CAR_NET_TO_FRONT_X2.description: Declares the car's length from its reference point to the front end.

VEH_DIM_CAR_NET_TO_REAR_AXIS_X3.name: Car size: reference point to rear axle
VEH_DIM_CAR_NET_TO_REAR_AXIS_X3.description: Declares the distance from the car's reference point to the rear axle.

AUX1_IN_HU.name: AUX input 1 (head unit)
AUX1_IN_HU.description: Video connection for the head unit's first auxiliary (AUX) video input, with the same two choices as “Head unit video playback” (`3001/9/11111111b`): the head unit's internal video input, or none. The picture from this input is routed as set in “Head unit video playback” (`3001/9/11111111b`). Best left unchanged.

MACRO_CAM_LEGALDISCLAIMER.name: Camera legal disclaimer
MACRO_CAM_LEGALDISCLAIMER.description: Sets whether a legal notice appears with the parking camera views and how long it stays: for a short time or permanently. Disclaimer rules vary by country.

MACRO_NIVICAM_LDISCLAIMER.name: Night vision legal disclaimer
MACRO_NIVICAM_LDISCLAIMER.description: Sets whether a legal notice appears with the night vision camera image and how long it stays: for a short time or permanently. Disclaimer rules vary by country.

MACRO_TRAILER_COUPLING.name: Trailer tow hitch
MACRO_TRAILER_COUPLING.description: Enables the head unit's trailer-related functions. Enable it only when the car has a trailer tow hitch (S235).

HVAC_AIRLAMINATION_DRV.name: Air lamination: driver side
HVAC_AIRLAMINATION_DRV.description: Configures driver-side air lamination (directed airflow zones) for the climate system.

HVAC_AIRLAMINATION_CODRV.name: Air lamination: front passenger side
HVAC_AIRLAMINATION_CODRV.description: Configures front-passenger-side air lamination (directed airflow zones). 2-bit numeric field; no symbolic enum names in firmware.

HVAC_AUTOMATIC_INTENSITY.name: Climate automatic intensity control
HVAC_AUTOMATIC_INTENSITY.description: Enables automatic blower/intensity control within the HVAC automatic mode.

HVAC_POPUP_AIRDISTR.name: Climate popup: air distribution
HVAC_POPUP_AIRDISTR.description: Enables the air-distribution control popup/overlay in the climate HMI.

HVAC_CABRIO.name: Convertible (Cabrio) climate mode
HVAC_CABRIO.description: Activates convertible-specific climate-control logic (adapted airflow when roof is open).

HVAC_POPUP_AUTO_TOGGLE.name: Climate popup: AUTO mode toggle
HVAC_POPUP_AUTO_TOGGLE.description: Enables a popup/soft button for toggling the automatic climate mode from within the climate HMI.

HVAC_SEATVENTILATION_FRONT.name: Front seat ventilation available
HVAC_SEATVENTILATION_FRONT.description: Enables front seat ventilation control in the climate HMI.

HVAC_POPUP_SEATCLIMATE.name: Climate popup: seat climate controls
HVAC_POPUP_SEATCLIMATE.description: Enables the seat heating/ventilation popup panel in the climate HMI.

HEADUP_DISPLAY.name: Head-up display (HUD) fitted
HEADUP_DISPLAY.description: Enables head-up display settings and configuration menus in the HU.

AUDIO_REMOTE_CONTROL.name: External audio remote control
AUDIO_REMOTE_CONTROL.description: Enables support for an external audio remote control device connected to the HU.

DOORLOCKING_SEATMEMORY.name: Seat memory on door lock/unlock
DOORLOCKING_SEATMEMORY.description: Enables automatic seat position recall or adjustment linked to door lock/unlock events. FA-gated by 459 (electric seats with memory).

SCHNEEKETTENERKENNUNG.name: Snow chain detection
SCHNEEKETTENERKENNUNG.description: Enables snow chain detection logic in the vehicle dynamics system; affects HU warning display.

DWA.name: Alarm system (DWA) fitted
DWA.description: Indicates that the anti-theft alarm system (DWA = Diebstahl-Warn-Anlage) is installed. FA-gated by 302.

DISPLAY_VARIANTE.name: Display type variant
DISPLAY_VARIANTE.description: Identifies the physical display type installed: narrow/standard, wide, flap (motorised) or narrow flap. Affects display initialisation and aspect-ratio handling.

LEGAL_DISCLAIMER_TIME.name: Legal disclaimer display
LEGAL_DISCLAIMER_TIME.description: Sets whether a legal notice is shown on the central display and how long it stays: for a short time or permanently. “Camera legal disclaimer” (`3001/52/11111111b`) and “Night vision legal disclaimer” (`3001/53/11111111b`) cover those notices. Disclaimer rules vary by country.

CAMERA_SYSTEM.name: Camera system type
CAMERA_SYSTEM.description: Selects the type of camera system installed: none, top-view service camera, iCam standard rear-view, iCam high-end, iCam2 standard, or iCam2 high-end.

STARTUP_TYPE.name: Boot screen type
STARTUP_TYPE.description: Selects the style of boot/startup screen: black screen, static splash image, animation, or power-welcome animation.

STARTUP_EMBLEM.name: Startup emblem
STARTUP_EMBLEM.description: Picks the brand emblem the central display shows at startup, as a still image, animation or welcome sequence (see “Startup screen” (`3001/62/00000110b`)). A value that lists screen sizes has artwork only for those; on other screens the ConnectedDrive emblem shows instead. As a still image on the wider screens, some emblems show only their background, without the logo.

PDC_3D.name: PDC 3D graphics mode
PDC_3D.description: Enables the 3D visualisation mode for the park-distance control display instead of the flat 2D bar graphic.

DMB.name: Digital Multimedia Broadcasting (DMB) variant
DMB.description: Identifies the DMB (Korean/Asian digital TV) tuner ECU variant. 0xFF = not fitted. FA-gated by 601 (TV) or 802 (Korea).

ACTIVE_PDC_FLANKENBREMSUNG.name: Active PDC: flank braking
ACTIVE_PDC_FLANKENBREMSUNG.description: Enables automatic flank/side braking intervention by the Active PDC system to avoid lateral collisions.

ACTIVE_PDC_DEFAULT_ON.name: Active PDC: default on
ACTIVE_PDC_DEFAULT_ON.description: Sets Active PDC to be automatically enabled by default at vehicle start (instead of requiring manual activation).

EIN_AUSTIEGSHILFE_FA_SITZ.name: Exit-assist: driver seat
EIN_AUSTIEGSHILFE_FA_SITZ.description: Enables the automatic seat exit-assist function for the driver seat (seat moves back on door open / key out).

ACTIVE_PDC.name: Active PDC fitted
ACTIVE_PDC.description: Master flag for Active PDC (automated braking assistance during parking). Enables Active PDC HMI and system activation.

TSM.name: Trailer Stability Management (TSM)
TSM.description: Enables Trailer Stability Management in the HU menus (caravanning/towing stability control).

ICAM_PBA.name: iCam: Panoramic Back-view Assist (PBA)
ICAM_PBA.description: Enables panoramic back-view assist functionality using the iCam rear camera system.

ICAM_SBA.name: iCam: Side-view Back-view Assist (SBA)
ICAM_SBA.description: Enables side-view back-view assist functionality using the iCam system.

ICAM2_CAMERA_SELECTOR.name: iCam2 camera selector
ICAM2_CAMERA_SELECTOR.description: Enables the camera source selector for iCam2 multi-camera configurations.

ICAM2_HELLIGKEIT_KONTRAST.name: iCam2 brightness/contrast adjustment
ICAM2_HELLIGKEIT_KONTRAST.description: Enables user-adjustable brightness and contrast settings for the iCam2 camera display.

COMMUNICATION_PARKMASTER.name: Parking module interface
COMMUNICATION_PARKMASTER.description: Tells the head unit which generation of parking module the car has, so the parking view on the central display opens and closes when that module asks. With “None”, the head unit does not respond to a parking module. Set it to match the car's parking hardware.

VSG_HMI_MENUE.name: Speed governor (VSG) HMI menu
VSG_HMI_MENUE.description: Enables the vehicle speed governor (VSG) settings menu in the HU.

AUTO_PDC.name: PDC automatic activation
AUTO_PDC.description: Enables automatic activation of PDC when reverse gear is engaged or at slow speed. NICHT_AKTIV = manual activation only. FA-gated by 5DP.

RDC_FORTSCHRITTSANZEIGE.name: RDC reset progress indicator
RDC_FORTSCHRITTSANZEIGE.description: Enables a progress bar / status indicator during the tyre-pressure monitor reset procedure. FA-gated by 2VB.

REIFENUEBERWACHUNG_RDC_RPA.name: Tyre monitoring type selection (RDC/RPA)
REIFENUEBERWACHUNG_RDC_RPA.description: Selects the active tyre monitoring technology: direct pressure sensor (RDC), flat-tyre indicator (RPA), or none.

RDC_DRUCK_TEMP.name: Tire pressure display values
RDC_DRUCK_TEMP.description: Sets what the tire pressure display shows for each tire: the pressure, or the pressure and the tire temperature.

SPA_CHECKBOX.name: Transmission sport mode checkbox (SPA)
SPA_CHECKBOX.description: Enables a sport/steptronic mode toggle checkbox in the driving settings HMI. Shown on non-automatic/non-sport-transmission variants.

REARVIEW_REGULATION.name: Rearview camera regulatory compliance mode
REARVIEW_REGULATION.description: Enables a regulatory/compliance mode for the rear-view camera display (e.g. mandatory display rules in certain markets).

PDC_DARSTELLUNG_V2.name: PDC display version 2
PDC_DARSTELLUNG_V2.description: Selects the V2 (second generation) graphical layout for the PDC distance display.

HVAC_ZBF_SYNC.name: HVAC zone synchronisation (ZBF Sync)
HVAC_ZBF_SYNC.description: Enables synchronisation of climate zones (driver = passenger) for the Zuheizer/ZBF system.

HVAC_ZBF_AUC.name: HVAC: Automatic air recirculation (AUC)
HVAC_ZBF_AUC.description: Enables automatic recirculation control in the Zuheizer/ZBF auxiliary climate system.

HVAC_ZBF_ACTIVATION_FRT.name: HVAC ZBF activation: front seat side
HVAC_ZBF_ACTIVATION_FRT.description: Configures which front seat activates the ZBF (Zusatz-Belüftungsfunktion) auxiliary climate: driver side, passenger side, or both.

HVAC_ZBF_ACTIVATION_2TIR.name: HVAC ZBF activation: 2-door activation
HVAC_ZBF_ACTIVATION_2TIR.description: Enables ZBF auxiliary climate activation via the 2nd door (2TIR). Relevant for vehicles where rear-door opening triggers climate.

HVAC_ZBF_3TIR.name: HVAC ZBF: 3-door / 3rd row
HVAC_ZBF_3TIR.description: Enables ZBF auxiliary climate function for a 3rd row or 3rd door zone.

HVAC_ZBF_DEFAULT_2TIR.name: HVAC ZBF: 2-door default state
HVAC_ZBF_DEFAULT_2TIR.description: Sets the default activation state for the 2-door ZBF auxiliary climate zone.

BACKDOOR_SMO_INSTALLED.name: Electric tailgate (SMO) fitted
BACKDOOR_SMO_INSTALLED.description: Indicates that an electrically-powered tailgate/boot lid (SMO = Schließmechanismus Öffnung) is installed. NICHT_AKTIV = no electric tailgate.

BACKDOOR_SETTING_LIDS.name: Tailgate lid configuration
BACKDOOR_SETTING_LIDS.description: Configures which tailgate lid(s) are present and adjustable: upper lid only, or both upper and lower (split tailgate).

BACKDOOR_OPENINGANGLE_STEPS.name: Tailgate opening angle step count
BACKDOOR_OPENINGANGLE_STEPS.description: Sets the number of programmable opening-angle stop positions for the electrically-powered tailgate. 3-bit numeric field; observed raw values 0, 1, 2 — no symbolic enum names in firmware.

RADIO_COUNTRY.name: Radio country/region
RADIO_COUNTRY.description: Selects the radio regulatory region for the tuner. Determines frequency ranges, channel spacing, and reception standards applicable to the market.

FM_DEEMPHASIS.name: FM de-emphasis
FM_DEEMPHASIS.description: Configures the FM tuner de-emphasis time constant. 50 µs is standard for Europe/Australia; 75 µs is used in the US/Japan. Affects high-frequency reproduction of FM audio.

AF_FUNKTION.name: AF (Alternative Frequency) function
AF_FUNKTION.description: Enables or disables RDS Alternative Frequency following, allowing the tuner to switch to a stronger transmitter carrying the same programme.

TIME_LAG_IMG.name: Audio timing delay IMG
TIME_LAG_IMG.description: Internal timing delay for the audio system. Best left unchanged.

TIME_LAG_IDG.name: Audio timing delay IDG
TIME_LAG_IDG.description: Internal timing delay for the audio system. Best left unchanged.

TIME_DIST_SAME_PRIO.name: Minimum gap between equal-priority chimes
TIME_DIST_SAME_PRIO.description: Sets how long the head unit waits after playing a chime before it plays another chime of the same priority; one that comes sooner isn't played. Best left unchanged.

TIME_OUT_GONG.name: Chime timeout
TIME_OUT_GONG.description: Longest time a continuous chime keeps sounding without a new request from the module that asked for it. Best left unchanged.

VOL_MAX_ON.name: Switch-on volume limit
VOL_MAX_ON.description: When the audio system switches on, a volume left above this level is lowered to it, so it doesn't start too loud. The level is a step on the head unit's volume scale.

RSE_MAX_VOLUME_ON.name: Rear-seat switch-on volume limit
RSE_MAX_VOLUME_ON.description: When the rear-seat entertainment switches on, a rear volume left above this level is lowered to it, so it doesn't start too loud. The level is a step on the rear volume scale. Only relevant with rear-seat entertainment.

RSE_MAX_VOLUME_STEP.name: Rear-seat volume limits
RSE_MAX_VOLUME_STEP.description: Sets two limits for the rear-seat entertainment volume: the top of its volume scale and the lower maximum used in the child ear-protection mode. Best left unchanged.

RDS_FUNCTION.name: RDS function enable
RDS_FUNCTION.description: Enables or disables Radio Data System (RDS) reception and display (station name, programme type, AF, TP/TA announcements).

SDARS_ALBUM_COVER.name: SiriusXM album cover art display
SDARS_ALBUM_COVER.description: Enables display of album cover art from the SiriusXM (SDARS) satellite radio stream on the head-unit screen.

RSE_180_DEGREES_EARPHONE.name: RSE headphone 180-degree audio rotation
RSE_180_DEGREES_EARPHONE.description: Rotates headphone audio channels 180 degrees for RSE rear-seat headphones (e.g. when headphones are worn inverted or mounted differently). Inactive on cars without RSE.

SDARS_SMART_FAVORITES.name: SiriusXM Smart Favourites
SDARS_SMART_FAVORITES.description: Enables the SiriusXM Smart Favourites feature, which allows the tuner to automatically track and buffer multiple favourite satellite channels simultaneously for instant channel switching.

BIN_DISABLE_AUDIO_BUTTON.name: Disable audio/entertainment menu button
BIN_DISABLE_AUDIO_BUTTON.description: When active, disables the dedicated audio/entertainment hard button in the iDrive menu. Typically applied on vehicles with integrated TV or professional navigation where audio is accessed differently.

RDS_CHARACTER_SET.name: RDS character set
RDS_CHARACTER_SET.description: Selects the character encoding used to decode RDS text. Default uses the standard Latin character set; the Chinese variant enables Chinese character decoding for Chinese-market vehicles.

SDARS_FAVORITE_ALERT_POPUP.name: SiriusXM favourite alert popup
SDARS_FAVORITE_ALERT_POPUP.description: Enables an on-screen popup notification when a previously favourited SiriusXM artist or song begins playing on any channel.

PARTITION_WALL.name: Partition wall (limousine divider)
PARTITION_WALL.description: Indicates presence of a dividing partition wall between front and rear compartments (long-wheelbase limousine variants). Affects audio routing and RSE behaviour.

TIME_LAG_IMG_LONG.name: Audio timing delay IMG, long
TIME_LAG_IMG_LONG.description: Internal long timing delay for the audio system. Best left unchanged.

TIME_LAG_IDG_LONG.name: Audio timing delay IDG, long
TIME_LAG_IDG_LONG.description: Internal long timing delay for the audio system. Best left unchanged.

UPDATE_MIXER_LEVEL.name: Audio mixer level updates
UPDATE_MIXER_LEVEL.description: Internal setting for how the audio mixer updates its levels when sources change. Only the standard setting is offered. Best left unchanged.

AUDIO_SYSTEM_VAR.name: Audio system variant
AUDIO_SYSTEM_VAR.description: Selects the audio system hardware variant profile used by the head unit for internal audio processing and routing. Typically set by production to match the installed amplifier/speaker configuration.

ANZEIGE_FREQ.name: Frequency display (US radio)
ANZEIGE_FREQ.description: Enables the alternate frequency display format used in US radio markets (e.g. displaying FM frequencies in different step increments). Active only with US radio control option 645.

RADIO_SDARS.name: SiriusXM antenna diagnostics
RADIO_SDARS.description: Configures satellite tuner antenna diagnostics mode. ANTDIAG enables active antenna diagnostics; KEIN_ANTDIAG disables them.

REVERSE_GONG.name: Reverse gear gong
REVERSE_GONG.description: Enables or disables the audible chime played when reverse gear is engaged.

STORE_EQ_DATA.name: Store equalizer data
STORE_EQ_DATA.description: Enables persistent storage of user equalizer settings to non-volatile memory. When disabled, EQ settings are not retained across ignition cycles.

EWS_KOREA.name: Emergency Warning System — Korea (EWS)
EWS_KOREA.description: Enables the Korean Emergency Warning System (EWS) broadcast reception and alert functionality in the radio tuner.

FBM_SEATMEMORY.name: Front-seat memory (FBM) audio profile recall
FBM_SEATMEMORY.description: Controls whether the audio system is linked to the seat memory (FBM) profile recall. When set, audio source/volume settings are restored together with the seat memory position.

MUTE_PIN.name: External audio mute pin function
MUTE_PIN.description: Configures the function of the external mute pin on the audio hardware. Can be set to mute entertainment audio, or act as a mono or stereo auxiliary input trigger.

MICROPHONE_POSITION.name: Microphone position
MICROPHONE_POSITION.description: Selects which physical microphone position/mounting variant is used in this vehicle. Affects the audio processing chain for voice recognition and telephony.

MICROPHONE_PARAMETER.name: Microphone parameter set
MICROPHONE_PARAMETER.description: Selects the microphone parameter/calibration profile. Numeric value matching the installed microphone hardware characteristics.

TLAM_VOLUME.name: TLAM volume processing
TLAM_VOLUME.description: Turns on the volume-dependent part of the TLAM audio processing. Best left unchanged.

AUDIO_PROFILE.name: Audio tuner profile
AUDIO_PROFILE.description: Selects the audio tuner processing profile variant. Affects internal signal-processing parameters for the radio tuner.

SOUND_SIGNAL_SET.name: Chime sound set
SOUND_SIGNAL_SET.description: Chooses which brand's set of chimes and signal tones the head unit plays: BMW, MINI, Rolls-Royce, BMW i or the Toyota Supra. Set it to match the car's brand.

REFERENCE_CHANNEL_TEL.name: Telephone reference channel enable
REFERENCE_CHANNEL_TEL.description: Enables a dedicated audio reference channel for telephone calls, used for echo cancellation and noise reduction calibration.

REFERENCE_CHANNEL_TEL_MODE.name: Telephone reference channel mode
REFERENCE_CHANNEL_TEL_MODE.description: Selects the operating mode for the telephone reference audio channel (echo cancellation/noise reduction mode variant).

SDARS_TAGGING.name: SiriusXM song tagging
SDARS_TAGGING.description: Enables SiriusXM song tagging, allowing users to tag currently playing songs for later purchase/identification via iTunes or similar services.

SDARS_ALBUM_ART.name: SiriusXM album art display
SDARS_ALBUM_ART.description: Enables display of full album artwork from the SiriusXM satellite radio stream. Distinct from SDARS_ALBUM_COVER which controls cover-art thumbnail.

TV_DIVERSITY.name: TV antenna diversity
TV_DIVERSITY.description: Enables antenna diversity for the TV tuner, switching between multiple antennas to maintain the best TV reception. Inactive on cars without TV tuner.

SDARS_TUNE_START.name: SiriusXM Tune Start
SDARS_TUNE_START.description: Enables the SiriusXM Tune Start feature, which replays the beginning of the current song when switching to a channel that is mid-song.

RADIO_IBOC.name: IBOC (HD Radio) enable
RADIO_IBOC.description: Enables In-Band On-Channel (IBOC) digital radio reception, known commercially as HD Radio. Allows the tuner to receive the digital HD Radio signal on standard AM/FM frequencies. Active on vehicles with US-market type keys.

CHECKBOX_TP.name: Traffic programme (TP) checkbox
CHECKBOX_TP.description: Enables the TP (Traffic Programme) RDS filter checkbox in the tuner UI, allowing the user to restrict station seek to traffic-information-broadcasting stations only.

RADIO_WEATHERBAND.name: Weather Band radio
RADIO_WEATHERBAND.description: Enables the NOAA Weather Band radio tuner band (162.400–162.550 MHz), used in North America for weather broadcasts.

RADIO_DAB.name: DAB digital radio enable
RADIO_DAB.description: Enables DAB (Digital Audio Broadcasting) digital radio reception. Active on vehicles equipped with DAB tuner (option 654) or certain market configurations.

DAB_STANDARD.name: DAB standard/mode
DAB_STANDARD.description: Selects the Digital Audio Broadcasting standard supported by the tuner. Determines which DAB variants (DAB, DAB+, DMB-Audio, DMB-Video) are enabled.

RADIO_DAB_VARIANTEN.name: DAB tuner hardware layout
RADIO_DAB_VARIANTEN.description: Tells the head unit which DAB tuner hardware layout is installed. Only the dual-tuner layout is offered. Best left unchanged.

HMI_FUER_DAB_DMB.name: DAB/DMB HMI display mode
HMI_FUER_DAB_DMB.description: Controls whether the DAB/DMB source is displayed as a radio station (DAB radio) or as a TV source (DMB replacing TV) in the HMI menus.

AUDIO_SYSTEM.name: Sound system type
AUDIO_SYSTEM.description: Tells the head unit which sound system is installed, from the base stereo up to the premium systems. Set it to match the car's speakers and amplifier. The factory sets it from the HiFi loudspeaker system (S676).

AMPLIFIER_VARIANT.name: Amplifier type
AMPLIFIER_VARIANT.description: Tells the head unit which amplifier drives the speakers: its own built-in amplifier, a separate external amplifier or an external amplifier on the car's fiber-optic (MOST) network. Set it to match the car's audio hardware. The factory sets it from the HiFi loudspeaker system (S676) or Harman Kardon HiFi system (S674).

MULTICHANNEL.name: Multichannel audio enable
MULTICHANNEL.description: Enables multichannel (surround) audio processing. When active, the head unit routes audio through a multi-channel amplifier/speaker configuration rather than standard stereo.

AUTOSTORE_ANALOG.name: Automatic analogue station store
AUTOSTORE_ANALOG.description: Enables automatic storing of the strongest analogue (AM/FM) stations to presets. When active, the tuner automatically populates preset memory with the best-received stations.

DAB_FOLLOWING_CHECKB_HMI.name: DAB following HMI checkbox
DAB_FOLLOWING_CHECKB_HMI.description: Shows or hides the DAB-following (DAB→FM fallback) checkbox option in the tuner HMI. When shown, the user can enable/disable DAB→FM following from the radio settings menu.

TLAM_KENNFELD.name: TLAM audio characteristic map
TLAM_KENNFELD.description: Selects one of twelve built-in characteristic maps for the TLAM stage of the audio processing, which works with loudness and volume. Best left unchanged.

EQ_VARIANT.name: Sound tuning set
EQ_VARIANT.description: Picks which of up to eight factory sound tunings the head unit loads for its audio output, such as equalizer, gain and limiter settings. Tunings exist per model series and coded sound system; if the chosen one is missing for that combination, the head unit uses the default tuning for its amplifier type.

SDARS_EPG.name: SiriusXM Electronic Programme Guide (EPG)
SDARS_EPG.description: Enables the SiriusXM Electronic Programme Guide, which displays current and upcoming programme schedules for satellite radio channels.

SDARS_FEATURED_FAVORITES.name: SiriusXM Featured Favorites
SDARS_FEATURED_FAVORITES.description: Turns on SiriusXM Featured Favorites: themed sets of channels that SiriusXM sends over the air, which the radio can offer alongside your own presets. For cars with a satellite tuner (S655).

SDARS_STATUS_SUBSCRIP_NOTIFI.name: SiriusXM subscription status notification
SDARS_STATUS_SUBSCRIP_NOTIFI.description: Enables display of SiriusXM subscription status and renewal notifications on the head-unit screen.

RADIO_BAND_MW.name: Medium-wave (AM) radio band enable
RADIO_BAND_MW.description: Enables the Medium Wave (MW/AM) radio band in the tuner. When disabled, the AM broadcast band is not available for manual or seek tuning.

RADIO_BAND_KW.name: Shortwave band (SW)
RADIO_BAND_KW.description: Makes the shortwave (SW) band available in the radio, alongside FM and AM. Set per market at the factory.

DAB_SLIDESHOW_TIMEOUT.name: DAB slideshow image timeout
DAB_SLIDESHOW_TIMEOUT.description: Sets the auto-timeout for DAB slideshow images displayed on screen. When set to OFF, slideshow images are displayed indefinitely until the next image arrives.

VOLUME_POPUP_DISPLAY.name: On-screen volume pop-up
VOLUME_POPUP_DISPLAY.description: Shows a pop-up on the central display when you change the volume. Disabled at the factory with Switch off volume pop-up (SVPOF).

VOLUME_POPUP_REJECTION.name: Volume popup suppression
VOLUME_POPUP_REJECTION.description: When active, suppresses (rejects) the volume popup display even if VOLUME_POPUP_DISPLAY is enabled. Acts as an override to disable the popup.

VOLUME_POPUP_EXCEPTION.name: Volume popup exception
VOLUME_POPUP_EXCEPTION.description: Enables an exception to the volume popup suppression rule, allowing the popup to appear in specific defined circumstances even when normally suppressed.

USB_BULK_TRANSFER.name: USB bulk transfer mode
USB_BULK_TRANSFER.description: Enables USB bulk transfer mode for media devices. When active, data transfers from USB media devices use bulk transfer protocol rather than interrupt-driven transfers.

DAB_LAENDERVARIANTEN.name: DAB regional variant
DAB_LAENDERVARIANTEN.description: Selects the regional/country-specific DAB configuration variant. Determines country-specific frequency plans, channel lists, and features for the DAB tuner.

FOLLOWING_DAB_FM.name: DAB→FM following enable
FOLLOWING_DAB_FM.description: Enables automatic fallback from DAB to FM reception when the DAB signal is lost. The system switches to the corresponding FM frequency to maintain uninterrupted listening.

DAB_DABFOLLOWING.name: DAB→DAB service following enable
DAB_DABFOLLOWING.description: Enables DAB-to-DAB service following, allowing the tuner to follow a DAB service (station) across different DAB ensembles/multiplexes when the signal quality of the current ensemble degrades.

DAB_BAND.name: DAB frequency band selection
DAB_BAND.description: Selects which DAB frequency bands the tuner scans and receives. Band III (174–240 MHz) is standard for Europe; Band L (1452–1492 MHz) is less common.

DMB_MAX_FRAMERATE.name: DMB video maximum frame rate
DMB_MAX_FRAMERATE.description: Limits the maximum frame rate for DMB (Digital Multimedia Broadcasting) video decoding. Lower frame rates reduce processing load; higher values allow smoother video.

DAB_SLIDESHOW.name: DAB slideshow enable
DAB_SLIDESHOW.description: Enables the DAB slideshow feature, which displays images broadcast alongside DAB radio stations (DAB Slideshow/DLS data service).

DAB_JOURNALINE.name: DAB Journaline text service enable
DAB_JOURNALINE.description: Enables the DAB Journaline data service, which provides text-based news, sports, weather, and programme information alongside DAB broadcasts.

AUDIO_OFFSET.name: Telephony audio offset enable
AUDIO_OFFSET.description: Enables an audio level offset applied to telephone calls, compensating for level differences between the telephony audio channel and entertainment audio.

DAB_ANNOUNCEMENTS.name: DAB traffic announcements mode
DAB_ANNOUNCEMENTS.description: Configures which DAB traffic announcements trigger audio interruption. Can be restricted to traffic-only or include all announcement types.

MICROPHONE_NUMBER.name: Number of microphones
MICROPHONE_NUMBER.description: Specifies the number of microphone channels installed in the vehicle. Affects voice recognition and telephony processing.

DAB_EPG.name: DAB Electronic Programme Guide (EPG) view
DAB_EPG.description: Selects the EPG display format for DAB radio. Determines whether the programme guide shows now/next only, or includes a full day view with programme details.

DAB_HMI_LIST_VIEW.name: DAB station list checkbox display
DAB_HMI_LIST_VIEW.description: Controls how the station-selection checkbox is displayed in the DAB station list HMI. Can show checkbox in on or off state, or hide it entirely.

AM_FM_HMI_LIST_VIEW.name: AM/FM station list checkbox display
AM_FM_HMI_LIST_VIEW.description: Controls how the station-selection checkbox is displayed in the AM/FM station list HMI.

TV_HMI_LIST_VIEW.name: TV channel list checkbox display
TV_HMI_LIST_VIEW.description: Controls how the channel-selection checkbox is displayed in the TV channel list HMI.

SDARS_HMI_LIST_VIEW.name: SiriusXM channel list checkbox display
SDARS_HMI_LIST_VIEW.description: Controls how the channel-selection checkbox is displayed in the SiriusXM satellite radio channel list HMI.

CDMM_TV_CA_ID_MENUE.name: TV CA (conditional access) ID menu
CDMM_TV_CA_ID_MENUE.description: Enables the conditional access ID menu in the TV tuner interface (CDMM = Conditional Access/Digital Media Management), used to display or configure pay-TV smart card/module information.

A4A_ANDROID.name: Smartphone apps: Android phones
A4A_ANDROID.description: Lets Android phones use the head unit's smartphone apps connection, so supported apps on the phone work through iDrive. Enabled at the factory with Apps or TeleServices (S6NR or S6AE).

HEAD_BOOT_UP_TIMEOUT.name: Phone connection delay at startup
HEAD_BOOT_UP_TIMEOUT.description: Sets how long the head unit may hold back the Bluetooth hands-free connection to a phone while it starts up; the phone connects once startup is done or the time is up. When disabled, the phone connects right away.

CDMM_GLOBAL_COVER.name: CDMM global cover (USB/iPod metadata cover art)
CDMM_GLOBAL_COVER.description: Enables global cover-art fetching in the CDMM (Content Device Media Manager) for USB and iPod sources. When active, album artwork is retrieved and displayed for all sources.

CBS_MOBIGUAR_LIFELONG.name: CBS lifelong service interval (MobiGuard)
CBS_MOBIGUAR_LIFELONG.description: Enables Condition Based Service (CBS) integration with MobiGuard for lifelong/permanent service interval tracking via the telematics connection.

RSE_SERVICE_MESSAGES.name: RSE service messages
RSE_SERVICE_MESSAGES.description: Enables display of service/reminder messages on the rear-seat entertainment (RSE) screens.

VANITY_DIALING.name: Vanity (alpha) dialling
VANITY_DIALING.description: Enables vanity (letter-to-digit) dialling on the phone keypad, allowing the user to enter alphanumeric phone numbers (e.g. 1-800-BMW-CALL). Active on Canadian-spec vehicles.

SPEECH_2_TEXT.name: Speech-to-text input
SPEECH_2_TEXT.description: Enables voice-dictation / speech-to-text conversion for composing messages or other text fields. Requires 6NL Bluetooth+USB+BMW Assist option.

CDMM_USB_POD_BOOK.name: USB/iPod phonebook (CDMM pod book)
CDMM_USB_POD_BOOK.description: Enables CDMM phonebook synchronisation over USB/iPod. When active, the head unit can read contacts stored on a connected iPod or USB device.

TIMESTAMP_DISPLAY.name: Message timestamp display
TIMESTAMP_DISPLAY.description: Enables display of timestamps on received messages (SMS, email) in the PIM/phone message list.

NEW_TALKING_HEAD_CONCEPT.name: New talking-head UI concept
NEW_TALKING_HEAD_CONCEPT.description: Enables the updated 'talking head' graphical concept for the Bluetooth/phone call screen, showing an animated graphic during calls.

A4A_WIRELESS_IOS.name: Wireless CarPlay / iOS wireless A4A
A4A_WIRELESS_IOS.description: Enables wireless Apple CarPlay (A4A — Apps for Automobile, iOS) over Wi-Fi. When off, only wired USB CarPlay is available.

A4A_WIRELESS_ANDROID.name: Wireless Android Auto / Android wireless A4A
A4A_WIRELESS_ANDROID.description: Enables wireless Android Auto (A4A — Apps for Automobile, Android) over Wi-Fi. When off, only wired USB Android Auto is available.

API_TYPE.name: A4A/smartphone integration API type
API_TYPE.description: Selects which smartphone integration API protocol the head unit exposes on the USB port. NONE disables the API; NBT = standard NBT protocol; ENTRY_NAV_MEDIA = Entry/Entry-Nav media-only subset.

API_MTP_EIN_AUS.name: MTP USB device mode enable
API_MTP_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the MTP (Media Transfer Protocol) USB mode, allowing the head unit to access media files on Android devices connected via USB.

API_IPOD_EIN_AUS.name: iPod USB device mode enable
API_IPOD_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the iPod/iPhone accessory protocol (iAP) over USB, allowing the head unit to control and browse an iPod/iPhone connected via USB cable.

DEBUG_HCI_TRACE_EIN_AUS.name: Bluetooth HCI debug trace enable
DEBUG_HCI_TRACE_EIN_AUS.description: Enables debug-level HCI (Host Controller Interface) trace logging for the Bluetooth stack. Intended for workshop/engineering diagnosis; has no user-visible effect under normal use.

AUDIO_PLAYER_ON_OFF.name: Bluetooth audio player (A2DP)
AUDIO_PLAYER_ON_OFF.description: Enables the A2DP Bluetooth audio player, allowing high-quality stereo audio streaming from a connected Bluetooth device to the vehicle audio system.

DUN_PROFILE.name: Bluetooth DUN profile (dial-up networking)
DUN_PROFILE.description: Enables the Bluetooth DUN (Dial-Up Networking) profile, allowing the head unit to use a paired phone's mobile data connection. Mostly legacy.

PAN_PROFILE.name: Bluetooth PAN profile (personal area network)
PAN_PROFILE.description: Enables the Bluetooth PAN (Personal Area Network) profile, allowing IP networking over Bluetooth between the head unit and a paired phone.

CE_DEVICE_SPEECH_RECOGNITION.name: Smartphone voice recognition passthrough
CE_DEVICE_SPEECH_RECOGNITION.description: Enables use of the connected smartphone's own voice recognition (e.g. Siri, Google Assistant) triggered from the vehicle. The voice command is passed through to the CE (consumer electronics) device rather than processed locally.

TWO_PHONES_PARALLEL.name: Two phones simultaneously (dual HFP)
TWO_PHONES_PARALLEL.description: Enables simultaneous connection of two phones via Bluetooth, allowing both to be active for calls and audio at the same time. Requires 6NK/6NL/6NS/6NW telephony options.

TELEMATIC_ECU.name: Telematics ECU type
TELEMATIC_ECU.description: Specifies which telematics control unit is fitted. Selects between TCB (Telematics Communication Box), TPL (Telematics Platform), or ATM (Advanced Telematics Module) variants to match installed hardware.

PHONE_TYPE.name: Phone type
PHONE_TYPE.description: Specifies the type of telephone hardware present or expected. NO_PHONE means no integrated phone module; INTERNAL_PHONE indicates a built-in cellular module (rare, legacy fitment).

PHONE_RSE.name: Phone in rear-seat entertainment (RSE)
PHONE_RSE.description: Enables phone/telephony controls and display on the rear-seat entertainment screens, allowing rear passengers to view and potentially control calls.

PHONE_MPC.name: Phone MPC integration
PHONE_MPC.description: Enables the phone module integration with MPC (Multi Purpose Controller / multimedia head unit controller). Controls whether the phone application is accessible via the MPC interface.

PHONE_OBJPUSH_MENUE.name: Bluetooth object push menu (OPP)
PHONE_OBJPUSH_MENUE.description: Enables the Bluetooth OPP (Object Push Profile) menu, allowing files such as contacts (vCard) or images to be exchanged between the head unit and a paired phone via Bluetooth.

PHONE_CONFERENCE_CALL.name: Phone conference call
PHONE_CONFERENCE_CALL.description: Enables the ability to merge active and held calls into a three-way conference call via the hands-free phone interface.

PHONE_RESPONSE_HOLD.name: Phone answer/hold function
PHONE_RESPONSE_HOLD.description: Enables the ability to place an active call on hold and answer a second incoming call (call waiting with hold), or to swap between two calls.

PHONEBOOK_NAME_DISPL_ORD.name: Phonebook name display order
PHONEBOOK_NAME_DISPL_ORD.description: Sets the display order for contact names in the phonebook. Active on English-speaking markets (UK, Australia, Gulf, Canada) where first-name-first is conventional.

PHONEBOOK_NAME_ORD.name: Phonebook sort order
PHONEBOOK_NAME_ORD.description: Sets the sort order for contacts in the phonebook list. Controls whether the phonebook is sorted alphabetically by last name or first name.

MICROPHONE_SENSITIVITY.name: Microphone sensitivity level
MICROPHONE_SENSITIVITY.description: Selects the hands-free microphone sensitivity level: L4 (standard sensitivity) or L6 (higher sensitivity) to match the installed microphone hardware.

PIM_AUDIO_RECORDING_LENGTH.name: Voice memo maximum length
PIM_AUDIO_RECORDING_LENGTH.description: Sets the longest voice memo you can record in the Office menu. When disabled, a recording stops as soon as it starts.

ADRESSBOOK.name: Address book enable
ADRESSBOOK.description: Enables the address book / contacts application in the phone menu, allowing the head unit to display and dial contacts downloaded from a paired Bluetooth phone.

BT_MODUL_ON_OFF.name: Bluetooth module enable
BT_MODUL_ON_OFF.description: Master enable for the Bluetooth hardware module. When off, all Bluetooth functionality (phone, audio streaming, OPP) is disabled.

UNIFIED_CALL_LISTS.name: Unified call lists (merged call history)
UNIFIED_CALL_LISTS.description: Enables a single merged call history list combining call logs from all paired phones, rather than showing a separate list per device.

INBAND_RINGING.name: In-band ringtone
INBAND_RINGING.description: Plays the phone's own ringtone through the car speakers for incoming calls, when the phone sends it over the Bluetooth hands-free link. When disabled, the car plays its own ringtone instead.

CONTACTS_DOWNLOAD_ONLY_WHEN_DATA_CHANGED.name: Download contacts only when data changed
CONTACTS_DOWNLOAD_ONLY_WHEN_DATA_CHANGED.description: Optimises phonebook synchronisation by only downloading contacts from the phone when a change is detected, reducing sync time after initial download.

CONTACTS_FROM_ONLINE_SOURCE.name: Contacts from online source
CONTACTS_FROM_ONLINE_SOURCE.description: Enables retrieval of contacts/phonebook data from an online/cloud source (e.g. BMW ConnectedDrive or synced contacts service) in addition to or instead of the locally paired phone.

USB_OOB_BT_PAIRING.name: USB out-of-band Bluetooth pairing (OOB)
USB_OOB_BT_PAIRING.description: Enables Out-of-Band (OOB) Bluetooth pairing via USB cable. This allows initial Bluetooth pairing to be performed automatically when the phone is first connected via USB, skipping manual PIN entry.

RINGTONE.name: Ringtone brand
RINGTONE.description: Chooses which brand's built-in ringtone the head unit plays for incoming calls. Pick the brand that matches the car.

CONTACTS_NAVI_SEPARATED.name: Contacts and navigation separated
CONTACTS_NAVI_SEPARATED.description: When active, the contacts/phonebook and navigation destination entry are shown as separate menu items rather than integrated into a combined address-search view.

SINGLE_OR_MULTILINK.name: Bluetooth connection mode (single / multi-link)
SINGLE_OR_MULTILINK.description: Sets whether the head unit supports a single simultaneous Bluetooth device connection (Singlelink) or multiple parallel Bluetooth connections (Multilink), enabling two phones to be linked at once.

CONTACT_NUMBERS_BT.name: Contact phone numbers via Bluetooth
CONTACT_NUMBERS_BT.description: Enables display of phone numbers from contacts downloaded via Bluetooth, as opposed to only showing contact names.

CONTACT_BOOK_PICTURES.name: Contact book photos
CONTACT_BOOK_PICTURES.description: Enables display of contact photos/pictures downloaded from the paired phone alongside contact names in the phonebook list.

BLUETOOTH_HANDSET.name: Bluetooth handset (cordless handset support)
BLUETOOTH_HANDSET.description: Enables support for a separate Bluetooth cordless handset accessory connected to the vehicle, allowing calls to be taken on a detachable handset. Legacy feature.

BLUETOOTH_SAP_SUPPORT.name: Bluetooth SAP profile (SIM access)
BLUETOOTH_SAP_SUPPORT.description: Enables the Bluetooth SAP (SIM Access Profile), allowing the vehicle's built-in cellular module to use the SIM card from a paired phone.

BT_PHONE_INSTANCE_ID.name: Bluetooth phone instance ID
BT_PHONE_INSTANCE_ID.description: Identifies which Bluetooth phone instance slot is active (used when multiple phone module instances are supported). Value 0 = first/default instance.

BLUETOOTH_2ND_HFP.name: Bluetooth second HFP connection
BLUETOOTH_2ND_HFP.description: Enables a second simultaneous Bluetooth HFP (Hands-Free Profile) connection, allowing two phones to be active for calls concurrently (complementary to TWO_PHONES_PARALLEL).

MACRO_PIM.name: Macro PIM enable
MACRO_PIM.description: Enables the macro-level PIM (Personal Information Manager) feature set, providing calendar, messages, and notes integration in the iDrive menu. Requires 6NK/6NL/6NS/6NW and excludes Japanese market.

PIM_CROSS_USE.name: PIM cross-device use
PIM_CROSS_USE.description: Enables PIM (calendar/contacts/messages) data sharing across multiple connected CE (consumer electronics) devices, so all paired phones see the same PIM state.

PIM_TTS.name: PIM text-to-speech (TTS) readout
PIM_TTS.description: Enables text-to-speech readout of PIM messages (SMS, calendar entries, emails) through the vehicle audio system, allowing the driver to listen to messages without looking at the screen.

PIM_DRIVING_TEXT_LENGTH.name: Text while driving: Office entries
PIM_DRIVING_TEXT_LENGTH.description: Limits how much of a message, email or other Office entry appears on screen while the car is moving. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

PIM_NAVI_TO_MEETING_LOCATION.name: PIM navigate to meeting location
PIM_NAVI_TO_MEETING_LOCATION.description: Enables a one-tap option in calendar meeting entries to navigate directly to the meeting location using the navigation system.

PIM_SPEECH_TO_TEXT.name: PIM message speech-to-text dictation
PIM_SPEECH_TO_TEXT.description: Enables speech-to-text dictation for composing PIM messages (SMS/email reply) using the vehicle's microphone and voice recognition engine.

PIM_MESSAGE_SENDING.name: PIM message sending (compose and send)
PIM_MESSAGE_SENDING.description: Enables the ability to compose and send messages (SMS, email) from the PIM application in the head unit, not just read incoming messages.

PIM_REMINDER_POPUPS.name: PIM reminder pop-ups
PIM_REMINDER_POPUPS.description: Enables pop-up notification overlays on the iDrive screen when a PIM calendar reminder fires, alerting the driver to upcoming appointments.

PIM_CREATE_NEW.name: PIM create new entry
PIM_CREATE_NEW.description: Enables the 'Create new' function in the PIM application, allowing the driver to create new calendar events, notes, or contact entries directly from the head unit.

PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_VOICE_EMAIL.name: PIM new element: voice/email
PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_VOICE_EMAIL.description: Enables creation of a new PIM element of the voice-email type (a voice message recorded and sent as an email attachment). When disabled, only text-based elements can be created.

PIM_MULTIPLE_CE_DEVICES.name: PIM multi-device CE support
PIM_MULTIPLE_CE_DEVICES.description: Enables PIM data synchronisation with multiple simultaneous consumer-electronics (CE) devices (e.g. two paired phones each contributing contacts and calendar data).

PIM_NOTES_USB_EXPORT.name: PIM notes USB export
PIM_NOTES_USB_EXPORT.description: Enables export of PIM notes and memos to a USB storage device, allowing the user to save created notes externally.

PIM_HTML_EMAIL_BROWSER.name: PIM HTML email browser
PIM_HTML_EMAIL_BROWSER.description: Enables HTML rendering in the PIM email viewer, displaying rich-text/formatted emails rather than plain-text only.

CONTACTS_ICON.name: Contacts icon display
CONTACTS_ICON.description: Enables display of a graphical icon/avatar for contacts in the phonebook list when no photo is available, instead of a generic placeholder.

WIDEBAND_SPEECH.name: Wideband speech (HD Voice)
WIDEBAND_SPEECH.description: Enables HD Voice / wideband speech audio for Bluetooth hands-free calls, providing significantly improved call audio quality over narrowband when both phone and network support it.

RDU_CONTROL.name: RDU remote control
RDU_CONTROL.description: Enables RDU (Remote Diagnostic Unit / remote control module) control features reachable via BMW ConnectedDrive services, such as remote locking, climate preconditioning triggers, etc.

SVR.name: SVR (stolen vehicle recovery)
SVR.description: Enables SVR (Stolen Vehicle Recovery) telematics service, which allows BMW Assist to track and report vehicle location in the event of theft.

HEATING_CONTROL.name: Remote heating control (BMW Remote)
HEATING_CONTROL.description: Enables remote pre-conditioning heating control via the BMW Remote / ConnectedDrive app, allowing the driver to start or schedule cabin heating from a smartphone.

VENTILATION_CONTROL.name: Remote ventilation control (BMW Remote)
VENTILATION_CONTROL.description: Enables remote cabin ventilation/cooling control via the BMW Remote / ConnectedDrive app, allowing the driver to start ventilation from a smartphone.

LIGHT_CONTROL.name: Remote light control (BMW Remote)
LIGHT_CONTROL.description: Enables remote exterior light flashing control via BMW Remote / ConnectedDrive app, allowing the driver to flash headlights to locate the vehicle.

HORN_CONTROL.name: Remote horn control (BMW Remote)
HORN_CONTROL.description: Enables remote horn honking via BMW Remote / ConnectedDrive app, allowing the driver to sound the horn briefly to locate the vehicle.

ASSIST_VEHICLEFINDER_SHOW.name: BMW Assist vehicle finder show
ASSIST_VEHICLEFINDER_SHOW.description: Controls whether the Vehicle Finder feature (using BMW Assist / ConnectedDrive to display the parked car location on a smartphone map) is displayed in the head unit menu.

ASSIST_SVR_SHOW.name: BMW Assist SVR show in menu
ASSIST_SVR_SHOW.description: Controls whether the Stolen Vehicle Recovery (SVR) entry is shown in the BMW Assist / ConnectedDrive services menu. Active on vehicles with 6AE TeleServices.

CONTACT_NUMBERS_BCALL.name: BMW Assist B-Call contact numbers
CONTACT_NUMBERS_BCALL.description: Enables display of BMW Assist B-Call (Breakdown Call) service phone numbers in the contacts/Assist menu. Excluded for Korean and Japanese market variants.

CONTACT_NUMBERS_DEALER.name: Dealer contact numbers
CONTACT_NUMBERS_DEALER.description: Enables display of the dealer/BMW service centre phone number in the BMW Assist or contacts menu. Excluded for Korean market.

CONTACT_NUMBERS_HOTLINE.name: BMW Assist hotline contact numbers
CONTACT_NUMBERS_HOTLINE.description: Enables display of BMW Assist customer hotline phone numbers in the BMW Assist menu. Excluded for Japanese market.

ONLINE_BROWSER.name: BMW Online and Internet portals
ONLINE_BROWSER.description: Chooses which built-in online portals the head unit offers: the BMW Online service portal and the BMW Internet web browser.

STARTUP.name: Startup (telematics/online startup sequence)
STARTUP.description: Enables a telematics or online-services startup sequence at vehicle power-on, triggering initial connection and service registration for ConnectedDrive.

ONLINE_SERVICES.name: Online services enable
ONLINE_SERVICES.description: Master enable for BMW ConnectedDrive Online Services (real-time traffic, weather, BMW Online portal, remote services). Requires 6AE TeleServices or 6AF Emergency Call option; disabled if TELD (telematics deactivation) is set.

ONLINE_SERVICES_GLS.name: Online services GLS (geographic location services)
ONLINE_SERVICES_GLS.description: Enables GLS (Geographic / GPS Location Services) as part of BMW Online Services, used for real-time traffic routing, local search, and location-aware ConnectedDrive features.

TELEX.name: Telematics / ConnectedDrive online services enable
TELEX.description: Enables the telematics/online services subsystem (TELEX). Gated by NOT TELD (telematics deactivation) and NOT 6AE (TeleServices); set when telematics hardware is fitted and active.

NGTP_KEY_TABLE.name: NGTP key table index
NGTP_KEY_TABLE.description: Selects which NGTP (Next Generation Telematics Protocol) key table is used for secure BMW ConnectedDrive communication. Supports up to 14 key-table variants (TABLE_0–TABLE_13).

TDA_CFG_HLC_DATA.name: TDA high-level data configuration enable
TDA_CFG_HLC_DATA.description: Enables the TDA (Telematics Data Application) high-level car data (HLC_DATA) path, which allows the telematics ECU to exchange vehicle data at the application layer with BMW backend services.

ASSIST.name: BMW Assist (emergency call) enable
ASSIST.description: Enables the BMW Assist telematics service, including automatic and manual emergency call (eCall/SOS) functionality. Gated on NOT TELD, NOT 6AE, and NOT 6AF (statutory emergency call option).

CONFIG_INDEX.name: Telematics/online configuration table index
CONFIG_INDEX.description: Selects the active configuration table (CONFIG_TABLE_0 through CONFIG_TABLE_10) for the telematics/online subsystem, allowing market- or variant-specific parameter sets to be applied without changing individual fields.

GPS_FROM_NAVI.name: GPS position source: navigation system
GPS_FROM_NAVI.description: When enabled, the telematics/online services obtain GPS position data from the fitted professional navigation system (609) rather than from a standalone GPS receiver.

TOL_CFG_EXP_USB_OVERWRITE.name: TOL export USB overwrite enable
TOL_CFG_EXP_USB_OVERWRITE.description: Allows a USB-connected device to overwrite the TOL (Telematics Online) export/configuration data. Engineering/production flag.

ONLINE_BROWSER_LIVE.name: Online browser live-data mode
ONLINE_BROWSER_LIVE.description: Selects the live-data mode for the integrated online browser (BMW ConnectedDrive web portal). 2-bit field with no symbolic enum.

DATACOMM_CSIM.name: Data communication CSIM enable
DATACOMM_CSIM.description: Enables the CSIM (Card Services Interface Module) data communication path, used when a C-SIM (embedded cellular SIM) is the data bearer for telematics connectivity.

CONTACTS_INITIAL_SPELLER_ASIA.name: Contacts: Asian initial-character speller
CONTACTS_INITIAL_SPELLER_ASIA.description: Enables the Asian (Japanese/Chinese) initial-character speller layout for the phone contacts search screen. Active for Japanese (807), Chinese (8AA), and specific country-control codes (8LH, 8LT) markets.

CONTACTS_JAPAN_SEARCH.name: Contacts: Japan phonetic search enable
CONTACTS_JAPAN_SEARCH.description: Enables Japan-specific phonetic (kana) search ordering for the phone contacts list, where contacts are sorted and searched by pronunciation rather than character.

ADDRESS_VALIDATION.name: Navigation address validation enable
ADDRESS_VALIDATION.description: Enables server-side address validation for navigation destination input (online POI/address check). Requires navigation system option (606 Business or 609 Professional).

ENT_BTAS_IAP.name: Bluetooth audio streaming (BTAS) iAP enable
ENT_BTAS_IAP.description: Enables the iAP (iPod Accessory Protocol) command channel used by the Bluetooth audio streaming subsystem (BTAS) for Apple device control over Bluetooth. When disabled (NICHT_AKTIV), iAP commands are not issued.

TDA_CFG_BDA_REMOTE_HELP.name: TDA BDA remote help enable
TDA_CFG_BDA_REMOTE_HELP.description: Enables the BMW Digital Assistant (BDA) remote help feature through the Telematics Data Application (TDA) layer, allowing remote BMW assistance operations via telematics.

ENT_BTAS_METADATA.name: Bluetooth audio streaming (BTAS) metadata enable
ENT_BTAS_METADATA.description: Enables the retrieval and display of track metadata (artist, title, album) from Bluetooth-connected devices via the BTAS subsystem. Requires a Bluetooth/USB phone option (6NH, 6NK, 6NL, 6NS, or 6NW).

ENT_BTAS_BROWSING.name: Bluetooth audio streaming (BTAS) media browsing enable
ENT_BTAS_BROWSING.description: Enables AVRCP media browsing over Bluetooth, allowing the iDrive to browse playlists and tracks on the connected phone. Active when TV (601) or professional navi (609) are NOT fitted.

CONTACTS_EIN_AUS.name: Phone contacts display enable
CONTACTS_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the phone contacts (phonebook) feature on the iDrive, allowing imported contacts from a paired Bluetooth device to be viewed and dialled. Requires a Bluetooth/USB telephony option.

PIM_BILDER_EIN_AUS.name: PIM photo/image sync enable
PIM_BILDER_EIN_AUS.description: Enables synchronisation of images/photos from the paired phone to the Personal Information Manager (PIM) on the head unit. Not available for Japanese (807), Australian (810), and certain Chinese/Bluetooth-only markets.

CALENDAR_EIN_AUS.name: PIM calendar sync enable
CALENDAR_EIN_AUS.description: Enables synchronisation of calendar entries from a paired phone to the iDrive PIM calendar application. Requires professional navigation (609) and a Bluetooth/USB telephony option.

TASK_EIN_AUS.name: PIM tasks sync enable
TASK_EIN_AUS.description: Enables synchronisation of task/to-do entries from a paired phone to the iDrive PIM tasks application. Requires professional navigation (609) and a Bluetooth/USB telephony option.

REMINDER_EIN_AUS.name: PIM reminders sync enable
REMINDER_EIN_AUS.description: Enables synchronisation of reminder/alarm entries from a paired phone to the iDrive PIM application. Requires professional navigation (609) and a Bluetooth/USB telephony option.

OGG_CODEC_ON_OFF.name: OGG Vorbis audio codec enable
OGG_CODEC_ON_OFF.description: Enables playback of OGG Vorbis compressed audio files from USB or other media sources. Always active (no FA gate); disabling removes OGG format support.

TEXT_NOTES_EIN_AUS.name: PIM text notes sync enable
TEXT_NOTES_EIN_AUS.description: Enables synchronisation of text notes/memos from a paired phone to the iDrive PIM note application. Requires professional navigation (609) and a Bluetooth/USB telephony option.

AUDIO_NOTES_EIN_AUS.name: PIM audio notes enable
AUDIO_NOTES_EIN_AUS.description: Enables recording and playback of voice/audio memos in the iDrive PIM application. Requires a Bluetooth/USB telephony option (6NK, 6NL, 6NS, or 6NW).

SMS_EIN_AUS.name: SMS messaging enable
SMS_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the iDrive SMS (text message) reader/sender for paired Bluetooth phones. When not active (NICHT_AKTIV), the SMS menu is hidden. Requires a Bluetooth/USB telephony option.

EMAIL_EIN_AUS.name: Email access enable
EMAIL_EIN_AUS.description: Enables access to email messages on the iDrive from a paired Bluetooth phone. Requires a Bluetooth/USB telephony option (6NK, 6NL, 6NS, or 6NW).

WLAN_DIAGNOSE.name: Wi-Fi diagnostic mode
WLAN_DIAGNOSE.description: Turns on a Wi-Fi diagnostic mode for workshop and development use. Not a CarPlay setting.

WLAN_STATUS.name: WLAN status display enable
WLAN_STATUS.description: Enables display of the Wi-Fi/WLAN connection status indicator in the iDrive.

WLAN_SIGNAL_STRENGTH.name: WLAN signal strength model
WLAN_SIGNAL_STRENGTH.description: Selects the signal-strength calibration model for the Wi-Fi antenna: OUTDOOR (open-air antenna placement) or INCAR (antenna mounted inside the vehicle body).

WLAN_WIFI_DIRECT.name: WLAN Wi-Fi Direct enable
WLAN_WIFI_DIRECT.description: Enables Wi-Fi Direct (peer-to-peer Wi-Fi) mode on the head unit's WLAN module, allowing direct connections to devices without a router.

WLAN_CLIENT.name: WLAN client mode enable
WLAN_CLIENT.description: Enables the WLAN module to operate in client (station) mode, connecting to an external Wi-Fi access point.

WLAN_AP.name: WLAN access point mode enable
WLAN_AP.description: Enables the WLAN module to operate as a Wi-Fi access point (hotspot mode), broadcasting its own SSID.

WLAN_CHANNEL.name: WLAN channel selection
WLAN_CHANNEL.description: Selects the default Wi-Fi channel (1–14) for the WLAN access point or direct-connect mode. Channel range varies by regulatory domain (WLAN_DOMAIN). Default is channel 1.

WLAN_DOMAIN.name: WLAN regulatory domain
WLAN_DOMAIN.description: Selects the Wi-Fi regulatory domain/region, which determines permitted channels and transmit power limits for the WLAN module.

API_IPOD_2WIRE_ON_OFF.name: iPod 2-wire (USB) audio interface enable
API_IPOD_2WIRE_ON_OFF.description: Enables the older 2-wire USB audio data path for iPod/iPhone devices instead of the digital audio interface. legacy iPod connector feature.

API_MSD_EIN_AUS.name: USB Mass Storage Device (MSD) media enable
API_MSD_EIN_AUS.description: Enables USB Mass Storage Device class support on the media interface port, allowing USB drives and media players (not iPod protocol) to be read as a media source.

API_APPLE_AUTH_CHIP_ON_OFF.name: Apple authentication chip enable
API_APPLE_AUTH_CHIP_ON_OFF.description: Enables hardware-level Apple MFi authentication chip interaction on the USB/accessory port, required for iAP2 communication with iPhone/iPod devices. Always active (no FA gate).

API_USB_READ_WRITE.name: USB read/write (bidirectional USB) enable
API_USB_READ_WRITE.description: Enables bidirectional USB data access (both read and write) on the media port. When disabled (NICHT_AKTIV), only read access is permitted.

API_CAR_TYPE_IPOD_LOGO.name: iPod/iPhone logo variant for car type
API_CAR_TYPE_IPOD_LOGO.description: Selects which iPod/iPhone-compatible logo artwork variant is displayed in the iDrive media source list, based on the vehicle model family. 0=no logo (NONE).

API_MP4_ON_OFF.name: MP4 video playback via USB enable
API_MP4_ON_OFF.description: Enables playback of MP4 video files from a USB-connected device on the iDrive screen. Requires a USB/BT telephony option.

WLAN_HOTSPOT_TELEMATIC_ECU.name: WLAN hotspot via telematics ECU enable
WLAN_HOTSPOT_TELEMATIC_ECU.description: Enables the Wi-Fi hotspot function routed through the telematics ECU (TCB), allowing the car to share its cellular data connection as a Wi-Fi access point. Requires option 6WD (Personal Hotspot).

CDMM_USB_TAG_MGR.name: CDMM USB tag manager enable
