CDMM_USB_TAG_MGR.description: Enables the USB tag-manager component of the Content and Data Media Manager (CDMM), used to read metadata tags from USB media files.

CDMM_USB_COVER_ART.name: USB cover art display enable
CDMM_USB_COVER_ART.description: Enables display of album artwork embedded in USB media files (ID3/MP4 cover art). Disabled for certain Chinese market vehicles (8LH country control).

CDMM_USB_COVER_ART_IPOD.name: iPod cover art display enable
CDMM_USB_COVER_ART_IPOD.description: Enables display of album artwork from iPod/iPhone devices connected via USB iAP. Disabled for certain Chinese market vehicles (8LH country control).

USB1_IPOD_AUDIO.name: USB port 1 iPod audio path
USB1_IPOD_AUDIO.description: Selects the audio data path for iPod/iPhone devices on USB port 1: Digital (iAP digital audio), Analog (line-level output), or Auto (firmware auto-detects the preferred path).

USB2_IPOD_AUDIO.name: USB port 2 iPod audio path
USB2_IPOD_AUDIO.description: Selects the audio data path for iPod/iPhone devices on USB port 2 (when fitted). 2-bit field; syset carries only raw codes [1,2] with no symbolic names. By analogy with USB1_IPOD_AUDIO the values likely correspond to Analog and Auto, but no symbolic enum is confirmed.

DPAS_INDEX.name: Online services connection profile
DPAS_INDEX.description: Picks the built-in connection profile the head unit's online services start from: the BMW provisioning server, mobile-data access point and proxy for a region. The test-server profiles point to BMW's development backend instead of the live service. A value without a profile leaves the head unit with no default profile.

NAVI_INFO_INSTANCE_ID.name: Navigation info service instance
NAVI_INFO_INSTANCE_ID.description: Identifies which instance of the navigation information service the head unit uses.

SWUP_AGENT_TYPE.name: Software update agent role
SWUP_AGENT_TYPE.description: Determines the SWUP agent's role in multi-ECU update orchestration: CLIENT (receives update instructions from a master) or MASTER (orchestrates updates across ECUs).

SWUP_SEPARATE_UPDATES.name: Software update: separate/sequential updates enable
SWUP_SEPARATE_UPDATES.description: When enabled, software updates are applied to each SWE (Software Element) separately in sequence rather than in a combined package, allowing more granular retry/rollback behaviour.

SWUP_ENABLE_POPUP_SCREENS.name: Software update: user popup screens enable
SWUP_ENABLE_POPUP_SCREENS.description: When enabled, the iDrive displays progress and confirmation popup screens to the driver during a software update. may suppress HMI feedback during OTA updates.

SWUP_CYCLIC_RESET_THRESHOLD.name: Software update: cyclic reset threshold
SWUP_CYCLIC_RESET_THRESHOLD.description: Sets the maximum number of cyclic reset attempts permitted before the update agent aborts an update cycle. Values: 0 (disabled/no limit), 5 (5 retries), or 255 (maximum).

PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_EMAIL.name: PIM new email notification enable
PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_EMAIL.description: Enables display of an iDrive notification when a new email is received from the paired phone via the PIM (Personal Information Manager) sync.

PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_SMS.name: PIM new SMS notification enable
PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_SMS.description: Enables display of an iDrive notification when a new SMS text message is received from the paired phone via the PIM sync.

PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_TEXT_NOTE.name: PIM new text note notification enable
PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_TEXT_NOTE.description: Enables display of an iDrive notification when a new text note/memo is synced from the paired phone via the PIM.

PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_AUDIO_NOTE.name: PIM new audio note notification enable
PIM_NEW_ELEMENT_AUDIO_NOTE.description: Enables display of an iDrive notification when a new voice/audio memo is synced from the paired phone via the PIM.

API_USB_VIDEO.name: USB ports for video files
API_USB_VIDEO.description: Chooses the USB ports on which video files from a USB drive or player can play. With no port checked, USB video is blocked. The factory sets it from the TV function (S601), Navigation Professional (S609), the smartphone options (S6NF, S6NR or S6NS) and the market (S8LH).

API_IPOD_VIDEO.name: iPod video playback port assignment
API_IPOD_VIDEO.description: Selects which USB port(s) support video streaming from iPod/iPhone devices (iAP video). Mirrors USB video port selection but for iPod-protocol devices.

ECALL_INSTANCE_ID.name: eCall instance ID
ECALL_INSTANCE_ID.description: Identifies the SOME/IP service instance used by the eCall (emergency call) system in the telematics module. Required for statutory eCall (6AF) fitments. Default 0 (WERT_0); value 0xEC (236) maps to an alternative instance.

M_SECURITY_MODE_ASH.name: NGTP security mode: authentication algorithm (session handshake)
M_SECURITY_MODE_ASH.description: Selects the cryptographic authentication algorithm used for NGTP (telematics protocol) session handshake (ASH = Authentication Security Handshake). 4-bit field; syset carries no symbolic enum names for this coord.

M_SECURITY_MODE_AEH.name: NGTP security mode: encryption algorithm (session handshake)
M_SECURITY_MODE_AEH.description: Selects the encryption algorithm for NGTP session data (AEH = Authentication Encryption Handshake). DES_CBC is the only named value, indicating DES in CBC mode for this telematics protocol phase.

M_SECURITY_MODE_ASP.name: NGTP security mode: authentication algorithm (payload)
M_SECURITY_MODE_ASP.description: Selects the message authentication algorithm applied to NGTP payload data (ASP = Authentication Security Payload): DES-CBC-MAC, HMAC-SHA-1, or HMAC-SHA-256.

M_SECURITY_MODE_AEP.name: NGTP security mode: encryption algorithm (payload)
M_SECURITY_MODE_AEP.description: Selects the encryption algorithm applied to NGTP payload data (AEP = Authentication Encryption Payload): DES-CBC or AES-128.

API_VIDEO_DELAY_USB.name: USB video sync delay
API_VIDEO_DELAY_USB.description: Picture-to-sound delay for video from a USB source. The head unit doesn't use it.

API_VIDEO_DELAY_IPOD.name: iPod video sync delay
API_VIDEO_DELAY_IPOD.description: Picture-to-sound delay for video from an iPod or iPhone. The head unit doesn't use it.

BT_USER_FRIENDLY_NAME.name: Bluetooth device friendly name (brand)
BT_USER_FRIENDLY_NAME.description: Sets the brand name prefix used for the Bluetooth device friendly name (the name shown to pairing phones). Selects between BMW group brand identities.

RESET_INFO_SCREEN.name: Reset info screen
RESET_INFO_SCREEN.description: Controls whether the yellow system-information screen (service/diagnostic info screen) is reset on next boot. Activated only when FA option SCRY (Yellow Screen activation) is present.

ENT_IAP2_SUPPORT.name: iAP2 (Lightning/USB) entertainment support
ENT_IAP2_SUPPORT.description: Enables iAP2 (Apple Lightning/USB accessory protocol v2) support for iPod/iPhone audio and control in the entertainment system. Suppressed when TV (601) or Professional Navigation (609) is present.

CARPLAY_SWT.name: CarPlay coding check
CARPLAY_SWT.description: The bit the head unit checks before it offers Apple CarPlay. CarPlay appears only when this is 1 and the CarPlay FSC (AppNo 0x0143) is accepted. It is the only coding bit the CarPlay check reads.

CC_CBS_ETH_SERVICE_VERSION.name: Check Control and CBS service version
CC_CBS_ETH_SERVICE_VERSION.description: Picks which version of the instrument cluster's network service the central display uses to get Check Control messages and Condition Based Service (CBS) data. Match it to the car's instrument cluster; with the wrong version these messages and service data can be missing.

TC_CDS_FKA_LUM_SUPPORT.name: Touch Command CDS FKA luminance support
TC_CDS_FKA_LUM_SUPPORT.description: Enables Touch Command (TC) Car Data Service (CDS) support for FKA (front-facing driver-assistance camera) luminance data.

PIA_MMI.name: Portation (profile transfer) menu mode
PIA_MMI.description: Selects which portation-related menu items appear in the system settings. Controls whether the full portation menu, a subset, or no menu at all is shown to the user.

SMARTSOL.name: SmartSol feature
SMARTSOL.description: Enables the SmartSol feature (BMW SmartSolution / smart personalisation solution).

NFC_OPERATION_MODE.name: NFC operation mode
NFC_OPERATION_MODE.description: Selects the NFC (Near Field Communication) reader operating mode. Rotation mode cycles through NFC polling; Passive mode keeps the reader in passive/listen state.

ZOOM_IN_DIRECTION_ZBE.name: iDrive rotary controller zoom direction
ZOOM_IN_DIRECTION_ZBE.description: Defines which rotary direction on the ZBE (iDrive controller) zooms in on the map or list. Left = rotate left to zoom in; Right = rotate right to zoom in.

USE_GW_TR_VIN.name: Use gateway transport VIN
USE_GW_TR_VIN.description: Instructs the head unit to read the vehicle VIN from the gateway (GW) transport layer rather than from its own stored value.

TYP_LENKUNG.name: Steering wheel side (left-hand drive / right-hand drive)
TYP_LENKUNG.description: Specifies whether the vehicle is left-hand drive (LHD, steering on left) or right-hand drive (RHD, steering on right). Used for layout and ergonomics decisions in the HMI.

ZBE_35UP.name: ZBE hardware generation 3.5+ (CIC-era controller)
ZBE_35UP.description: Indicates that a ZBE (iDrive controller) from the 3.5-generation or later (CIC/NBT era) is fitted. Affects input-event handling and feature availability for the iDrive rotary/button cluster.

SHUTDOWN_DELAY_TIMER_1.name: Shutdown delay timer 1 (post-ignition-off delay)
SHUTDOWN_DELAY_TIMER_1.description: Sets the first post-ignition-off delay before the head unit begins its shutdown sequence. A value of 0 means immediate shutdown; 20 encodes a 20-second delay.

SHUTDOWN_DELAY_TIMER_2.name: Shutdown delay timer 2 (secondary post-ignition delay)
SHUTDOWN_DELAY_TIMER_2.description: Sets the second (secondary) post-ignition-off shutdown delay. A value of 0 means no secondary delay; 15 encodes a 15-second secondary delay before final power-off.

DEFAULT_DATUM.name: Default date display format
DEFAULT_DATUM.description: Sets the default date format displayed in the system settings and clock. The user can usually override this at runtime; this is the factory default.

DEL_PERS_DATA.name: Delete personal data on next start
DEL_PERS_DATA.description: When set, triggers deletion of stored personal/user data on the next system start. Gated by absence of car-sharing (ECSM) or flexible car-use (5GC) options.

SOFTWARE_UPDATE_MANAGER.name: Software update manager
SOFTWARE_UPDATE_MANAGER.description: Turns on the head unit's software update manager, which finds and installs software updates delivered by USB or over the air.

SOFTWARE_UPDATE_ASSISTANT.name: Software Update Assistant enable
SOFTWARE_UPDATE_ASSISTANT.description: Enables the Software Update Assistant — a guided on-screen update workflow presented to the user. FA-gated; active only with certain navigation, telephony, telematics, or car-sharing options.

CONNECTIVITY_SYSTEM_VER.name: Connectivity system version identification method
CONNECTIVITY_SYSTEM_VER.description: Selects how the connectivity system version is reported / identified. The only defined value uses the part number (Teilenummer).

DEFAULT_WEG_EINHEIT.name: Default distance unit
DEFAULT_WEG_EINHEIT.description: Sets the default unit for displaying distances (odometer, range, navigation). FA-gated by 548 (speedometer with km reading).

DEFAULT_DRUCK_EINHEIT.name: Default tyre pressure unit
DEFAULT_DRUCK_EINHEIT.description: Sets the factory-default unit for tyre pressure display (RDC / tyre-pressure monitoring system).

DEFAULT_TEMPERATUR.name: Default temperature unit
DEFAULT_TEMPERATUR.description: Sets the factory-default unit for temperature display (outside temperature, climate settings, etc.).

ZBE_TOUCH_SL.name: ZBE touch-screen slide (touch-sensitive iDrive surface)
ZBE_TOUCH_SL.description: Enables touch-slide (swipe/gesture) input on a touch-sensitive ZBE (iDrive controller surface).

DEFAULT_ZEIT_EINHEIT.name: Default time format
DEFAULT_ZEIT_EINHEIT.description: Sets the default time format for the clock display. FA-gated for Japanese, Gulf, and certain type-key regions.

EINSTELLUNG_MEILEN.name: Miles variant (US or UK)
EINSTELLUNG_MEILEN.description: When distance is displayed in miles, specifies whether US miles or UK miles (slightly different conversion context, used for speed/fuel calculations) are used.

VERBRAUCH.name: Default fuel consumption unit
VERBRAUCH.description: Sets the factory-default unit for fuel consumption display. FA-gated (not Japan / not GB/Ireland).

GETRIEBETYP.name: Transmission type
GETRIEBETYP.description: Specifies the type of gearbox fitted. Used by the HMI to tailor gear-display and driving-dynamics UI. FA-gated by steptronic/DCT options.

BAUART.name: Body style (Bauart)
BAUART.description: Identifies the vehicle body style. The HMI uses this to select appropriate vehicle silhouette graphics and feature defaults. FA-gated by vehicle type-key group.

DEFAULT_SVS_DIALOG.name: Default voice-command dialog style
DEFAULT_SVS_DIALOG.description: Selects the default verbosity/style of BMW voice-command (SVS) dialogs. Standard shows full prompts; Short gives abbreviated prompts for experienced users.

ANTRIEB.name: Drive type (all-wheel / rear-wheel drive)
ANTRIEB.description: Specifies the vehicle drivetrain type. Used by the HMI and portation master for drivetrain-specific feature selection. FA-gated by vehicle type-key group.

ZBE_LOW.name: ZBE low-end controller fitted
ZBE_LOW.description: Indicates that a low-specification ZBE (iDrive controller, e.g. for entry-level navigation or audio systems) is fitted rather than the full Professional ZBE. Suppressed when TV, Business Nav, or Professional Nav is present.

EXTERNER_MOST.name: External MOST bus connected
EXTERNER_MOST.description: Indicates whether an external MOST (Media Oriented Systems Transport) optical bus is connected to the head unit, used for DVD changer or extended-equipment KOMBI. When inactive (code 0), no external MOST device is present.

HTTP_ILEVEL_UPDATE.name: HTTP iLevel update enable
HTTP_ILEVEL_UPDATE.description: Enables or disables the HTTP-based iLevel (i-step level) update mechanism, which allows the head unit to receive software component updates over HTTP from BMW's servers.

ZBE_TOUCH.name: ZBE touch-display (touch-screen iDrive) fitted
ZBE_TOUCH.description: Indicates that a touch-screen ZBE (iDrive controller with touch-sensitive display) is fitted. Enables touch input event routing. FA-gated by 609 (Professional Navigation).

TRACE.name: Diagnostic trace / logging mode
TRACE.description: Selects the diagnostic trace/logging channel active on this head unit. External tracing routes logs to an external tester/logger; internal tracing uses the on-device gnlog facility.

SLEEPDELAY_CLAMP30B_MIN.name: Sleep delay after clamp 30B drop (seconds, encoded)
SLEEPDELAY_CLAMP30B_MIN.description: Sets the minimum time the head unit waits after the 30B clamp (battery-backed standby power) drops before entering deep sleep. The raw field value encodes time in units of 10 seconds.

SLEEPDELAY_TIMERVALUE.name: Sleep delay timer value (encoded seconds)
SLEEPDELAY_TIMERVALUE.description: Sets the sleep delay timer value (secondary sleep timer). Raw field value encodes time in units of 10 seconds; the defined settings correspond to 60, 180, 300, and 540 seconds.

ASD.name: Active Sound Design loudspeaker diagnostics mode
ASD.description: Controls the Active Sound Design (ASD) loudspeaker diagnostic mode. When LS_DIAG_ON, speaker self-diagnostics are enabled; LS_DIAG_OFF suppresses them. FA-gated by vehicle type-key groups.

ENT_MODE_NAVIGATION.name: Navigation entertainment mode (entitlement model)
ENT_MODE_NAVIGATION.description: Controls how navigation features are enabled/authorised. When set to 'active with authorisation', navigation content requires an online authorisation step before becoming available. FA-gated; not active in car-sharing or flexible car-use scenarios.

CAN_ANSCHLUSS_HEADUNIT.name: Head unit CAN bus connection
CAN_ANSCHLUSS_HEADUNIT.description: Specifies which CAN bus the head unit is physically connected to. Body CAN is standard for most models; IK-CAN (instrument cluster CAN) is used in some configurations.

ENT_MODE_BMW_SERVICES.name: BMW Connected Services entertainment mode (entitlement)
ENT_MODE_BMW_SERVICES.description: Controls how BMW online/Connected Services features are authorised in the entertainment mode. 'Active with authorisation' requires an online authorisation step. FA-gated; not active in car-sharing scenarios.

TEILNETZBETRIEB.name: Partial network (sub-bus) operation mode
TEILNETZBETRIEB.description: Enables partial network (Teilnetzbetrieb) mode, allowing the head unit to operate on a reduced-power sub-network. Version selects the 2013 or 2015 partial-network protocol variant.

ENT_MODE_CONNECTIVITY.name: Connectivity entertainment mode (entitlement)
ENT_MODE_CONNECTIVITY.description: Controls how connectivity features (e.g. Wi-Fi hotspot, online services) are authorised. FA-gated; not active in car-sharing scenarios.

MIRRORING.name: Screen mirroring enable
MIRRORING.description: Enables the screen mirroring feature (MIRS — Mirroring on switch), allowing a connected device's display to be mirrored on the iDrive screen. FA-gated by MIRS option.

PRODUKTLINIE.name: Product line
PRODUKTLINIE.description: Tells the head unit which BMW Group product line the car belongs to. The personal profile system and other functions use it to pick line-specific defaults. Set it to match the car.

SERVICE_PACK.name: Service pack level
SERVICE_PACK.description: Encodes the installed software service-pack level for the head unit. Raw numeric value 0-5; no symbolic names defined.

CAN_SELECTIVE_WAKEUP.name: CAN selective wakeup
CAN_SELECTIVE_WAKEUP.description: Enables CAN selective wakeup (CPS — CAN partial networking / selective wakeup), allowing the head unit to be woken by specific CAN frames rather than requiring full bus activity.

PROXIMITY_Z.name: Touch proximity sensor Z-axis calibration range
PROXIMITY_Z.description: 4-byte calibration range for the touch-proximity sensor Z-axis (depth/distance from screen). Encodes minimum and maximum threshold values used by the proximity detection subsystem. value format is type0x66 (signed 16-bit pair: min/max).

PROXIMITY_Y.name: Touch proximity sensor Y-axis calibration range
PROXIMITY_Y.description: 4-byte calibration range for the touch-proximity sensor Y-axis (vertical position). Encodes minimum and maximum threshold values.

PROXIMITY_X.name: Touch proximity sensor X-axis calibration range
PROXIMITY_X.description: 4-byte calibration range for the touch-proximity sensor X-axis (horizontal position). Encodes minimum and maximum threshold values.

CP_NMEA_VARIANT.name: CarPlay / navigation NMEA coordinate variant
CP_NMEA_VARIANT.description: Selects the GPS coordinate format/datum used for CarPlay and navigation data exchange. WGS-84 is the global standard; GCJ-02 (shifted) is required for mainland China. DR suffix adds dead-reckoning support. FA-gated by Chinese (8AA) and country-control (8LH) options.

DIM_CURVE_X1.name: Display dimming curve X1 (ambient light input, point 1)
DIM_CURVE_X1.description: First X-axis breakpoint of the 3-point ambient-light-to-brightness mapping curve for the central display. Defines the lower ambient light sensor level at which the brightness curve starts. This is a 16-bit value split across bytes 0-1.

DIM_CURVE_X2.name: Display dimming curve X2 (ambient light input, point 2)
DIM_CURVE_X2.description: Second (middle) X-axis breakpoint of the 3-point ambient-light-to-brightness mapping curve for the central display. Default 0x1FC0 = 8128 (mid-range sensor value).

DIM_CURVE_X3.name: Display dimming curve X3 (ambient light input, point 3)
DIM_CURVE_X3.description: Third (upper) X-axis breakpoint of the ambient-light-to-brightness mapping curve for the central display. Default 0x7F00 = 32512 (near-maximum sensor reading).

DIM_CURVE_Y1.name: Display dimming curve Y1 (brightness output, point 1)
DIM_CURVE_Y1.description: First Y-axis breakpoint of the brightness mapping curve — the brightness level output at the lowest ambient light sensor value (X1). Default 0x0145 = 325. This is a 16-bit value across bytes 6-7.

DIM_CURVE_Y2.name: Display dimming curve Y2 (brightness output, point 2)
DIM_CURVE_Y2.description: Second (middle) Y-axis breakpoint of the brightness mapping curve — the brightness level at the midpoint ambient sensor value (X2). Default 0x1FC0 = 8128.

DIM_CURVE_Y3.name: Display dimming curve Y3 (brightness output, point 3)
DIM_CURVE_Y3.description: Third (upper) Y-axis breakpoint of the brightness mapping curve — the maximum brightness output at the highest ambient sensor value (X3). Default 0x7F00 = 32512.

DIM_FILT_CHANGE_SENS.name: Display dimming filter change sensitivity
DIM_FILT_CHANGE_SENS.description: Sensitivity threshold for the low-pass / change-detection filter that controls how aggressively the display brightness responds to ambient light fluctuations. Higher values make the display less reactive to quick lighting changes. Default 0 (minimum filtering).

DIM_TOLERANCE_ALPHA.name: Display dimming alpha tolerance
DIM_TOLERANCE_ALPHA.description: Alpha (percentage/fraction) tolerance band around the current brightness target; the dimmer does not react until the ambient light change exceeds this proportional threshold. Default 15.

DIM_TOLERANCE_ABS.name: Display dimming absolute tolerance
DIM_TOLERANCE_ABS.description: Absolute (count) tolerance band; the dimmer ignores ambient sensor changes smaller than this absolute value. Prevents flicker due to sensor noise. Default 10.

DIM_DIFF_GAIN.name: Display dimming differential gain
DIM_DIFF_GAIN.description: Gain factor applied to the differential (rate-of-change) component of the ambient light signal before feeding into the dimming controller. Higher values make the display react more quickly to fast light changes. Default 1.

DIM_DIFF_THRESHOLD.name: Display dimming differential threshold
DIM_DIFF_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum rate-of-change of the ambient light signal required to trigger the differential (fast-response) path of the dimming controller. Default 10.

DIM_DIFF_BIAS.name: Display dimming differential bias
DIM_DIFF_BIAS.description: Offset added to the differential brightness adjustment step; provides a base increment when the differential path activates. Default 4.

DIM_DIFF_MAX.name: Display dimming differential maximum step
DIM_DIFF_MAX.description: Maximum brightness adjustment step size that the differential path can apply per cycle, capping how fast the display can change brightness. Default 128.

DIM_DIFF_MIN.name: Display dimming differential minimum step
DIM_DIFF_MIN.description: Minimum non-zero brightness adjustment step produced by the differential path; prevents sub-threshold corrections from stalling. Default 7.

DIM_UP_MIN.name: Display dimming minimum brightness increase step
DIM_UP_MIN.description: Minimum step size per dimming cycle when brightness is increasing (dim-up). Prevents imperceptibly slow brightening transitions. Default 1 (WERT_01); alternate code 20 = WERT_14 (step size 14).

DIM_DOWN_MIN.name: Display dimming minimum brightness decrease step
DIM_DOWN_MIN.description: Minimum step size per dimming cycle when brightness is decreasing (dim-down). Prevents imperceptibly slow dimming transitions. Default 1; alternate value 180 applies larger minimum step.

DIM_MAX_OFFSET_BRIG.name: Display dimming maximum brightness offset
DIM_MAX_OFFSET_BRIG.description: Maximum upward offset from the curve-calculated brightness that can be applied (e.g. by a user preference boost or environmental override). Default 127.

DIM_FADE_TIME_T0.name: Display dimming fade time T0
DIM_FADE_TIME_T0.description: Duration (in display-subsystem time units) of the initial fade phase T0 when transitioning brightness. Default 0 (immediate transition start, no delay).

DIM_FADE_TIME_T1.name: Display dimming fade time T1
DIM_FADE_TIME_T1.description: Duration of the first fade ramp phase T1 when transitioning the central display brightness. Default 15 (units depend on firmware timer base).

DIM_FADE_TIME_T2.name: Display dimming fade time T2
DIM_FADE_TIME_T2.description: Duration of the second fade ramp phase T2 of the central display brightness transition. Default 5.

DIM_FADE_EXPO_T1.name: Display dimming fade exponent T1
DIM_FADE_EXPO_T1.description: Exponent (curve shape) applied to the T1 fade ramp; controls whether the brightness ramp is linear (1) or accelerated/decelerated. Default 1 (linear).

DIM_FADE_EXPO_T2.name: Display dimming fade exponent T2
DIM_FADE_EXPO_T2.description: Exponent applied to the T2 fade ramp for the central display brightness transition. Default 1.

DIM_MIN_OFFSET_BRIG.name: Display dimming minimum brightness offset
DIM_MIN_OFFSET_BRIG.description: Minimum downward offset from the curve-calculated brightness target (i.e. how far below the curve the display can be driven). Default 0 (no lower offset allowed).

ENDIANESS_ADAPTED.name: Endianness adapted flag
ENDIANESS_ADAPTED.description: Internal flag indicating whether byte-endianness adaptation has been applied to this coding page data. Should remain 0 (not adapted) under normal circumstances.

PADDING3.name: Padding byte 3
PADDING3.description: Reserved padding byte with no functional meaning. Fixed at 0xFF to fill the coding page structure; must not be changed.

TEMP_THRESHOLD1.name: Display thermal protection threshold 1
TEMP_THRESHOLD1.description: First (lowest) temperature threshold (in tenths of a degree Kelvin or raw sensor units) at which the display begins reducing brightness for thermal protection. Default 0x0672 = 1650. This is a 16-bit value across bytes 32-33.

TEMP_THRESHOLD2.name: Display thermal protection threshold 2
TEMP_THRESHOLD2.description: Second temperature threshold for display brightness reduction. Default 0x06D6 = 1750. Above this level an additional brightness reduction step is applied.

TEMP_THRESHOLD3.name: Display thermal protection threshold 3
TEMP_THRESHOLD3.description: Third temperature threshold for display brightness reduction. Default 0x073A = 1850.

TEMP_THRESHOLD4.name: Display thermal protection threshold 4
TEMP_THRESHOLD4.description: Fourth (highest) temperature threshold for display brightness reduction. Default 0x079E = 1950. Above this level the display applies maximum brightness reduction to prevent overheating.

ZIN_DIM_CURVE_X1.name: ZIN display dimming curve X1 (ambient input, point 1)
ZIN_DIM_CURVE_X1.description: First X-axis breakpoint of the 3-point ambient-light-to-brightness mapping curve for the ZIN (central information display / rear zone). 16-bit value across bytes 40-41. Default 0 (lowest sensor reading).

ZIN_DIM_CURVE_X2.name: ZIN display dimming curve X2 (ambient input, point 2)
ZIN_DIM_CURVE_X2.description: Second X-axis breakpoint of the ZIN ambient-light-to-brightness curve. Default 0x1FC0 = 8128.

ZIN_DIM_CURVE_X3.name: ZIN display dimming curve X3 (ambient input, point 3)
ZIN_DIM_CURVE_X3.description: Third X-axis breakpoint of the ZIN ambient-light-to-brightness curve. Default 0x7F00 = 32512.

ZIN_DIM_CURVE_Y1.name: ZIN display dimming curve Y1 (brightness output, point 1)
ZIN_DIM_CURVE_Y1.description: First Y-axis breakpoint of the ZIN brightness output curve — the brightness level at the lowest ambient sensor value. Default 0x03E8 = 1000 (brighter minimum than the CID curve).

ZIN_DIM_CURVE_Y2.name: ZIN display dimming curve Y2 (brightness output, point 2)
ZIN_DIM_CURVE_Y2.description: Second Y-axis breakpoint of the ZIN brightness output curve. Default 0x1FC0 = 8128.

ZIN_DIM_CURVE_Y3.name: ZIN display dimming curve Y3 (brightness output, point 3)
ZIN_DIM_CURVE_Y3.description: Third Y-axis breakpoint of the ZIN brightness output curve — maximum brightness. Default 0x7F00 = 32512.

ZIN_DIM_MAX_OFFSET_BRIG.name: ZIN display dimming maximum brightness offset
ZIN_DIM_MAX_OFFSET_BRIG.description: Maximum upward brightness offset allowed for the ZIN display above the curve-calculated target. Default 127.

ZIN_DIM_MIN_OFFSET_BRIG.name: ZIN display dimming minimum brightness offset
ZIN_DIM_MIN_OFFSET_BRIG.description: Minimum downward brightness offset for the ZIN display below the curve-calculated target. Default 0 (no downward offset).

ZIN_DIM_DOWN_MIN.name: ZIN display dimming minimum brightness decrease step
ZIN_DIM_DOWN_MIN.description: Minimum step size per cycle when decreasing ZIN display brightness. Default 120 (larger minimum than CID, producing a faster observable dim-down).

ZIN_DIM_UP_MIN.name: ZIN display dimming minimum brightness increase step
ZIN_DIM_UP_MIN.description: Minimum step size per cycle when increasing ZIN display brightness. Default 1; alternate value 2 activates hub-step mode.

ZIN_DIM_FADE_IN_T1.name: ZIN display fade-in time T1
ZIN_DIM_FADE_IN_T1.description: Duration of the first ramp phase when the ZIN display fades in (increases brightness). Default 3 (time units).

ZIN_DIM_FADE_IN_T2.name: ZIN display fade-in time T2
ZIN_DIM_FADE_IN_T2.description: Duration of the second ramp phase of the ZIN display fade-in transition. Default 6.

ZIN_DIM_FADE_IN_T3.name: ZIN display fade-in time T3
ZIN_DIM_FADE_IN_T3.description: Duration of the third ramp phase of the ZIN display fade-in transition. Default 12.

ZIN_DIM_TIME_OUT_T1.name: ZIN display dimming timeout T1
ZIN_DIM_TIME_OUT_T1.description: First timeout duration for the ZIN display dimming state machine — how long the display stays at a transient brightness level before proceeding to the next step. Default 12.

ZIN_DIM_TIME_OUT_T2.name: ZIN display dimming timeout T2
ZIN_DIM_TIME_OUT_T2.description: Second timeout duration in the ZIN display dimming state machine. Default 37.

ZIN_DIM_TIME_OUT_T3.name: ZIN display dimming timeout T3
ZIN_DIM_TIME_OUT_T3.description: Third (longest) timeout duration in the ZIN display dimming state machine. Default 50.

ZIN_CRC_CALC.name: Center instrument data checksum (CRC)
ZIN_CRC_CALC.description: Checksum (CRC) calculation for the data exchanged with the MINI center instrument. Best left unchanged.

ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG1.name: ZIN animation config 1
ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG1.description: First animation configuration bit for the ZIN display. Controls an unspecified animation parameter or mode flag for the ZIN (central information display) subsystem. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG2.name: ZIN animation config 2
ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG2.description: Second animation configuration bit for the ZIN display. Controls a second animation mode flag. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG3.name: ZIN animation config 3
ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG3.description: Third animation configuration bit for the ZIN display. Controls a third animation mode flag. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG4.name: ZIN animation config 4
ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG4.description: Fourth animation configuration bit for the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG5.name: ZIN animation config 5
ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG5.description: Fifth animation configuration bit for the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG6.name: ZIN animation config 6
ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG6.description: Sixth animation configuration bit for the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG7.name: ZIN animation config 7
ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG7.description: Seventh animation configuration bit for the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG8.name: ZIN animation config 8
ZIN_ANIMATION_CONFIG8.description: Eighth animation configuration bit for the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_VARIANT.name: ZIN display variant
ZIN_VARIANT.description: Selects which ZIN (central information display) hardware variant is fitted. KEIN_ZIN = no ZIN display present; RADIO_ZIN = ZIN display driven by the radio/HU. Not active (no ZIN) on this vehicle.

ZIN_MAX_TARGET_BRIGHTNESS.name: ZIN display maximum target brightness
ZIN_MAX_TARGET_BRIGHTNESS.description: Maximum allowed target brightness level for the ZIN display. Default 0x7F00 (INITWERT = initial/nominal maximum). Used to cap ZIN brightness regardless of the dimming curve output.

ZIN_BLOWER_VARIANT.name: ZIN blower fan variant
ZIN_BLOWER_VARIANT.description: Selects the cooling fan (blower) hardware variant used for the ZIN display. BASE = standard blower; HIGH = high-performance blower (requires different thermal management tuning).

CID_TOUCH_PROXIMITY.name: CID touch proximity sensor
CID_TOUCH_PROXIMITY.description: Enables the proximity (hover) detection sensor on the CID (Central Information Display) touchscreen. When active, the display can detect a hand approaching before physical contact. Not active on this vehicle.

CID_TOUCH_SL.name: CID touchscreen speed-lock enable
CID_TOUCH_SL.description: Enables speed-lock (input restriction at speed) specifically for the CID touchscreen. When active, touch input on the CID may be restricted above a vehicle speed threshold. Not active on this vehicle.

CID_DISP_AR.name: CID display pixel aspect ratio
CID_DISP_AR.description: Configures the pixel aspect ratio correction factor applied to CID display output. RATIO_1_00 = square pixels (1:1); RATIO_1_07 = 1.07:1 non-square correction for panels with non-square pixels.

CID_TOUCH.name: CID touchscreen enable
CID_TOUCH.description: Enables touchscreen functionality on the CID (Central Information Display). Active on vehicles with 601 TV Function or 609 Professional navigation system.

CID_APIX_MODE.name: CID APIX interface mode
CID_APIX_MODE.description: Selects the APIX (Automotive Pixel Link) communication protocol version used between the head unit and the CID display. AUTO lets the HU negotiate; APIX1/2/3 force a specific version.

CID_COLOR_DEPTH.name: CID display color depth
CID_COLOR_DEPTH.description: Selects the color bit depth transmitted over the APIX link to the CID. Raw enum codes present (1, 2) but no symbolic names; default corresponds to 18-bit color (per cur_desc).

CID_COM_MODE.name: CID communication mode
CID_COM_MODE.description: Selects the physical communication interface mode used by the CID controller. Raw codes only (value 2 is the fitted default); no symbolic names available in the firmware descriptor.

CID_DISPLAY_RES.name: CID display resolution
CID_DISPLAY_RES.description: Selects the CID panel resolution. Active on vehicles with 609 Professional navigation. Default value 1 corresponds to 800x480 per cur_desc; raw codes 1-5 cover various resolution options.

CID_DISPLAY_SIZE.name: CID display physical size
CID_DISPLAY_SIZE.description: Selects the CID panel physical size variant. Default code 1 = 6.5-inch panel per cur_desc. Codes 1-4 cover different display sizes. Not active on this vehicle.

DIMMUNGSVARIANTE.name: Display dimming algorithm variant
DIMMUNGSVARIANTE.description: Selects between the old (ALTE_DIMMUNG) and new (NEUE_DIMMUNG) automatic brightness control algorithm. Not active on this vehicle (uses new algorithm by default via DIM_VARIANT).

CID_HMI_ACTIVATION_VIA_TOUCH.name: CID HMI wakeup via touch
CID_HMI_ACTIVATION_VIA_TOUCH.description: Enables waking up the HMI (display/user-interface) from sleep/standby by touching the CID touchscreen. Not active on this vehicle.

RSE_APIX_MODE.name: RSE display APIX interface mode
RSE_APIX_MODE.description: Selects the APIX protocol version for the RSE (Rear-Seat Entertainment) display link. AUTO lets the HU negotiate; APIX1/2/3 force a specific version. Not active on this vehicle.

RSE_COLOR_DEPTH.name: RSE display color depth
RSE_COLOR_DEPTH.description: Selects the color bit depth for the RSE display APIX link. Raw codes only (value 2 is the default). Not active on this vehicle.

RSE_COM_MODE.name: RSE display communication mode
RSE_COM_MODE.description: Selects the physical communication interface for the RSE display controller. SPI = Serial Peripheral Interface; MII = Media Independent Interface (Ethernet-family). Not active on this vehicle.

RSE_DISPLAY_RES.name: RSE display resolution
RSE_DISPLAY_RES.description: Selects the RSE panel resolution. Raw codes 1 and 2; default 2 per cur_desc (800x480 noted). Not active on this vehicle.

RSE_DISPLAY_SIZE.name: RSE display physical size
RSE_DISPLAY_SIZE.description: Selects the RSE panel physical size variant. Raw codes 0-2 available; no symbolic names. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_PERMANENT_DISPLAY.name: ZIN permanent display content
ZIN_PERMANENT_DISPLAY.description: Selects what is permanently shown on the ZIN display when no other priority content is active. OFF = blank; DREHZAHL = rev counter; DRIVING_MODE = current driving mode; ALWAYS_OPEN = always show main view; colour options (BLUE/YELLOW etc.) select a coloured ambient display; JCW = John Cooper Works mode; PHEV = plug-in hybrid display. Not active (no ZIN) on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_HEARTBEAT.name: ZIN heartbeat semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_HEARTBEAT.description: Enables the 'heartbeat' status indicator as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display (shown when no priority content is active). Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_MSA.name: ZIN MSA semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_MSA.description: Enables the MSA (Motor Stop/Start Automatic — auto start-stop status) indicator as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_NAVI.name: ZIN navigation semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_NAVI.description: Enables navigation turn-by-turn instructions as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_PDC_PMA.name: ZIN PDC/PMA semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_PDC_PMA.description: Enables the PDC (Park Distance Control) or PMA (Park Manoeuvre Assist) sensor view as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display during parking. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_TELEPHONE.name: ZIN telephone semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_TELEPHONE.description: Enables telephone/call status as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_USB_BLUETOOT.name: ZIN USB/Bluetooth semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_USB_BLUETOOT.description: Enables USB/Bluetooth media playback status as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_CLIMATE.name: ZIN climate control semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_CLIMATE.description: Enables climate control status (temperature, fan, etc.) as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_AUDIO.name: ZIN audio semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_AUDIO.description: Enables audio/entertainment status (track info, source) as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_SDE.name: ZIN SDE semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_SDE.description: Enables the SDE (Service Display / Sonderdisplay Einheit — special display unit) content as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_ID4.name: ZIN iDrive 4 semi-permanent display
ZIN_SEMI_PERMANENT_DISPLAYS_ID4.description: Enables the iDrive 4 (ID4) menu/status as a semi-permanent overlay on the ZIN display. Not active on this vehicle.

DIM_VARIANT.name: Display dimming algorithm variant (DIM_VARIANT)
DIM_VARIANT.description: Selects the active brightness control algorithm variant. NEW = modern algorithm; OLD = legacy algorithm. Default is OLD (0x01). Controls which dimming state machine path is used by the display manager.

APIX_LENGTH_CID.name: APIX cable length — CID
APIX_LENGTH_CID.description: Configures the APIX cable length compensation setting for the CID (Central Information Display) video link. Correct setting ensures signal integrity over the actual harness length. Not active on this vehicle.

APIX_LENGTH_KOMBI.name: APIX cable length — instrument cluster (KOMBI)
APIX_LENGTH_KOMBI.description: Configures the APIX cable length compensation for the instrument cluster (KOMBI) display link. No symbolic enum names are defined for this field; raw codes 1, 3, 4 are the only documented values. Not active on this vehicle.

APIX_LENGTH_RSE_FOMO_LEFT.name: APIX cable length — RSE FOMO left display
APIX_LENGTH_RSE_FOMO_LEFT.description: Configures the APIX cable length compensation for the left rear-seat entertainment (RSE FOMO — Front Of Monitor Option, left) display link. Not active on this vehicle.

APIX_LENGTH_RSE_FOMO_RIGHT.name: APIX cable length — RSE FOMO right display
APIX_LENGTH_RSE_FOMO_RIGHT.description: Configures the APIX cable length compensation for the right rear-seat entertainment (RSE FOMO right) display link. Raw codes 1, 3, 4 available. Not active on this vehicle.

NAVI_FREE_TEXT_SEARCH.name: Navigation free-text search
NAVI_FREE_TEXT_SEARCH.description: Enables free-text (keyword) destination search in the navigation system, allowing the driver to type arbitrary words rather than structured address fields. Active with navigation option 606 or 609.

NAVI_NEW_START_GUIDANCE.name: Navigation new-start guidance
NAVI_NEW_START_GUIDANCE.description: Enables the revised/new-style route guidance start sequence introduced in the NBT Evo navigation stack (updated turn-by-turn guidance initiation flow). Requires Professional navigation (609).

NAVI_DESTINATION_INPUT_US.name: US-style destination input
NAVI_DESTINATION_INPUT_US.description: Activates the US-market destination entry UI, which uses US-format address input (number before street name) rather than European format. Gated on US vehicle type-key.

NAVI_CONSUMPTION_DIFF.name: Navigation fuel-consumption difference display mode
NAVI_CONSUMPTION_DIFF.description: Controls how the navigation system displays fuel consumption savings for eco-routes: no display, percentage difference, or absolute value difference.

SL03_IMPORT_EXPORT.name: Profile import/export feature
SL03_IMPORT_EXPORT.description: Enables the profile/data import-export feature in the USB portation subsystem. Controls whether the head unit exposes import and export functions for user profile data via USB.

SL17_ASIA_NAVI_POI.name: Asia-market navigation POI
SL17_ASIA_NAVI_POI.description: Enables Asia-market-specific points-of-interest categories and features in the navigation system. Active with Professional navigation (609) or Japanese version (807).

SL18_ASIA_SEARCH.name: Asia-market navigation search
SL18_ASIA_SEARCH.description: Enables Asia-market-specific search features and input methods for navigation (e.g. character-based or phonetic search for Asian languages). Active with navigation options 606/609 or Japanese version.

SL19_ASIA_SETTINGS.name: Asia-market navigation settings
SL19_ASIA_SETTINGS.description: Enables Asia-market-specific navigation settings menus and options (e.g. locale-specific preferences). Active with Professional navigation (609) or Japanese version (807).

FPK_COMING_ROAD_BMP.name: Upcoming road map bitmap display
FPK_COMING_ROAD_BMP.description: Enables a bitmap graphical preview of the upcoming road or manoeuvre (FPK coming-road preview image).

ITS.name: Intelligent Transport System (ITS) support
ITS.description: Enables ITS (Intelligent Transport System) integration in the navigation, which includes infrastructure-based traffic data exchange (V2X / roadside unit communications). Requires Professional navigation (609) or Japanese version.

NAVI_SHOW_GEOCORDINATES.name: Show geographic coordinates
NAVI_SHOW_GEOCORDINATES.description: Shows geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) in navigation, for example for the current position or a chosen destination.

CONTACT_ONLINE_ADDRESS_VALIDATION.name: Online check of contact addresses
CONTACT_ONLINE_ADDRESS_VALIDATION.description: Uses an online service to check addresses from your phone contacts, so they can be used as navigation destinations. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Business or Professional (S606 or S609) and TeleServices (S6AE).

NAVI_MAPMODE_AUTOMATIC.name: Automatic map mode
NAVI_MAPMODE_AUTOMATIC.description: Setting for the navigation map's automatic mode, in which the map picks its display mode on its own. Best left unchanged.

NAVI_MECCA_INDICATOR.name: Qiblah (direction of Mecca)
NAVI_MECCA_INDICATOR.description: Offers the Qiblah display in navigation, which shows the direction of Mecca from the car's position.

NAVI_ALTERNATIVE_ROUTES_FULLSCREEN.name: Full-screen alternative routes view
NAVI_ALTERNATIVE_ROUTES_FULLSCREEN.description: Shows the alternative route suggestions on a full-screen map, so you can compare them more easily before choosing one.

NAVI_TRAFFIC_INFO_MAP.name: Traffic information on the map
NAVI_TRAFFIC_INFO_MAP.description: Shows traffic information, such as congestion and incidents, directly on the navigation map. Set at the factory by market and traffic services, such as Traffic Information (S6UH).

POI_AZ_SEARCH.name: A to Z search for points of interest
POI_AZ_SEARCH.description: Lets you search points of interest by name in an alphabetical list, in addition to browsing them by category.

TI_FMVICS_ENHANCEMENT.name: Enhanced FM VICS traffic info (Japan)
TI_FMVICS_ENHANCEMENT.description: Turns on the enhanced FM radio service of Japan's Vehicle Information and Communication System (VICS) for traffic information. Enabled at the factory for the Japanese version (S807) with Navigation Professional (S609).

ADAS_2DH_NOT_EXPAND_ONEWAY.name: ADAS 2D heading — do not expand one-way streets
ADAS_2DH_NOT_EXPAND_ONEWAY.description: Controls ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) horizon data output: when enabled, the system does not expand one-way street segments in 2D heading mode, preventing incorrect lane-level data being sent to ADAS consumers.

NAVI_MAPSCROLL_LIGHTBEAM.name: Map scroll light-beam effect
NAVI_MAPSCROLL_LIGHTBEAM.description: Enables a visual light-beam/sweep animation effect when scrolling the navigation map, providing smooth map panning feedback.

NAVI_FUELSTOP_PROPOSAL.name: Refueling stop suggestions
NAVI_FUELSTOP_PROPOSAL.description: Lets navigation propose a refueling stop at a fuel station along or near your route.

NAVI_PFEILANSICHT.name: Arrow/schematic map view (Pfeilansicht)
NAVI_PFEILANSICHT.description: Enables the simplified arrow/schematic navigation view as an alternative to the full 2D/3D map view. This stripped-down view shows only directional arrows. Excluded on Business (606) and Professional (609) navigation systems and Asian market variants.

NAVI_KREUZUNGSZOOM.name: Intersection zoom
NAVI_KREUZUNGSZOOM.description: Shows an enlarged view of complex intersections and highway junctions as you approach them during route guidance. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Professional (S609).

NAVI_TRIP_IMPORT.name: Trip import
NAVI_TRIP_IMPORT.description: Lets you import trips, with their destinations and stops, into navigation, for example from a USB device, and then start route guidance with them.

NAVI_TRIP_EXPORT.name: Trip export
NAVI_TRIP_EXPORT.description: Lets you export saved navigation trips, with their destinations and stops, from the head unit, for example to a USB device. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Professional (S609) and in the Asian-market versions.

NAVI_DEST_IMPORT.name: Destination import
NAVI_DEST_IMPORT.description: Lets you import navigation destinations into the head unit, for example from a USB device, so you don't have to enter them by hand. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Business or Professional (S606 or S609) and in the Asian-market versions.

NAVI_DEST_EXPORT.name: Destination export
NAVI_DEST_EXPORT.description: Lets you export saved navigation destinations from the head unit, for example to a USB device, to keep a copy or use them in another car. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Business or Professional (S606 or S609) and in the Asian-market versions.

NAVI_MYPOI_IMPORT.name: My Points of Interest: import
NAVI_MYPOI_IMPORT.description: Lets you import your own points of interest (My Points of Interest) into navigation, for example from a USB device, so they appear on the map and in search.

NAVI_MYPOI_EXPORT.name: My Points of Interest: export
NAVI_MYPOI_EXPORT.description: Lets you export your own points of interest (My Points of Interest) from navigation, for example to a USB device, to keep a copy or move them to another car.

NAVI_ROUTE_RECORD.name: Route recording
NAVI_ROUTE_RECORD.description: Lets navigation record the route you actually drive, so you can save it and use it again later.

NAVI_MAP_ARROWVIEW.name: Arrow display in map views
NAVI_MAP_ARROWVIEW.description: Offers the arrow display among the navigation map views: a simplified view that shows the next maneuver as a large arrow. Set at the factory according to the navigation, such as Navigation Business (S606), and the market. See also “Arrow display guidance” (`3006/2/01000000b`).

NAVI_ELECTRONIC_TOLL_COLLECTION_ROADS.name: Route option: electronic toll roads
NAVI_ELECTRONIC_TOLL_COLLECTION_ROADS.description: Adds roads that collect tolls only electronically to the route options, so route calculation can avoid them when you have no toll tag.

NAVI_FULL_GUIDINGPOPUP.name: Full guidance pop-up
NAVI_FULL_GUIDINGPOPUP.description: Shows the route guidance instruction for the next maneuver as a full pop-up on the central display. Set at the factory according to Navigation Business (S606) and the instrument cluster with extended features (S6WA).

NAVI_ROUTE_STUDY.name: Route study
NAVI_ROUTE_STUDY.description: Navigation setting for the route study feature. Best left unchanged.

SLI_NAVI_DISPLAY.name: Speed limit info on navigation display (SLI)
SLI_NAVI_DISPLAY.description: Enables the Speed Limit Information (SLI) display on the navigation screen, showing the current road speed limit retrieved from the navigation map data.

INCREMENTAL_UPDATE.name: Incremental map updates
INCREMENTAL_UPDATE.description: Lets the navigation map be updated in parts rather than replaced as a whole. Best left unchanged.

ECO_ROUTE_TEXT.name: Eco route info text
ECO_ROUTE_TEXT.description: Shows an information text about the eco route in navigation.

M_LAPTIMER.name: M Laptimer
M_LAPTIMER.description: Navigation setting for the M Laptimer, which records lap times and driving data. Best left unchanged.

NAVI_SAVE_TRIP.name: Save trip to memory
NAVI_SAVE_TRIP.description: Enables the ability to save a completed navigation trip to internal memory for later retrieval or repeat navigation. Requires Professional navigation (609).

AVOID_VIGNETTE.name: Route option: avoid vignette roads
AVOID_VIGNETTE.description: Adds “Avoid vignette roads” to the route options, so route guidance can stay off roads that need a vignette, the prepaid toll sticker some countries require on highways. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Business or Professional (S606 or S609) on some models.

MAP_SCROLL_3D.name: Map scrolling in 3D view
MAP_SCROLL_3D.description: Lets you move the navigation map around with the controller while it's shown in the 3D perspective view.

ZIELEINGABE_MEHRDEUTIG.name: Ambiguous destination entry
ZIELEINGABE_MEHRDEUTIG.description: Setting for how destination entry handles ambiguous input, such as a place name that matches several locations. Best left unchanged.

NAVI_POI_ONLINE_SEARCH.name: POI online search mode (Japan)
NAVI_POI_ONLINE_SEARCH.description: Controls whether the navigation system's online POI search for Japan uses the integrated browser or a native (built-in) search UI. Japan-specific; uses the configured online POI service.

ADAS_OUTPUT_LANE_POS.name: ADAS lane position output
ADAS_OUTPUT_LANE_POS.description: Enables output of the vehicle's estimated lane position data from the ADAS/ADASIS horizon to lane-departure or driver-assistance consumers.

NAVI_EXPRESS_ROADS.name: Express/highway-specific road category
NAVI_EXPRESS_ROADS.description: Enables the express road (limited-access highway / express route) road category in navigation routing and avoidance preferences. Gated on specific vehicle type-key (US market).

NAVI_CARPOOL_ROADS.name: Route option: avoid carpool roads
NAVI_CARPOOL_ROADS.description: Adds “Avoid carpool roads” to the route options, so route guidance can stay off roads reserved for vehicles with several occupants.

NAVI_AUGMENTED_REALITY.name: Augmented-reality navigation view
NAVI_AUGMENTED_REALITY.description: Shows navigation directions over a live camera image of the road ahead. Enable it only when the car's camera and navigation support it.

POI_BRAND_DEALERS.name: Brand dealers as points of interest
POI_BRAND_DEALERS.description: Includes dealers of the car's brand, such as BMW or MINI dealers, as a point-of-interest category, so you can find one and start route guidance to it.

NAVI_AUTOZOOM.name: Auto zoom map view
NAVI_AUTOZOOM.description: Offers the auto zoom map view, which changes the map scale on its own during route guidance. See also “Automatic map zoom” (`3006/9/01000000b`). Enabled at the factory except in the Asian-market versions.

NAVI_SCROLLING_ALONG_ROUTE.name: Scrolling along planned route
NAVI_SCROLLING_ALONG_ROUTE.description: Enables the navigation map to automatically scroll/advance along the planned route ahead of the vehicle, previewing upcoming road segments. Active on Asian/Korean market variants.

NAVI_ROUTENMAGNET.name: Route magnet
NAVI_ROUTENMAGNET.description: Offers the route magnet in navigation, which lets you pull the planned route in any direction so it runs through an area you choose. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Business or Professional (S606 or S609) and in the Asian-market versions.

NAVI_ALERT_POI.name: Point-of-interest alerts
NAVI_ALERT_POI.description: Lets navigation alert you as you approach certain points of interest.

NAVI_AVOID_AREA.name: Avoid areas
NAVI_AVOID_AREA.description: Lets you mark areas on the map for route calculation to avoid, such as a district you would rather not drive through. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Professional (S609) and in the Asian-market versions.

NAVI_ONLINE_OPTIMIZATION_BUTTON.name: Online route optimization button
NAVI_ONLINE_OPTIMIZATION_BUTTON.description: Shows a button in navigation that has the route optimized by an online service. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Professional (S609).

NAVI_REICHWEITENKARTE.name: Range map
NAVI_REICHWEITENKARTE.description: Shows a range map in navigation that marks the area you can reach with the remaining charge or fuel.

NAVI_ROUTE_EXPORT.name: Route export
NAVI_ROUTE_EXPORT.description: Lets you export a planned navigation route from the head unit, for example to a USB device, so you can keep it or use it again later.

NAVI_GEO_COORDINATE_INPUT.name: Coordinate entry for destinations
NAVI_GEO_COORDINATE_INPUT.description: Lets you enter a navigation destination as geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) instead of an address.

GYRO_INTERN.name: Built-in gyro sensor
GYRO_INTERN.description: Tells navigation that the head unit has its own gyro sensor, which keeps the position accurate through turns and where GPS reception is weak, such as in tunnels. Enable it only when the head unit has one.

ETC.name: ETC (Electronic Toll Collection) transponder fitted (Japan)
ETC.description: Indicates that a Japanese ETC toll transponder (in-vehicle unit) is fitted, enabling the navigation system to display ETC-lane guidance and communicate with the transponder. Japan-specific; requires Professional navigation (609) or Japanese version (807) and Japan ETC mirror option (449).

NAVI_RNC_MAINMAP_TEXT.name: Navigation road name text on main map (RNC)
NAVI_RNC_MAINMAP_TEXT.description: Controls display of road name text rendered directly on the main navigation map (RNC = Raster Navigation Content). Off = no overlay; Permanent = always show road names.

NAVI_VARIANTE.name: Navigation map variant / regional edition
NAVI_VARIANTE.description: Selects the regional navigation map edition and feature set. Determines which geographic map data set and market-specific navigation features are activated.

TRAFFIC_CATEGORIES.name: Traffic categories filter
TRAFFIC_CATEGORIES.description: Enables user-selectable traffic event category filters in the navigation traffic display, allowing the driver to show/hide specific traffic event types.

AUTO_MAP_ZOOM.name: Automatic map zoom
AUTO_MAP_ZOOM.description: Lets the navigation map change its scale on its own while you drive. See also “Auto zoom map view” (`3006/6/00000010b`).

TIME_DEPENDING_ROUTING.name: Time-dependent routing
TIME_DEPENDING_ROUTING.description: Enables time-dependent (historical traffic pattern) routing, where the navigation system uses historical speed/flow data for the time of day and day of week to calculate faster routes.

TI_CA_TMC_FRANCE_MEDIAMOBILE.name: Encrypted TMC: France (Mediamobile)
TI_CA_TMC_FRANCE_MEDIAMOBILE.description: Lets navigation decode the encrypted TMC traffic service from Mediamobile in France, broadcast over FM radio, for more detailed traffic information there.

TI_CA_TMC_UK_ITIS.name: Traffic CA / TMC UK (ITIS)
TI_CA_TMC_UK_ITIS.description: Enables the ITIS conditional-access TMC provider for the UK, used to decode the UK encrypted FM-TMC traffic data broadcasts.

STREET_NAME_VOICE_GUIDING.name: Street names in voice guidance
STREET_NAME_VOICE_GUIDING.description: Has the voice guidance say street names along with the turn instructions, for example “Turn right onto Main Street”.

LAST_DESTINATION.name: Last destination
LAST_DESTINATION.description: Lets navigation offer your last destination for quick reuse, so you can restart route guidance to it without entering it again.

REICHWEITENKARTE_SCALE_MAX.name: Range map maximum scale
REICHWEITENKARTE_SCALE_MAX.description: Sets the maximum map scale level (zoom-out limit) for the range/reachability map (Reichweitenkarte) display. Numeric value 0-5 where higher = more zoomed out.

GUIDED_TOURS.name: Guided tours
GUIDED_TOURS.description: Makes guided tours available in navigation: prepared routes with several stops that you can pick and then follow with route guidance.

POI_DETAILS.name: Details for points of interest
POI_DETAILS.description: Shows a details page for points of interest, with information such as the address and phone number where the map data includes it.

IPD_BEHANDLUNG.name: IPD data handling
IPD_BEHANDLUNG.description: Setting for how navigation handles IPD areas on a route, including guidance when entering and leaving them. Best left unchanged.

ROUTEN_ID_GUIDEDTOURS.name: Guided tours route ID
ROUTEN_ID_GUIDEDTOURS.description: Enables the route ID subsystem for the guided tours feature, associating tours with unique identifiers for tracking and management.

ALTERNATIV_ROUTEN.name: Alternative routes
ALTERNATIV_ROUTEN.description: Enables the navigation system's alternative-routes feature, allowing the driver to view and select alternative route proposals during guidance.

EINHEITEN_WEGSTRECKE.name: Distance unit system
EINHEITEN_WEGSTRECKE.description: Selects the measurement unit used for distance and navigation guidance — kilometres, miles/yards, or miles/feet — depending on market region.

ROTATION_WERTE_EINHEITEN.name: Rotate/cycle measurement units
ROTATION_WERTE_EINHEITEN.description: When enabled, allows the system to rotate or cycle through available measurement-unit choices for displayed values. Inactive on this vehicle.

TYPE_OF_FUEL.name: Vehicle fuel type
TYPE_OF_FUEL.description: Specifies the vehicle's fuel type for navigation purposes, primarily used to filter and display relevant POIs (e.g. petrol stations, charging stations) on the map.

TIMER_VOLLBILDKARTE.name: Full-screen map auto-exit timer
TIMER_VOLLBILDKARTE.description: Timeout in seconds before the full-screen map view automatically exits and returns to the split-screen or normal view. A value of 0xFF (255) keeps the full-screen map permanently active.

SPEEDLOCK_X_KMH_MIN.name: Speed lock: navigation lower threshold
SPEEDLOCK_X_KMH_MIN.description: Sets the lower speed threshold for the navigation speed lock, which restricts some navigation inputs while the car is moving. It works together with the upper threshold. Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SPEEDLOCK_X_KMH_MAX.name: Speed lock: navigation upper threshold
SPEEDLOCK_X_KMH_MAX.description: Sets the upper speed threshold for the navigation speed lock, which restricts some navigation inputs while the car is moving. It works together with the lower threshold. Set at the factory for the Korean, Japanese and Chinese versions (S802, S807 or S8AA). Rules on driver distraction vary by country.

SYSTEM_GPS_RECEIVER.name: GPS receiver present
SYSTEM_GPS_RECEIVER.description: Indicates whether an integrated GPS receiver is fitted in the system. Enables GPS-based positioning for navigation.

SERVICE_MENUE.name: Service menu enable
SERVICE_MENUE.description: Enables the hidden service/diagnostic menu accessible within the head-unit UI, providing additional diagnostic and calibration options.

ENTWICKLER_MENUE.name: Developer menu enable
ENTWICKLER_MENUE.description: Enables the developer/engineering menu in the head-unit UI, providing advanced diagnostic and development options. Gated by NBT-Evo Head-unit variant FA options.

ENTWICKLER_MENUE_ASIEN.name: Developer menu enable (Asia variant)
ENTWICKLER_MENUE_ASIEN.description: Enables an Asia-market-specific variant of the developer/engineering menu. Inactive on non-Asian market vehicles.

ECO_PRO_ROUTE_ALPINE.name: ECO PRO route (Asian-market navigation)
ECO_PRO_ROUTE_ALPINE.description: Offers the ECO PRO route type, which favors fuel-saving roads, in the navigation used for Asian markets. Enabled at the factory for the Asian-market versions.

MAPVIEWER_FARBSET_AUSWAHL.name: Map colour scheme selection
MAPVIEWER_FARBSET_AUSWAHL.description: Enables user-selectable colour schemes (day/night/auto themes) for the map viewer display.

DISPLAY_SIZE_RESOLUTION.name: Display size and resolution
DISPLAY_SIZE_RESOLUTION.description: Specifies the physical display size and pixel resolution used by the system for rendering. Value 2 is the default (6.5-inch main NBT display); values 4 and 5 are rear-seat entertainment (RSE) screen sizes.

FAVORED_POI.name: Favourite POI
FAVORED_POI.description: Enables the Favourite POI feature in navigation, allowing users to mark and quickly access preferred points of interest. Gated by Business or Professional navigation system FA options.

CAR_TYPE_POI.name: Vehicle type for POI filter
CAR_TYPE_POI.description: Selects which type of refuelling/recharging infrastructure the POI (points of interest) system prioritises based on the vehicle's powertrain type.

ADAPTIV_DESTINATION.name: Adaptive destination prediction
ADAPTIV_DESTINATION.description: Enables the adaptive destination feature, which learns the driver's frequent destinations and proactively suggests navigation targets based on driving patterns.

ADAPTIV_MAP.name: Adaptive map content
ADAPTIV_MAP.description: Enables adaptive map display, where map content (zoom level, shown detail, overlays) adjusts automatically based on driving context and learned behaviour.

TI_DYNAMIC_ROUTING.name: Traffic information dynamic routing
TI_DYNAMIC_ROUTING.description: Enables dynamic re-routing based on real-time traffic information, allowing the navigation system to automatically calculate alternative routes around congestion.

MANEUVER_LIST.name: Manoeuvre list
MANEUVER_LIST.description: Enables the turn-by-turn manoeuvre list view in navigation, showing a scrollable list of upcoming guidance steps. Gated by Business navigation or Chinese-market FA.

RANGE_CORRECTION_KI.name: Range estimate correction
RANGE_CORRECTION_KI.description: Setting for how the range assistant corrects its range estimate. Best left unchanged.

LETZTE_LADESTATIONEN.name: Recent charging stations history
LETZTE_LADESTATIONEN.description: Enables display of recently visited charging stations as a quick-access list in navigation POI search, aiding EV drivers in finding familiar charging locations. Inactive on this vehicle.

ADAS_2D_HORIZON.name: ADAS 2D road horizon data
ADAS_2D_HORIZON.description: Enables the 2D road horizon interface for ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems), providing the navigation map's road geometry data to ADAS functions for predictive control (e.g. predictive speed control on curves).

ADAS_1D_HORIZON.name: ADAS 1D road horizon data
ADAS_1D_HORIZON.description: Enables the 1D (linear) road horizon interface for ADAS, providing simplified ahead-road curvature and slope data to driver assistance systems.

ADAS_GPS.name: ADAS GPS position output
ADAS_GPS.description: Enables transmission of the GPS position data to ADAS functions, allowing predictive driver-assistance systems to use the navigation system's position fix.

ADAS_SYS_INF.name: ADAS system information output
ADAS_SYS_INF.description: Enables the ADAS system-information channel, through which the navigation system reports status and diagnostic information to ADAS modules.

ADAS_CUR_SEG.name: ADAS current road segment data
ADAS_CUR_SEG.description: Enables output of the current road-segment data (road class, speed limit, geometry) from navigation to ADAS systems for predictive control.

IAK_FANGMODUS.name: IAK capture mode
IAK_FANGMODUS.description: Setting for the navigation map's IAK capture mode, used when picking places on the map. Best left unchanged.

RANGE_ASSISTANT.name: EV range assistant
RANGE_ASSISTANT.description: Enables the Range Assistant feature for electric vehicles, providing guidance on whether the destination is reachable on current battery charge and suggesting charging stops if needed. Inactive on this vehicle.

RETURN_JOURNEY.name: Return journey planning
RETURN_JOURNEY.description: Enables the Return Journey feature in navigation, allowing the driver to easily plan a route back to a previously set home or departure point. Inactive on this vehicle.

ADAS_1DH_PHEV_EXT.name: ADAS 1D horizon PHEV extension
ADAS_1DH_PHEV_EXT.description: Enables an extended 1D road horizon data set for plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEV), providing additional look-ahead data to optimise electric/combustion mode switching. Inactive on this vehicle.

ROUTE_FLIGHT.name: Route flight view
ROUTE_FLIGHT.description: Offers the route flight, an animated view that flies along the planned route on the navigation map.

EV_CONFIG.name: EV charging configuration
EV_CONFIG.description: Specifies the electric vehicle charging hardware type, used by navigation to filter and display compatible charging station POIs. Inactive on this vehicle (no EV drivetrain).

TI_CAT_DEFAULT_WEATHER.name: TI default category: Weather
TI_CAT_DEFAULT_WEATHER.description: Enables weather as a default-enabled traffic information (TI) category in the connected navigation service, so weather overlays are shown by default on the map.

TI_CAT_VMAP_WEATHER.name: TI virtual map category: Weather
TI_CAT_VMAP_WEATHER.description: Enables weather as a selectable category on the virtual map (VMAP) traffic information overlay layer, allowing weather data to be shown on the interactive online map.

TI_CAT_VMAP_PARK_PUBL.name: TI virtual map category: Public parking
TI_CAT_VMAP_PARK_PUBL.description: Enables public parking as a selectable category on the virtual map (VMAP) traffic information overlay, showing real-time parking availability data.

TI_CAT_VMAP_ONROUTE.name: TI virtual map category: On-route info
TI_CAT_VMAP_ONROUTE.description: Enables on-route information as a selectable category on the virtual map (VMAP) traffic information overlay, highlighting relevant incidents or services along the active route. Inactive on this vehicle.

TI_CAT_DEFAULT_FLOW.name: TI default category: Traffic flow
TI_CAT_DEFAULT_FLOW.description: Enables traffic flow (congestion level) as a default-enabled traffic information category, showing current road speed/flow data on the map by default.

TI_CAT_DEFAULT_FORECAST.name: TI default category: Traffic forecast
TI_CAT_DEFAULT_FORECAST.description: Enables traffic forecast (predicted future congestion) as a default-enabled traffic information category on the map.

TI_CAT_DEFAULT_INCIDENTS.name: TI default category: Traffic incidents
TI_CAT_DEFAULT_INCIDENTS.description: Enables traffic incidents (accidents, hazards) as a default-enabled traffic information category, showing incident markers on the map by default.

TI_CAT_DEFAULT_ROADWORKS.name: TI default category: Roadworks
TI_CAT_DEFAULT_ROADWORKS.description: Enables roadworks (construction zones) as a default-enabled traffic information category, showing roadwork markers on the map by default.

TI_CAT_DEFAULT_CLOSED.name: TI default category: Road closures
TI_CAT_DEFAULT_CLOSED.description: Enables road closures as a default-enabled traffic information category, showing closed-road markers on the map by default.

TI_CAT_DEFAULT_PARK_PUBL.name: TI default category: Public parking
TI_CAT_DEFAULT_PARK_PUBL.description: Enables public parking availability as a default-enabled traffic information category on the map.

TI_CAT_DEFAULT_ONROUTE.name: TI default category: On-route info
TI_CAT_DEFAULT_ONROUTE.description: Enables on-route information as a default-enabled traffic information category, highlighting relevant events along the active navigation route by default.

TI_BEACONS_JAPAN.name: Traffic information via VICS beacons (Japan)
TI_BEACONS_JAPAN.description: Enables reception of traffic information via Japanese VICS (Vehicle Information and Communication System) roadside IR/radio beacons, used for real-time traffic data in Japan.

TI_TMC.name: Traffic information via TMC
TI_TMC.description: Enables reception of traffic information via TMC (Traffic Message Channel) — a broadcast FM radio-based traffic data standard used primarily in Europe.

TI_CA_TMC.name: Traffic information via CA-TMC (Canada TMC)
TI_CA_TMC.description: Enables Canada-specific TMC traffic information reception. Inactive on this vehicle (European/US market).

TI_TPEG.name: Traffic information via TPEG
TI_TPEG.description: Enables reception of traffic and travel information via TPEG (Transport Protocol Experts Group) — a digital broadcast data format for real-time traffic information, typically over DAB/DARC.

TI_CA_TPEG.name: Traffic information via CA-TPEG (Canada TPEG)
TI_CA_TPEG.description: Enables Canada-specific TPEG traffic information reception. Inactive on this vehicle.

TI_TMC_REGIONAL.name: Traffic information: Regional TMC enabled
TI_TMC_REGIONAL.description: Enables regional TMC traffic information reception, allowing market-specific or region-specific TMC data to supplement the main TMC feed.

TI_FALLBACK_DISABLED.name: Traffic information: Fallback disabled
TI_FALLBACK_DISABLED.description: When enabled, disables the fallback mechanism that switches to an alternative traffic information source (e.g. TMC fallback) when the primary source is unavailable.

TI_USE_COMBI_DISABLED.name: Traffic information: Combined source disabled
TI_USE_COMBI_DISABLED.description: When enabled, disables the combined (combi) traffic information source mode, preventing the system from merging multiple traffic data streams. Inactive on this vehicle.

TI_VICS.name: Traffic information via VICS (Japan)
TI_VICS.description: Enables reception of VICS (Vehicle Information and Communication System) traffic data in Japan, including radio-wave and optical beacon traffic information. Inactive on this vehicle.

TI_VINFO.name: Traffic information via Vinfo (online service)
TI_VINFO.description: Enables Vinfo — BMW's online connected traffic information service — as a traffic data source, providing live data via the telematics connection.

TI_CAT_VMAP_FLOW.name: TI virtual map category: Traffic flow
TI_CAT_VMAP_FLOW.description: Enables traffic flow as a selectable category on the virtual map (VMAP) online traffic overlay. Inactive on this vehicle.

TI_CAT_VMAP_FORECAST.name: TI virtual map category: Traffic forecast
TI_CAT_VMAP_FORECAST.description: Enables traffic forecast as a selectable category on the virtual map (VMAP) online traffic overlay layer.

TI_CAT_VMAP_INCIDENTS.name: TI virtual map category: Traffic incidents
TI_CAT_VMAP_INCIDENTS.description: Enables traffic incidents as a selectable category on the virtual map (VMAP) online traffic overlay layer.

TI_CAT_VMAP_ROADWORKS.name: TI virtual map category: Roadworks
TI_CAT_VMAP_ROADWORKS.description: Enables roadworks as a selectable category on the virtual map (VMAP) online traffic overlay layer.

TI_CAT_VMAP_CLOSED.name: TI virtual map category: Road closures
TI_CAT_VMAP_CLOSED.description: Enables road closures as a selectable category on the virtual map (VMAP) online traffic overlay layer.

TI_CAT_VMAP_FREEFLOW.name: TI virtual map category: Free-flow traffic
TI_CAT_VMAP_FREEFLOW.description: Enables free-flow traffic (roads running at or above speed limit with no congestion) as a selectable category on the virtual map overlay. Inactive on this vehicle.

TI_CAT_DEFAULT_FREEFLOW.name: TI default category: Free-flow traffic
TI_CAT_DEFAULT_FREEFLOW.description: Enables free-flow traffic as a default-enabled traffic information category on the map, showing roads with no congestion in a distinct colour.

TI_DETOUR_BUTTON_DISABLED.name: Traffic detour button disabled
TI_DETOUR_BUTTON_DISABLED.description: When enabled, hides or disables the manual traffic-detour request button in the navigation UI, preventing the driver from manually triggering an alternative route around a reported incident. Inactive on this vehicle.

TPEG_TAP.name: TPEG TAP (TPEG Application Profile) enable
TPEG_TAP.description: Enables TPEG TAP — a specific TPEG application profile used to deliver structured traffic and travel information from the telematics/TeleServices connection. Gated by 6AE TeleServices FA option.

COUNTRY.name: Market country code
COUNTRY.description: Specifies the country/market for which this head-unit is configured, enabling country-specific navigation, traffic, and regulatory features. Inactive on this vehicle (field not active on European non-country-specific FA).

LANGUAGE_GERMAN.name: German language availability
LANGUAGE_GERMAN.description: Controls whether German is available as a selectable UI language. When set to MASTER (1), German is the primary/default language slot; LIST (2) makes it a secondary selectable option.

LANGUAGE_ENGLISH_UK.name: English (UK) language availability
LANGUAGE_ENGLISH_UK.description: Controls whether British English is available as a selectable UI language. MASTER (1) = primary slot, LIST (2) = secondary option. Always active with no FA gate restriction; default value is 01 (MASTER), making UK English the unconditional primary language.

LANGUAGE_ENGLISH_US.name: English (US) language availability
LANGUAGE_ENGLISH_US.description: Controls whether American English is available as a selectable UI language. Separate from UK English; allows market-specific default spellings and terminology (e.g. 'gas' vs 'petrol' prompts in navigation).

LANGUAGE_SPANISH.name: Spanish language availability
LANGUAGE_SPANISH.description: Controls whether Spanish is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 856 (Language version Spanish) or any of the listed language FA options.

LANGUAGE_FRENCH.name: French language availability
LANGUAGE_FRENCH.description: Controls whether French is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 854 (Language version French) or when other listed language options are present.

LANGUAGE_ITALIAN.name: Italian language availability
LANGUAGE_ITALIAN.description: Controls whether Italian is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 855 (Language version Italian) or when other listed language options are present.

LANGUAGE_HUNGARIAN.name: Hungarian language availability
LANGUAGE_HUNGARIAN.description: Controls whether Hungarian is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 8A2 (Language version Hungarian) or when other listed language options are present.

LANGUAGE_POLISH.name: Polish language availability
LANGUAGE_POLISH.description: Controls whether Polish is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 8A1 (Language version Polish) or when other listed language options are present.

LANGUAGE_PORTUGUESE.name: Portuguese (European) language availability
LANGUAGE_PORTUGUESE.description: Controls whether European Portuguese is available as a selectable UI language. Distinct from Brazilian Portuguese (LANGUAGE_PORTUGUESE_BR at 3007/6/00110000b). Enabled by FA option 6S3.

LANGUAGE_RUSSIAN.name: Russian language availability
LANGUAGE_RUSSIAN.description: Controls whether Russian is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 6UD (Language version Russian).

LANGUAGE_SWEDISH.name: Swedish language availability
LANGUAGE_SWEDISH.description: Controls whether Swedish is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 6S4 (Language version Swedish).

LANGUAGE_TURKISH.name: Turkish language availability
LANGUAGE_TURKISH.description: Controls whether Turkish is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 6S1 (Language version Turkish). The syset descriptor only supplies the symbolic name for value 2 (LIST); values 0 and 1 are inferred from the common LANGUAGE_ field pattern.

LANGUAGE_GREEK.name: Greek language availability
LANGUAGE_GREEK.description: Controls whether Greek is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 6S2 (Language version Greek).

LANGUAGE_ARABIC.name: Arabic language availability
LANGUAGE_ARABIC.description: Controls whether Arabic is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 8A3 (Arabic language version). Not active on this vehicle.

LANGUAGE_CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED.name: Simplified Chinese language availability
LANGUAGE_CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED.description: Controls whether Simplified Chinese (Mandarin, PRC) is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 866 or country control codes 8LH/8LT (China/Taiwan markets). Descriptor confirms value 1 as MASTER.

LANGUAGE_CHINESE_TRADITIONAL.name: Traditional Chinese language availability
LANGUAGE_CHINESE_TRADITIONAL.description: Controls whether Traditional Chinese (Taiwan/Hong Kong markets) is available as a selectable UI language. Active when FA option 866 (Simplified Chinese) is NOT present — Traditional and Simplified Chinese are mutually exclusive variants.

LANGUAGE_JAPANESE.name: Japanese language availability
LANGUAGE_JAPANESE.description: Controls whether Japanese is available as a selectable UI language. Not active on this vehicle. The syset descriptor explicitly names only value 0 (NICHT_AKTIV) for this field, indicating no other values are documented in the descriptor.

LANGUAGE_KOREAN.name: Korean language availability
LANGUAGE_KOREAN.description: Controls whether Korean is available as a selectable UI language. Not active on this vehicle.

LANGUAGE_CZECH.name: Czech language availability
LANGUAGE_CZECH.description: Controls whether Czech is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 8A4 (Language version Czech).

LANGUAGE_SLOVENIAN.name: Slovenian language availability
