LANGUAGE_SLOVENIAN.description: Controls whether Slovenian is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 8A6 (Slovenian language version).

LANGUAGE_SLOVAKIAN.name: Slovakian language availability
LANGUAGE_SLOVAKIAN.description: Controls whether Slovakian is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 8A5 (Language version Slovakian).

LANGUAGE_DANISH.name: Danish language availability
LANGUAGE_DANISH.description: Controls whether Danish is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 8A8 (Danish language version).

LANGUAGE_FINNISH.name: Finnish language availability
LANGUAGE_FINNISH.description: Controls whether Finnish is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 8A9 (Finnish language version).

LANGUAGE_NORWEGIAN.name: Norwegian language availability
LANGUAGE_NORWEGIAN.description: Controls whether Norwegian is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 8A7 (Norwegian language version).

LANGUAGE_ISPEECH_RU_RU.name: iSpeech Russian voice recognition enable
LANGUAGE_ISPEECH_RU_RU.description: Enables the Russian (ru-RU) iSpeech voice recognition engine. iSpeech is BMW's speech processing subsystem; this flag enables the Russian language pack for voice commands.

LANGUAGE_ISPEECH_PT_PT.name: iSpeech Portuguese voice recognition enable
LANGUAGE_ISPEECH_PT_PT.description: Enables the European Portuguese (pt-PT) iSpeech voice recognition engine. Separate from Brazilian Portuguese; enables voice commands in Portuguese for EU/Portugal market vehicles.

LANGUAGE_PORTUGUESE_BR.name: Brazilian Portuguese language availability
LANGUAGE_PORTUGUESE_BR.description: Controls whether Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) is available as a selectable UI language. Distinct from European Portuguese (LANGUAGE_PORTUGUESE). Enabled by country control 8LB (Brazil) or when not gated out by European language FA options.

LANGUAGE_INDONESIAN.name: Bahasa Indonesian language availability
LANGUAGE_INDONESIAN.description: Controls whether Bahasa Indonesian is available as a selectable UI language. Enabled by FA option 6S5. Not active on this vehicle. This coord has the most complete enum descriptor in the page, explicitly naming all four values including an unusual value 3 ('LANGUAGE_DUTCH') which the firmware descriptor defines as a named state for this field.

LANGUAGE_THAI.name: Thai language availability
LANGUAGE_THAI.description: Controls whether Thai is available as a selectable UI language. Not active on this vehicle.

FES_FEATURE.name: Driving Experience Control
FES_FEATURE.description: Tells the head unit the car has Driving Experience Control, the switch that selects driving modes such as COMFORT, SPORT and ECO PRO. The head unit's driving mode displays and settings depend on it, so set it to match the car.

FES_SPORT_BASE.name: SPORT BASE driving mode available
FES_SPORT_BASE.description: Enables the SPORT (base) driving mode in the Driving Experience Control menu. When active, the standard SPORT programme is offered as a selectable mode.

FES_SPORT_EXPERT.name: SPORT EXPERT driving mode available
FES_SPORT_EXPERT.description: Enables the SPORT Expert (enhanced/advanced) driving mode in the Driving Experience Control menu, providing the more aggressive dynamic programme.

FES_SPORT_CUSTOM.name: SPORT CUSTOM driving mode available
FES_SPORT_CUSTOM.description: Enables a user-configurable SPORT CUSTOM driving mode in the Driving Experience Control menu, allowing individual sub-system settings within the SPORT programme.

FES_COMFORT_BASE.name: COMFORT BASE driving mode available
FES_COMFORT_BASE.description: Enables the COMFORT (base) driving mode in the Driving Experience Control menu. Standard COMFORT programme selection.

FES_COMFORT_PLUS.name: COMFORT PLUS driving mode available
FES_COMFORT_PLUS.description: Enables the COMFORT PLUS (enhanced comfort) driving mode within the Driving Experience Control system.

FES_ECO_BASE.name: ECO PRO BASE driving mode available
FES_ECO_BASE.description: Enables the ECO PRO (base) driving mode in the Driving Experience Control menu. Base efficiency programme offering fuel-saving coaching.

FES_ECO_PLUS.name: ECO PRO PLUS driving mode available
FES_ECO_PLUS.description: Enables the ECO PRO PLUS driving mode, which adds extended coasting/sailing and additional energy-saving measures beyond ECO PRO base.

FES_ECO_CUSTOM.name: ECO PRO CUSTOM driving mode available
FES_ECO_CUSTOM.description: Enables a user-configurable ECO PRO CUSTOM driving mode, letting the driver individually adjust ECO-related sub-systems.

FES_ADAPTIVE.name: ADAPTIVE driving mode available
FES_ADAPTIVE.description: Enables the ADAPTIVE driving mode, which dynamically adjusts suspension, steering, and drivetrain based on current driving style.

SPORT_CONF_ATTENUATION.name: SPORT mode: damper/chassis attenuation configurable
SPORT_CONF_ATTENUATION.description: When set, the suspension/chassis attenuation (damper) setting is individually adjustable within the SPORT driving mode configuration.

SPORT_CONF_STEERING.name: SPORT mode: steering configurable
SPORT_CONF_STEERING.description: When set, the steering weight/ratio is individually configurable within the SPORT driving mode.

SPORT_CONF_ENGINE.name: SPORT mode: engine response configurable
SPORT_CONF_ENGINE.description: When set, the engine throttle/response mapping is individually configurable within the SPORT driving mode.

SPORT_CONF_GEAR_TYPE.name: SPORT mode: transmission type
SPORT_CONF_GEAR_TYPE.description: Identifies the gearbox type present, which determines which SPORT mode gear-shift configuration options are offered (manual vs automatic Sport programmes).

SPORT_CONF_SEAT.name: SPORT mode: driver seat configurable
SPORT_CONF_SEAT.description: When set, the front driver's seat (bolster/position) is individually adjustable within the SPORT driving mode configuration.

SPORT_CONF_MSA.name: SPORT mode: auto start/stop (MSA) configurable
SPORT_CONF_MSA.description: When set, the auto start/stop (MSA — Motor-Start-Automatik) function is individually selectable within the SPORT driving mode.

ECO_CONF_ATTENUATION.name: ECO PRO mode: damper/chassis attenuation configurable
ECO_CONF_ATTENUATION.description: When set, the suspension/chassis attenuation (damper) setting is individually adjustable within the ECO PRO driving mode configuration.

ECO_CONF_STEERING.name: ECO PRO mode: steering configurable
ECO_CONF_STEERING.description: When set, the steering weight is individually configurable within the ECO PRO driving mode.

ECO_CONF_SAILING.name: ECO PRO mode: coasting/sailing configurable
ECO_CONF_SAILING.description: When set, the engine sailing/coasting function (engine-off coasting to save fuel) is individually selectable within the ECO PRO mode.

ECO_CONF_SEATHEATING.name: ECO PRO mode: seat heating configurable
ECO_CONF_SEATHEATING.description: When set, seat heating availability/behaviour is configurable within the ECO PRO driving mode (seat heating may be reduced to save energy).

ECO_CONF_CLIMATE.name: ECO PRO mode: climate control configurable
ECO_CONF_CLIMATE.description: When set, the climate control (AC compressor / heating) setting is individually configurable within the ECO PRO mode.

ECO_CONF_LIGHT_SIGHT.name: ECO PRO mode: lights and visibility scope
ECO_CONF_LIGHT_SIGHT.description: Selects which energy consumers ECO PRO mode governs: either lights and visibility systems (e.g. rear defroster), or visibility systems only.

ECO_CONF_LIMIT.name: ECO PRO mode: speed limiter configurable
ECO_CONF_LIMIT.description: When set, the speed limiter function is individually configurable within the ECO PRO driving mode (ECO speed cap).

ECO_CONF_VZA.name: ECO PRO mode: speed limit assistant (VZA) configurable
ECO_CONF_VZA.description: When set, the speed limit assistant (VZA — Verkehrszeichen-Assistent / traffic-sign recognition) behaviour is configurable within ECO PRO mode.

ECO_CONF_CID_TIPPS.name: ECO PRO mode: CID tips/hints active
ECO_CONF_CID_TIPPS.description: Controls whether ECO PRO tips and coaching hints are shown on the Central Information Display (CID). When inactive, the on-screen ECO coaching overlay is suppressed.

SPORT_CONF_SEAT_CODRIVER.name: SPORT mode: co-driver seat configurable
SPORT_CONF_SEAT_CODRIVER.description: When set, the front passenger (co-driver) seat bolster/position is individually adjustable within the SPORT driving mode configuration.

FES_CONF_RESET.name: Driving Experience Control: reset configuration available
FES_CONF_RESET.description: When set, a reset option is offered in the Driving Experience Control configuration menu, allowing the user to revert all driving mode settings to factory defaults.

ECO_CONF_ATTENUATION_COMFPLUS.name: COMFORT PLUS mode: damper/chassis attenuation configurable
ECO_CONF_ATTENUATION_COMFPLUS.description: When set, the suspension/chassis attenuation (damper) setting is individually adjustable within the COMFORT PLUS driving mode.

ECO_CONF_STEERING_COMFPLUS.name: COMFORT PLUS mode: steering configurable
ECO_CONF_STEERING_COMFPLUS.description: When set, the steering weight/ratio is individually configurable within the COMFORT PLUS driving mode.

ECO_CONF_LIMIT_TEXT.name: ECO PRO mode: speed limit text display style
ECO_CONF_LIMIT_TEXT.description: Selects how the ECO PRO speed limit notification is presented on the display — as a hint/advisory text at activation, or as an active limit indicator while driving.

STABILITY_CONTROL_POPUP.name: Stability control (DSC) mode-change popup
STABILITY_CONTROL_POPUP.description: When set, a popup/warning notification is displayed when the DSC (Dynamic Stability Control) mode is changed via the Driving Experience Control settings.

ECO_CONF_MSA.name: ECO PRO mode: auto start/stop (MSA) configurable
ECO_CONF_MSA.description: When set, the auto start/stop (MSA) function is individually selectable within the ECO PRO driving mode.

GLOBAL_CONF_SAILING.name: Global coasting/sailing configurable
GLOBAL_CONF_SAILING.description: When set, the engine sailing/coasting function is available as a global (vehicle-level) configurable option, not tied to a specific driving mode.

RR_DSCOFF_AVL.name: Rolls-Royce DSC-OFF mode available
RR_DSCOFF_AVL.description: Indicates that the DSC-OFF (Dynamic Stability Control fully off) mode is available. The 'RR' prefix in the token designates a Rolls-Royce vehicle variant; this flag is not applicable to standard xDrive or F-series vehicles.

ECO_PRO_HINT.name: ECO PRO hint display style
ECO_PRO_HINT.description: Selects how ECO PRO mode activation hints are shown — as an advisory message at the point of activation (HINWEIS_BEI), or as an active limit indicator during driving (LIMIT_BEI).

ECO_INFO_DISPLAY.name: ECO info display enabled
ECO_INFO_DISPLAY.description: When set, ECO PRO mode information (fuel saving indicators, efficiency data) is shown on the Central Information Display during ECO PRO operation.

EFF_DYN_SAILING.name: Efficiency/dynamic coasting (sailing) available
EFF_DYN_SAILING.description: When active, the engine sailing/coasting function (engine-off free-roll to save fuel) is available as an efficiency-dynamic feature on this vehicle. Gate excludes Steptronic and certain market/type variants.

ECO_TIPPS.name: ECO PRO tips/coaching enabled
ECO_TIPPS.description: When set, ECO PRO driving tips and efficiency coaching messages are enabled and displayed to the driver during ECO PRO operation.

ECO_ROUTE.name: ECO PRO route function enabled
ECO_ROUTE.description: When set, the ECO PRO navigation route optimisation function (fuel-efficient routing) is enabled, allowing the system to suggest or follow more economical routes.

ECO_LIMIT.name: ECO PRO speed limit function enabled
ECO_LIMIT.description: When set, the ECO PRO speed limit/cap function is enabled, providing a driver-configurable top-speed limit within ECO PRO mode to maximise efficiency.

ECO_MODE.name: ECO PRO mode enabled
ECO_MODE.description: Master enable for the ECO PRO driving mode. When set, ECO PRO appears as a selectable mode in the Driving Experience Control menu.

ECO_MODE_CONF.name: ECO PRO mode configurable by user
ECO_MODE_CONF.description: When set, the ECO PRO mode parameters (climate, seat heating, etc.) are user-adjustable via the settings menu, enabling the ECO PRO Individual/Custom sub-mode.

FDS_NAMING_MODE.name: Driving Experience Control UI naming scheme
FDS_NAMING_MODE.description: Selects the naming/labelling convention used in the Driving Experience Control menu — either the post-July 2011 (current) naming or the earlier (pre-July 2011) naming scheme.

FDS_POPUP_DEACTIVATE.name: Driving Experience Control popup deactivated
FDS_POPUP_DEACTIVATE.description: When set, the introductory/welcome popup shown when the Driving Experience Control menu is first accessed is suppressed.

MACRO_FDS.name: Driving mode switch display
MACRO_FDS.description: Chooses how the head unit responds when the driver uses the driving mode switch: no display, a pop-up showing the selected mode, or that pop-up plus pages for configuring the modes.

ECO_TYPE_DRIVETRAIN.name: EfficientDynamics drivetrain type (ECO display)
ECO_TYPE_DRIVETRAIN.description: Selects the powertrain variant used by the EfficientDynamics / ECO display subsystem to determine which energy-flow gauges and history charts to render. Must match the vehicle's actual powertrain; conventional petrol is value 0.

ASD_CONFIGURATION.name: ASD (active sound design) installed
ASD_CONFIGURATION.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is equipped with Active Sound Design (ASD) — the electronic engine sound synthesis system. When set, ASD sound profile fields in this page are evaluated.

ASD_SOUND_OFF.name: ASD sound output disable
ASD_SOUND_OFF.description: When active, suppresses ASD audio output — the artificial engine sound is muted regardless of drive mode. Allows the system to be installed but silenced for specific market/variant configurations.

ASD_SOUND_1.name: ASD sound profile 1 available
ASD_SOUND_1.description: Enables ASD engine-sound profile slot 1. Each ASD_SOUND_n bit makes a specific synthesized sound profile available for selection in the drive-mode setup.

ASD_SOUND_2.name: ASD sound profile 2 available
ASD_SOUND_2.description: Enables ASD engine-sound profile slot 2. Corresponds to a second synthesized engine-sound variant selectable in drive modes.

ASD_SOUND_3.name: ASD sound profile 3 available
ASD_SOUND_3.description: Enables ASD engine-sound profile slot 3. Third synthesized engine-sound variant for drive-mode selection.

ASD_SOUND_4.name: ASD sound profile 4 available
ASD_SOUND_4.description: Enables ASD engine-sound profile slot 4. Fourth synthesized engine-sound variant for drive-mode selection.

HIST_ZOOM.name: EfficientDynamics history zoom
HIST_ZOOM.description: Enables zoom interaction on the EfficientDynamics consumption-history bar chart, allowing the driver to expand individual time segments for detail.

HIST_FDS_MODE_NAME.name: EfficientDynamics drive-mode name display
HIST_FDS_MODE_NAME.description: Controls whether the FDS (Fahrdynamiksystem / drive-mode system) mode name is shown as a text label in the EfficientDynamics history view. FA-gated: suppressed on certain vehicle type-key groups (electrified/entry variants).

HIST_FDS_MODE_COLOR.name: EfficientDynamics drive-mode colour coding
HIST_FDS_MODE_COLOR.description: Enables colour-coding of FDS (drive-mode) segments in the EfficientDynamics history chart, distinguishing Comfort/Sport/Eco segments by bar colour.

HIST_CONSUMP_AVERAGE.name: EfficientDynamics average consumption display mode
HIST_CONSUMP_AVERAGE.description: Selects which average-consumption value is shown in the history view. Numeric code; no symbolic names in firmware.

DRIVE_EXP_RESET.name: Drive Experience statistics reset
DRIVE_EXP_RESET.description: When enabled, allows the Drive Experience trip statistics to be reset by the driver from the iDrive menu.

DRIVE_EXP_BRW.name: Drive Experience brake-regen widget
DRIVE_EXP_BRW.description: Enables the brake-regeneration (BRW = Bremsenrückgewinnung) widget in the Drive Experience / EfficientDynamics display, showing energy recovered under braking.

DRIVE_EXPERIENCE.name: Drive Experience feature available
DRIVE_EXPERIENCE.description: Master enable for the Drive Experience analysis feature. When active, the Drive Experience page is accessible in the iDrive menu. FA-gated: suppressed on specific base vehicle type-key group.

CHARGING_HOSPITALITY.name: EV charging hospitality feature
CHARGING_HOSPITALITY.description: Enables the 'charging hospitality' function for plug-in vehicles — locating and routing to charging stations with amenities. Only relevant for PHEV/BEV variants.

HIST_PRESENT_VARIANT_DXE.name: EfficientDynamics history UI variant (DXE)
HIST_PRESENT_VARIANT_DXE.description: Selects which generation of the EfficientDynamics history display layout (DXE = Driving Experience) is used. Controls whether the newer or older bar-chart variant is rendered.

FAHRSTILANALYSE_ANIMATION.name: Driving style analysis animation
FAHRSTILANALYSE_ANIMATION.description: Enables the animated graphical display in the Fahrstilanalyse (driving style analysis) view — shows leaf/arc animations reflecting eco-driving score.

FAHRSTILANALYSE.name: Driving style analysis feature available
FAHRSTILANALYSE.description: Master enable for the Fahrstilanalyse (driving style analysis) page — an EfficientDynamics sub-page scoring driver eco-behaviour. FA-gated: suppressed on specific base vehicle type-key group.

HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_6.name: EfficientDynamics history Y-axis scale step 6
HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_6.description: Sets the sixth configurable Y-axis graduation step for the EfficientDynamics consumption bar chart. This is one of a series of scale-step fields (HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_1.6) that define chart grid lines. Numeric value; no symbolic names.

HIST_GAS_CONSUMP.name: EfficientDynamics petrol consumption bar visible
HIST_GAS_CONSUMP.description: Enables the petrol/gas consumption column in the EfficientDynamics history bar chart. FA-gated on KOMBI extended equipment or specific vehicle type-key group.

SAILING_COUNTER.name: Sailing (coasting) counter display
SAILING_COUNTER.description: Enables the sailing/coasting counter widget in the EfficientDynamics view, showing the cumulative duration or count of engine-off coast events (BMW 'Sailing' function).

EV_MENU_AVAILABLE.name: Electric drive menu
EV_MENU_AVAILABLE.description: Controls whether the head unit offers its electric drive menu, and which version: the one for plug-in hybrids or the one for electric cars with a range extender (REX). Set it to match the car's powertrain.

VEM_PHEV_AVAILABLE.name: PHEV energy management (VEM) available
VEM_PHEV_AVAILABLE.description: Enables the Vehicle Energy Management (VEM) display for plug-in hybrid variants, showing the charge/discharge balance between petrol and electric drive. Inactive on non-PHEV vehicles.

HIST_GAS_CONSUMP_SCALE_1.name: Consumption chart top value (L/100 km)
HIST_GAS_CONSUMP_SCALE_1.description: Sets the value at the top of the vertical axis of the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart when fuel consumption is shown in L/100 km. The chart's bars and its average line are scaled to it, and anything higher is cut off at the top.

HIST_GAS_CONSUMP_SCALE_2.name: Consumption chart top value (mpg, UK)
HIST_GAS_CONSUMP_SCALE_2.description: Sets the value at the top of the vertical axis of the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart when fuel consumption is shown in UK (imperial) miles per gallon. The chart's bars and its average line are scaled to it, and anything higher is cut off at the top.

HIST_GAS_CONSUMP_SCALE_3.name: Consumption chart top value (mpg, US)
HIST_GAS_CONSUMP_SCALE_3.description: Sets the value at the top of the vertical axis of the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart when fuel consumption is shown in US miles per gallon. The chart's bars and its average line are scaled to it, and anything higher is cut off at the top.

HIST_GAS_CONSUMP_SCALE_4.name: Consumption chart top value (km/L)
HIST_GAS_CONSUMP_SCALE_4.description: Sets the value at the top of the vertical axis of the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart when fuel consumption is shown in km/L. The chart's bars and its average line are scaled to it, and anything higher is cut off at the top.

EFF_DYN_TYPE_HYBRID.name: EfficientDynamics hybrid type
EFF_DYN_TYPE_HYBRID.description: Specifies the hybrid architecture used by this vehicle for EfficientDynamics display purposes. Determines which energy-flow view (pure ICE vs belt/axle hybrid vs parallel hybrid) is rendered.

EFF_DYN_TYPE_DRIVETRAIN.name: EfficientDynamics drivetrain layout
EFF_DYN_TYPE_DRIVETRAIN.description: Specifies the driven-axle layout (rear-wheel, front-wheel, or all-wheel drive) for the EfficientDynamics display. Determines power-flow animation direction in the energy diagram.

EFF_DYN_SPORT_CID.name: Sport display on central display
EFF_DYN_SPORT_CID.description: Makes the sport display available on the central display, as part of the EfficientDynamics functions. Enabled at the factory on some models with Navigation Business (S606), Navigation Professional (S609) or Radio BMW Professional (S663).

EFF_DYN_SPORT_UNIT.name: Sport display unit
EFF_DYN_SPORT_UNIT.description: Setting for the sport display pages. Best left unchanged.

SOC_DISP_SIGNAL.name: State-of-charge display signal source
SOC_DISP_SIGNAL.description: Selects the CAN signal source used to display battery state-of-charge (SoC) in the EfficientDynamics view. Only relevant for hybrid/electric variants.

SEAT_HEATING_CONSUMER.name: Seat heating as energy consumer (EfficientDynamics)
SEAT_HEATING_CONSUMER.description: Registers the seat heating system as a tracked energy consumer in the EfficientDynamics display, contributing to the auxiliary load breakdown. Only relevant on equipped vehicles.

CHARGING_CABLE_SIDE.name: Charging cable port position
CHARGING_CABLE_SIDE.description: Specifies which side of the vehicle the AC charging port is located on. Controls charging-port indicator graphics in the iDrive EV/PHEV menus.

KI_SELECTION_SOC.name: Instrument cluster SoC display selection
KI_SELECTION_SOC.description: When enabled, the battery state-of-charge (SoC) percentage is displayed on the instrument cluster (KI = Kombi-Instrument) via a dedicated selection/override. Hybrid/EV-specific.

EFF_DYN_FORECAST_HYB.name: EfficientDynamics hybrid forecast display variant
EFF_DYN_FORECAST_HYB.description: Selects which variant of the hybrid energy-forecast view is displayed in the EfficientDynamics section. Used on HEV/PHEV models to show predictive charge-depletion or route-based energy planning.

HIST_HYB_CONSUMP.name: Hybrid consumption bar in history chart
HIST_HYB_CONSUMP.description: Enables a separate hybrid-mode (electric) consumption bar alongside the petrol bar in the EfficientDynamics history chart. Only meaningful on HEV/PHEV variants.

HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SCALE_1.name: Hybrid consumption history scale — step 1
HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SCALE_1.description: First Y-axis reference scale value for the hybrid (electric) consumption history chart. Default 0x14 (=20 dec). Numeric; no symbolic names.

HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SCALE_2.name: Hybrid consumption history scale — step 2
HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SCALE_2.description: Second Y-axis reference scale value for the hybrid consumption history chart. Default 0x14 (=20 dec). Numeric; no symbolic names.

HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SCALE_3.name: Hybrid consumption history scale — step 3
HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SCALE_3.description: Third Y-axis reference scale value for the hybrid consumption history chart. Default 0x1E (=30 dec). Numeric; no symbolic names.

HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SWITCH.name: Hybrid / EV consumption chart display switch
HIST_HYB_CONSUMP_SWITCH.description: Enables the ability to toggle between hybrid and EV consumption views in the EfficientDynamics history display. Allows switching between PHEV electric and petrol history segments.

HIST_BEV_CONSUMP.name: BEV consumption bar in history chart
HIST_BEV_CONSUMP.description: Enables the battery-electric vehicle (BEV) energy consumption bar in the EfficientDynamics history chart. Only relevant for BEV or PHEV-in-EV-mode operation.

CONDITION_CHECK.name: Condition check feature available
CONDITION_CHECK.description: Enables the vehicle condition check function accessible from the EfficientDynamics / vehicle status page. When active, driver can initiate a readiness/health check from the iDrive menu.

EFF_DYN_SYS_CID.name: EfficientDynamics system display on CID
EFF_DYN_SYS_CID.description: Enables the overall EfficientDynamics system display widget on the Central Information Display (CID). When active, the EfficientDynamics tile/page is available in the iDrive main menu.

HIST_BEV_CONSUMP_SCALE_1.name: Consumption chart top value (kWh/100 km)
HIST_BEV_CONSUMP_SCALE_1.description: Sets the value at the top of the vertical axis of the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart when electric consumption is shown in kWh/100 km. The chart's bars and its average line are scaled to it, and anything higher is cut off at the top.

HIST_BEV_CONSUMP_SCALE_2.name: Consumption chart top value (mi/kWh)
HIST_BEV_CONSUMP_SCALE_2.description: Sets the value at the top of the vertical axis of the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart when electric consumption is shown in mi/kWh. The chart's bars and its average line are scaled to it, and anything higher is cut off at the top.

HIST_BEV_CONSUMP_SCALE_3.name: Consumption chart top value (km/kWh)
HIST_BEV_CONSUMP_SCALE_3.description: Sets the value at the top of the vertical axis of the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart when electric consumption is shown in km/kWh. The chart's bars and its average line are scaled to it, and anything higher is cut off at the top.

HIST_BEV_RECUP_SCALE_1.name: BEV recuperation history scale — step 1
HIST_BEV_RECUP_SCALE_1.description: First Y-axis reference scale value for the BEV regenerative-braking (recuperation) history chart. Default 0x14 (=20 dec). Numeric; no symbolic names.

HIST_BEV_RECUP_SCALE_2.name: BEV recuperation history scale — step 2
HIST_BEV_RECUP_SCALE_2.description: Second Y-axis reference scale value for the BEV regenerative-braking history chart. Default 0x14 (=20 dec). Observed variant value: 20. Numeric; no symbolic names.

HIST_BEV_RECUP_SCALE_3.name: BEV recuperation history scale — step 3
HIST_BEV_RECUP_SCALE_3.description: Third Y-axis reference scale value for the BEV regenerative-braking history chart. Default 0x1E (=30 dec). Observed variant value: 30. Numeric; no symbolic names.

HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_1.name: EfficientDynamics history Y-axis scale step 1
HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_1.description: First configurable Y-axis graduation step for the EfficientDynamics consumption bar chart. Part of the HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_1.6 series defining chart scale. Numeric value 0.4; no symbolic names.

HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_2.name: EfficientDynamics history Y-axis scale step 2
HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_2.description: Second configurable Y-axis graduation step for the EfficientDynamics consumption bar chart. Numeric value 0.4; no symbolic names.

HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_3.name: EfficientDynamics history Y-axis scale step 3
HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_3.description: Third configurable Y-axis graduation step for the EfficientDynamics consumption bar chart. Numeric value 0.4; no symbolic names.

HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_4.name: EfficientDynamics history Y-axis scale step 4
HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_4.description: Fourth configurable Y-axis graduation step for the EfficientDynamics consumption bar chart. Numeric value 0.4; no symbolic names.

HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_5.name: EfficientDynamics history Y-axis scale step 5
HIST_Y_SCALE_STEP_5.description: Fifth configurable Y-axis graduation step for the EfficientDynamics consumption bar chart. Numeric value; no symbolic names.

HIST_FUTURE.name: EfficientDynamics future (predictive) segment available
HIST_FUTURE.description: Enables a predictive/future segment in the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart, showing expected future consumption based on navigation route data.

HIST_PRESENT.name: EfficientDynamics current-trip segment shown
HIST_PRESENT.description: Enables display of the current (present) trip segment in the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart, showing real-time consumption for the ongoing journey.

HIST_PAST.name: EfficientDynamics past-trips segment shown
HIST_PAST.description: Enables display of the historical (past trips) segment in the EfficientDynamics consumption history chart. FA-gated on KOMBI extended equipment or specific vehicle type-key group.

HIST_PAST_AVERAGE_CONSUMP.name: EfficientDynamics past-trips average consumption line
HIST_PAST_AVERAGE_CONSUMP.description: Enables the average consumption reference line overlaid on the past-trips bars in the EfficientDynamics history chart, giving a visual benchmark across historical trips.

HIST_PAST_ACT_BAR.name: EfficientDynamics active bar highlight in past-trips view
HIST_PAST_ACT_BAR.description: When enabled, the currently selected (active) bar in the past-trips consumption history is highlighted/underlined to distinguish it from surrounding bars.

HIST_PAST_ACT_BAR_HIGHLIGHT.name: EfficientDynamics active bar accent highlight
HIST_PAST_ACT_BAR_HIGHLIGHT.description: Enables an additional accent highlight on the active bar in the past-trips history chart — distinct from the base bar highlight, typically used for a top-border or colour accent.

HIST_PAST_BAR_COLOUR_GAS.name: EfficientDynamics past-trips bar colour — petrol
HIST_PAST_BAR_COLOUR_GAS.description: Enables distinct colour coding for petrol/gas consumption bars in the past-trips EfficientDynamics history chart, distinguishing petrol segments from electric or hybrid segments.

HIST_PAST_BAR_COLOUR_PHEV.name: EfficientDynamics past-trips bar colour — PHEV electric
HIST_PAST_BAR_COLOUR_PHEV.description: Enables distinct colour coding for plug-in hybrid (PHEV) electric-mode consumption bars in the past-trips EfficientDynamics history chart. Only relevant on PHEV variants.

HIST_PAST_COOKIE.name: EfficientDynamics past-trips cookie/marker
HIST_PAST_COOKIE.description: Enables a 'cookie' marker overlay on individual bars in the past-trips history chart — a small icon or badge indicating a specific event or milestone trip (e.g. refuelling, charge cycle).

HIST_PAST_COUNTER_MSA.name: EfficientDynamics MSA (auto start/stop) counter display
HIST_PAST_COUNTER_MSA.description: Controls how the MSA (Motor-Stopp-Automatik / auto start/stop) event counter is shown in the past-trips EfficientDynamics history. Can show with or without seconds breakdown, or be hidden.

HIST_PAST_COUNTER_SAILING.name: EfficientDynamics sailing/coasting counter in history
HIST_PAST_COUNTER_SAILING.description: Enables display of the sailing (engine-off coasting) event counter in the past-trips EfficientDynamics history chart, showing how many coasting events occurred per segment.

HIST_PAST_COUNTER_EDRIVE.name: EfficientDynamics eDrive counter in history
HIST_PAST_COUNTER_EDRIVE.description: Enables display of the eDrive (electric-mode driving) event counter in the past-trips EfficientDynamics history chart. Only meaningful on PHEV/BEV variants. Default: not active.

HIST_PAST_RESET.name: EfficientDynamics past-trips history reset available
HIST_PAST_RESET.description: Enables the driver-accessible option to reset the past-trips EfficientDynamics consumption history from the iDrive menu.

INSZENIERUNG.name: Driver assistance display stage
INSZENIERUNG.description: Selects how the head unit presents driver assistance warnings, from simple status panels to one of two full display concepts. Best left unchanged.

AUFFAHRWARNUNG.name: Forward collision warning (AUFFAHRWARNUNG)
AUFFAHRWARNUNG.description: Enables the rear-end / tailgating collision warning function that alerts the driver when following distance becomes dangerously short.

LANE_POSITIONING.name: Lane positioning display (LANE_POSITIONING)
LANE_POSITIONING.description: Enables on-screen lane-positioning display showing vehicle position within the current lane relative to lane markings.

PERSONENWARNUNG_TAGS.name: Pedestrian warning (daytime) (PERSONENWARNUNG_TAGS)
PERSONENWARNUNG_TAGS.description: Configures the daytime pedestrian detection and warning capability, alerting the driver when a pedestrian is detected in or near the vehicle's path.

PERSONENWARNUNG_NACHTS.name: Pedestrian warning (nighttime) (PERSONENWARNUNG_NACHTS)
PERSONENWARNUNG_NACHTS.description: Configures the nighttime pedestrian detection and warning function, typically using Night Vision (NIVI) camera data.

SPURVERLASSENSWARNUNG.name: Lane departure warning version
SPURVERLASSENSWARNUNG.description: Tells the head unit which version of lane departure warning the car has, so its settings and displays match. With generation 2 the Intelligent Safety menu labels one warning setting “Early” instead of “Always”, and notices can name a deactivated Lane Departure Warning or reduced steering intervention. Set at the factory with Lane departure warning (S5AD) or Driving Assistant (S5AS).

SPURWECHSELWARNUNG.name: Lane change warning generation (SPURWECHSELWARNUNG)
SPURWECHSELWARNUNG.description: Selects the generation/variant of the lane change warning function (blind spot monitor style warning when changing lanes).

SEITENKOLLISIONSWARNUNG.name: Side collision warning (SEITENKOLLISIONSWARNUNG)
SEITENKOLLISIONSWARNUNG.description: Enables the side collision warning function, which alerts the driver to objects alongside the vehicle that could cause a side impact.

VMIN_SPURVERLASSEN_KMH.name: Lane departure warning min. speed (km/h)
VMIN_SPURVERLASSEN_KMH.description: Tells the head unit the speed, in km/h, below which lane departure warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

VMIN_SPURWECHSEL_KMH.name: Lane change warning min. speed (km/h)
VMIN_SPURWECHSEL_KMH.description: Tells the head unit the speed, in km/h, below which lane change warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

GEZIELTESANLEUCHTEN.name: Targeted headlight illumination (GEZIELTESANLEUCHTEN)
GEZIELTESANLEUCHTEN.description: Enables directed/targeted headlight illumination — the system that actively steers a spotlight toward a detected pedestrian or obstacle at night.

AUTOTEMPOMAT.name: Cruise control (AUTOTEMPOMAT)
AUTOTEMPOMAT.description: Enables cruise control (Tempomat) — the speed-hold function displayed/managed via the HU Driving Assistant page.

AUTOLIMITER.name: Speed limiter (AUTOLIMITER)
AUTOLIMITER.description: Enables the automatic speed limiter function, which prevents the vehicle from exceeding a set maximum speed.

SPURVERLASSENSWARNZEITPUNKT.name: Lane departure warning timing (SPURVERLASSENSWARNZEITPUNKT)
SPURVERLASSENSWARNZEITPUNKT.description: Selects when (how early) the lane departure warning triggers — the timing point relative to crossing the lane marking. Raw descriptor codes are 1 and 2; no symbolic names are defined.

VMIN_SPURVERLASSEN_MPH.name: Lane departure warning min. speed (mph)
VMIN_SPURVERLASSEN_MPH.description: Tells the head unit the speed, in mph, below which lane departure warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

VMIN_SPURWECHSEL_MPH.name: Lane change warning min. speed (mph)
VMIN_SPURWECHSEL_MPH.description: Tells the head unit the speed, in mph, below which lane change warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

SPURWECHSELWARNZEITPUNKT.name: Lane change warning timing (SPURWECHSELWARNZEITPUNKT)
SPURWECHSELWARNZEITPUNKT.description: Selects the timing point at which the lane change warning triggers relative to the lane crossing event. Raw descriptor codes are 1 and 2; no symbolic names are defined.

VIBRATIONSSTAERKE.name: Steering wheel vibration (VIBRATIONSSTAERKE)
VIBRATIONSSTAERKE.description: Enables/disables the steering wheel haptic vibration used to alert the driver during lane departure or lane change warnings. This is a binary on/off field.

SPURVERLASSENSLENKEINGRIFF.name: Lane departure steering intervention (SPURVERLASSENSLENKEINGRIFF)
SPURVERLASSENSLENKEINGRIFF.description: Enables active steering counter-correction when the vehicle is about to depart its lane — the system applies a corrective steering torque.

SPURWECHSELLENKEINGRIFF.name: Lane change steering intervention (SPURWECHSELLENKEINGRIFF)
SPURWECHSELLENKEINGRIFF.description: Enables active steering counter-correction during an unintentional lane change — system applies corrective torque to prevent drifting into an adjacent lane.

SARAH_PARAMETER.name: Driver assistance base value
SARAH_PARAMETER.description: Internal value for the head unit's driver assistance displays. The unit offers only one value.

VOFFSET_MIN_KMH.name: Speed limit offset below limit (km/h)
VOFFSET_MIN_KMH.description: Sets the largest offset below the detected speed limit, in km/h, that the driver can choose for the speed limit functions. Best left unchanged.

VOFFSET_MAX_KMH.name: Speed limit offset above limit (km/h)
VOFFSET_MAX_KMH.description: Sets the largest offset above the detected speed limit, in km/h, that the driver can choose for the speed limit functions. Best left unchanged.

VOFFSET_MIN_MPH.name: Speed limit offset below limit (mph)
VOFFSET_MIN_MPH.description: Sets the largest offset below the detected speed limit, in mph, that the driver can choose for the speed limit functions. Best left unchanged.

VOFFSET_MAX_MPH.name: Speed limit offset above limit (mph)
VOFFSET_MAX_MPH.description: Sets the largest offset above the detected speed limit, in mph, that the driver can choose for the speed limit functions. Best left unchanged.

VORFAHRTSWARNUNG.name: Right-of-way / junction warning (VORFAHRTSWARNUNG)
VORFAHRTSWARNUNG.description: Enables the right-of-way warning at junctions, alerting the driver to cross-traffic when they may not have right of way.

VMIN_SEITENKOLLISION_KMH.name: Side collision warning min. speed (km/h)
VMIN_SEITENKOLLISION_KMH.description: Tells the head unit the speed, in km/h, below which side collision warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

MACRO_RFA.name: Reversing Assistant
MACRO_RFA.description: Shows the Reversing Assistant in the head unit's parking displays. Enable it only when the car has Reversing Assistant.

VMIN_SEITENKOLLISION_MPH.name: Side collision warning min. speed (mph)
VMIN_SEITENKOLLISION_MPH.description: Tells the head unit the speed, in mph, below which side collision warning is inactive, so its driver assistance displays match the system. Best left unchanged.

INDIVIDUAL_INFO.name: Intelligent Safety deactivation notice
INDIVIDUAL_INFO.description: Sets the notice the central display shows when Intelligent Safety systems are switched off or reduced: a general notice that at least one system is deactivated, or one that names the change, such as “Lane Departure Warning deactivated.” It only takes effect when “Lane departure warning version” (`300A/1/00001100b`) is set to generation 2.

FRONTKOLLISIONSWARNUNG.name: Front collision warning (FRONTKOLLISIONSWARNUNG)
FRONTKOLLISIONSWARNUNG.description: Enables the front collision warning, which alerts the driver to an imminent front-end collision with a vehicle or obstacle ahead.

ANFAHRVERHINDERUNG.name: Unintended vehicle movement prevention (ANFAHRVERHINDERUNG)
ANFAHRVERHINDERUNG.description: Enables the unintended vehicle movement prevention feature — the system that prevents inadvertent vehicle motion from a standstill.

SPEEDGESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT.name: Speed/velocity assistant (SPEEDGESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT)
SPEEDGESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT.description: Enables the speed-management component of the driving assistant, which monitors vehicle speed and assists with speed management.

STRECKENVERLAUF.name: Route / road profile data use (STRECKENVERLAUF)
STRECKENVERLAUF.description: Enables the use of road/route profile data (from navigation) by the driving assistant to anticipate curves and road conditions ahead.

SPURWECHSELASSISTENT.name: Lane change assist (SPURWECHSELASSISTENT)
SPURWECHSELASSISTENT.description: Enables the active lane change assist function, which supports the driver in performing safe lane changes.

ENGSTELLENASSISTENT.name: Narrow passage assist (ENGSTELLENASSISTENT)
ENGSTELLENASSISTENT.description: Enables the narrow passage / tight-space assistant, which provides visual/audible guidance when passing through narrow gaps or tight spots.

LENKRADLED.name: Steering wheel LED indicator (LENKRADLED)
LENKRADLED.description: Enables LED indicators on the steering wheel rim used to provide haptic/visual driving assistant alerts (e.g. lane departure, collision warnings).

ANHAENGER_MANUELL.name: Manual trailer detection (ANHAENGER_MANUELL)
ANHAENGER_MANUELL.description: Enables manual trailer detection mode, where the driver confirms trailer presence rather than having it detected automatically.

ANHAENGER_INFO.name: Trailer info display (ANHAENGER_INFO)
ANHAENGER_INFO.description: Enables display of trailer-related information in the Driving Assistant / HMI when a trailer is detected or connected.

GESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT.name: Speed assistant (GESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT)
GESCHWINDIGKEITSASSISTENT.description: Enables the speed assistant function — a speed management/advisory system in the Driving Assistant page.

KREUZUNGSWARNUNG.name: Intersection / cross-traffic warning (KREUZUNGSWARNUNG)
KREUZUNGSWARNUNG.description: Enables the intersection warning function, which detects and alerts to cross-traffic at junctions.

SPEEDLIMITINFO.name: Speed limit info display (SPEEDLIMITINFO)
SPEEDLIMITINFO.description: Enables the speed limit information display on the HU, showing the current road speed limit derived from camera or map data.

VORAUSSCHAU.name: Predictive look-ahead (VORAUSSCHAU)
VORAUSSCHAU.description: Enables predictive look-ahead functionality, where navigation/camera data about the road ahead is used to anticipate and pre-condition driving assistant systems.

SPEEDLIMITWARNUNG.name: Speed limit warning
SPEEDLIMITWARNUNG.description: Tells the head unit which version of speed limit warning the car has, so the Speed Assistant settings describe it correctly. The warning alerts the driver when the car is faster than the detected or chosen limit. With generation 1 the settings describe a warning above the adjusted limit, the detected limit plus the driver's offset. Set it to match the car's equipment.

SPEEDLIMITINSZENIERUNG.name: Speed limit staging animation (SPEEDLIMITINSZENIERUNG)
SPEEDLIMITINSZENIERUNG.description: Configures the animation/staging displayed when a new speed limit is detected or when the speed limit warning triggers.

EINSEITIGVORBEIFAHREN.name: Single-side pass-through guidance (EINSEITIGVORBEIFAHREN)
EINSEITIGVORBEIFAHREN.description: Enables single-sided passing assistance — guidance when the vehicle passes a stationary obstacle or parked car where only one side has sufficient clearance.

VOFFSET.name: Speed limit offset
VOFFSET.description: Sets how far the driver can shift the speed limit functions above or below the detected limit in the Speed Assistant settings. With “Not set” the ±15 km/h or ±10 mph range applies.

SLAMANUELL.name: Speed Limit Assist manual mode (SLAMANUELL)
SLAMANUELL.description: Enables manual mode for the Speed Limit Assist (SLA) — allowing the driver to manually set the reference speed instead of relying on sign recognition.

PERSONEN_WARNUNG.name: Pedestrian warning enable (PERSONEN_WARNUNG)
PERSONEN_WARNUNG.description: Master enable for the pedestrian/person detection warning system. When active, the Driving Assistant will alert the driver when a pedestrian is detected in dangerous proximity.

FAS_INSZENIERUNG.name: Driving Assistant staging concept (FAS_INSZENIERUNG)
FAS_INSZENIERUNG.description: Selects the visual staging/animation concept for the Driving Assistant (FAS = Fahrerassistenzsystem). Controls the presentation style of warnings including staging boards, preview, or full visual concept.

GEZIELTES_ANLEUCHTEN.name: Targeted headlight illumination v2 (GEZIELTES_ANLEUCHTEN)
GEZIELTES_ANLEUCHTEN.description: Enables directed headlight illumination towards detected pedestrians or objects at night. This is the newer token (byte 49) for this feature vs the earlier GEZIELTESANLEUCHTEN at byte 3.

LANE_CHANGE_WARNING.name: Lane change warning enable (LANE_CHANGE_WARNING)
LANE_CHANGE_WARNING.description: Master enable bit for the lane change warning (blind spot warning style) function in the SARAH subsystem.

BRAKE_ASSISTENT.name: Brake assistant (BRAKE_ASSISTENT)
BRAKE_ASSISTENT.description: Enables the base brake assistant function, which provides braking support in emergency situations by maximising braking force.

BRAKE_ASSISTENT_3.name: Brake assistant 3 / Stop-and-Go (BRAKE_ASSISTENT_3)
BRAKE_ASSISTENT_3.description: Enables the third-generation brake assistant function integrated with Active Cruise Control Stop-and-Go capability, providing enhanced automated braking support.

BRAKE_ASSISTANT_CCM.name: Brake assistant CCM (BRAKE_ASSISTANT_CCM)
BRAKE_ASSISTANT_CCM.description: Enables the Camera / Cross-traffic Monitor (CCM) variant of the brake assistant. Active when NOT equipped with lane departure warning / ACC Stop&Go / Driving Assistant (different sensor set).

BRAKE_ASSISTANT_FCW.name: Brake assistant FCW (forward collision warning) (BRAKE_ASSISTANT_FCW)
BRAKE_ASSISTANT_FCW.description: Enables the Forward Collision Warning variant of the brake assistant, which combines camera-based collision detection with automatic pre-braking preparation.

LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING.name: Lane departure warning enable (LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING)
LANE_DEPARTURE_WARNING.description: Master enable for the lane departure warning system. When active, the system monitors lane markings and alerts the driver if the vehicle drifts across them without signalling.

NIVI_2_OBJ_DETECTION.name: Night Vision 2 object detection (NIVI_2_OBJ_DETECTION)
NIVI_2_OBJ_DETECTION.description: Enables second-generation Night Vision (NIVI 2) object detection, which uses the thermal/night camera to identify and classify objects (pedestrians, animals) in darkness.

TC_PANORAMADACH.name: Panoramic roof type
TC_PANORAMADACH.description: Declares whether the vehicle has a single-panel or two-panel panoramic glass roof. Tells the Touch Command subsystem which sunroof control UI to present.

TC_SCHIEBEHEBEDACH.name: Sliding/tilting sunroof present
TC_SCHIEBEHEBEDACH.description: Indicates whether the vehicle has a conventional sliding/tilting sunroof (Schiebehebedach). Enables the corresponding Touch Command UI tile.

TC_IONISATION.name: Air ionisation present
TC_IONISATION.description: Enables the air ionisation (ionizer) control tile in the Touch Command screen. Set when the vehicle is equipped with the cabin air ionisation system.

TC_CLIMATE_4_ZONES.name: Four-zone climate control present
TC_CLIMATE_4_ZONES.description: Indicates the vehicle has a 4-zone automatic climate control system. Activates the corresponding extended climate UI in Touch Command.

TC_CLIMATE_REAR_EXTENDED.name: Rear extended climate control present
TC_CLIMATE_REAR_EXTENDED.description: Indicates the vehicle has a rear-area extended climate control zone (beyond standard 2-zone rear). Enables additional rear climate controls in Touch Command.

TC_REAR_WINDOW_CURTAIN.name: Rear window roller blind present
TC_REAR_WINDOW_CURTAIN.description: Indicates whether the vehicle has a rear window roller sun blind. Enables the rear-curtain control tile in Touch Command.

TC_REAR_AND_SIDE_WINDOW_CURTAIN.name: Rear and side window roller blinds present
TC_REAR_AND_SIDE_WINDOW_CURTAIN.description: Indicates the vehicle has roller sun blinds on both rear and side windows. Enables the combined rear+side curtain control in Touch Command.

TC_CAPTAINCHAIR.name: Captain's chairs (individual rear seats) present
TC_CAPTAINCHAIR.description: Indicates the vehicle has individual rear captain's chairs rather than a bench seat. Enables the individual rear-seat control tile in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_MULTIFUNCTION.name: Front seat multifunction controls present
TC_SEAT_MULTIFUNCTION.description: Indicates the front seats have multifunction memory/position controls (e.g. easy-entry, memory recall). Enables front seat control tile in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_REAR_MULTIFUNCTION.name: Rear seat multifunction controls present
TC_SEAT_REAR_MULTIFUNCTION.description: Indicates the rear seats have multifunction electric adjustment controls. Enables rear seat control tile in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_REAR_MASSAGE.name: Rear seat massage present
TC_SEAT_REAR_MASSAGE.description: Indicates the rear seats are equipped with a massage function. Enables the rear seat massage control tile in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_FRONT_MASSAGE.name: Front seat massage present
TC_SEAT_FRONT_MASSAGE.description: Indicates the front seats are equipped with a massage function. Enables the front seat massage control tile in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_FRONT_LORDOSE.name: Front seat lumbar support present
TC_SEAT_FRONT_LORDOSE.description: Indicates the front seats are equipped with adjustable lumbar (lordosis) support. Enables the lumbar adjustment control in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_TRAINING.name: Seat training/dynamic support present
TC_SEAT_TRAINING.description: Indicates the seats are equipped with dynamic seat / training function (active back support that shifts during cornering). Enables seat training control in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_HEATING_FRONT.name: Front seat heating present
TC_SEAT_HEATING_FRONT.description: Indicates the front seats have heated seat elements. Enables the front seat heating control tile in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_HEATING_REAR.name: Rear seat heating present
TC_SEAT_HEATING_REAR.description: Indicates the rear seats have heated seat elements. Enables the rear seat heating control tile in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_VENTILATION_FRONT.name: Front seat ventilation present
TC_SEAT_VENTILATION_FRONT.description: Indicates the front seats have ventilated/cooled seat elements. Enables the front seat ventilation tile in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_VENTILATION_REAR.name: Rear seat ventilation present
TC_SEAT_VENTILATION_REAR.description: Indicates the rear seats have ventilated/cooled seat elements. Enables the rear seat ventilation tile in Touch Command.

TC_SEAT_AUTO_CLIMATE.name: Seat auto-climate function present
TC_SEAT_AUTO_CLIMATE.description: Indicates the seat climate system supports an automatic/combined heating+ventilation mode. Enables the seat auto-climate control in Touch Command.

TC_EINZEL_SA.name: Individual special equipment (SA) mode
TC_EINZEL_SA.description: Signals that the vehicle uses an individual/single special-equipment (Einzel-SA) configuration for Touch Command staging, rather than a bundled package. May affect which TC tiles are shown.

TC_HIGH_END_AUDIO_B_UND_W.name: Bowers & Wilkins high-end audio staging
TC_HIGH_END_AUDIO_B_UND_W.description: Controls the Touch Command staging level for the Bowers & Wilkins (B&W) Diamond/high-end audio system. Determines whether the audio system gets no menu, basic display, light animation only, or full introduction staging.

values.1: Display without introduction (KEINE_INSZ — show but skip animation)
values.2: Light animation only (NUR_LICHTINSZ — ambient lighting intro only)
values.3: Full introduction staging (VOLLE_INSZ — full light + sound intro)

TC_BELEUCHTETES_PANORAMADACH.name: Illuminated panoramic roof staging
TC_BELEUCHTETES_PANORAMADACH.description: Controls whether the illuminated panoramic roof (Beleuchtetes Panoramadach) is presented in Touch Command and whether its lighting is linked to the ambient interior lighting system.

values.0: Not active (NICHT_AKTIV — no illuminated panoramic roof)
values.1: Active (AKTIV — illuminated roof present, independent control)
values.2: Active with ambient light coupling (AKTIV_MIT_KOPPLUNG_AN_AMBIENTES_INNENLICHT — roof light synced to ambient lighting)

TC_LICHTSCHWERT.name: Light sword (Lichtschwert) ambient strip present
TC_LICHTSCHWERT.description: Indicates the vehicle has the 'Lichtschwert' (lit. light sword) illuminated ambient door strip feature. Enables the corresponding ambient lighting control in Touch Command.

TC_INDIVIDUAL_AMBIENTELICHT.name: Individual ambient lighting present
TC_INDIVIDUAL_AMBIENTELICHT.description: Indicates the vehicle has the Individual ambient interior lighting package (colour-selectable ambient light). Enables individual ambient light colour control in Touch Command.

TC_COLOUR_SWITCH_ENSEMBLE.name: Colour switch ensemble count
TC_COLOUR_SWITCH_ENSEMBLE.description: Configures the colour-switch ensemble variant for the ambient lighting system. Raw numeric field; exact meaning of each value is not symbolically named in the syset descriptor.

TC_HELLIGKEIT_AMBILIGHT.name: Ambient light brightness control present
TC_HELLIGKEIT_AMBILIGHT.description: Indicates the ambient lighting system supports user-adjustable brightness (Helligkeit). Enables the brightness slider in the Touch Command ambient lighting page.

TC_WLAN_HOTSPOT.name: WLAN hotspot tile present
TC_WLAN_HOTSPOT.description: Enables the Wi-Fi hotspot control tile in Touch Command, allowing the driver to enable/disable the in-car WLAN hotspot from the touchscreen.

TC_DIAGNOSE_TEST_MODE.name: Diagnostics/test mode tile present
TC_DIAGNOSE_TEST_MODE.description: Enables a diagnostics or test mode tile in the Touch Command screen. Intended for workshop or factory use; not typically enabled in production vehicles.

TC_NUMBER_OF_TOUCH_COMMAND.name: Number of Touch Command panels
TC_NUMBER_OF_TOUCH_COMMAND.description: Configures how many Touch Command control panels (TC screens) are available in the iDrive menu. TC_0 means no TC panel; TC_1 through TC_3 enable increasing numbers of TC panels.

TC_MEDIA_BROWSING.name: Media library browsing enabled
TC_MEDIA_BROWSING.description: Enables media library browsing (e.g. browse by artist/album/genre) in the Touch Command / entertainment section of the iDrive system.

TC_V12_ENGINE_AVAILABLE.name: V12 engine available
TC_V12_ENGINE_AVAILABLE.description: Indicates the vehicle is fitted with a V12 engine. May enable V12-specific Touch Command engine display graphics or power/cylinder-deactivation controls.

TC_FOLDER_BROWSING.name: Folder browsing enabled
TC_FOLDER_BROWSING.description: Enables folder-based browsing of USB/storage media in the Touch Command entertainment section, allowing navigation by folder hierarchy rather than media library.

CID_HMI_TOUCH.name: Touch operation of the central display
CID_HMI_TOUCH.description: Turns on touch operation of the central display, so the screen responds to taps and swipes as well as to the iDrive Controller. Enable it only when the central display is a touchscreen. Enabled at the factory with Navigation Professional (S609) or TV function (S601).

CID_HMI_TOUCH_RSE.name: Rear-seat entertainment touchscreen present
CID_HMI_TOUCH_RSE.description: Indicates the vehicle has a touch-capable display for the Rear Seat Entertainment (RSE) system. Enables RSE touch input handling.

HUD_SPORTANZEIGE_ENABLE.name: HUD sport display enable
HUD_SPORTANZEIGE_ENABLE.description: Enables the sport-display content group in the head-up display (HUD). When active, sport-oriented readouts are available for the driver to select in HUD settings.

HUD_SPORTANZEIGE_FES_ENABLE.name: HUD sport display — FES variant
HUD_SPORTANZEIGE_FES_ENABLE.description: Enables the FES (Fahrerassistenz — driver assistance) variant of the HUD sport display. Typically associated with assistance-oriented sport content in the HUD on FES-equipped cars.

HUD_SPORTANZEIGE_MS_GASSE_ENABLE.name: HUD sport display — motorsport lane view
HUD_SPORTANZEIGE_MS_GASSE_ENABLE.description: Enables the MS_GASSE (motorsport lane/corridor) sport-display variant in the HUD, showing a dynamic lane or corridor graphic during spirited driving or on track.

HUD_ENTERTAINMENTLIST.name: HUD entertainment list
HUD_ENTERTAINMENTLIST.description: Enables the entertainment content list (audio source, track, station) as a selectable content group in the head-up display.

HUD_DISTANCE_INFO.name: HUD distance/following-distance info
HUD_DISTANCE_INFO.description: Enables ACC (adaptive cruise) following-distance information as a selectable content element in the HUD, showing the set gap to the vehicle ahead.

HUD_M.name: HUD settings: BMW M version
HUD_M.description: Switches the head-up display settings on the central display to their BMW M version. For BMW M models with a head-up display.

HUD_TURNSIGNAL.name: HUD content: turn signals
HUD_TURNSIGNAL.description: When enabled, the head-up display also indicates when a turn signal is on.

HUD_VZA.name: HUD traffic sign recognition display
HUD_VZA.description: Enables display of recognised traffic signs (speed limits, no-passing signs, etc.) from the vehicle's camera-based sign recognition (VZA) system in the head-up display.

HUD_KOMPRIMIERUNG_ART.name: HUD image compression
HUD_KOMPRIMIERUNG_ART.description: Image compression the head unit uses for navigation graphics in the head-up display and cluster. It must match the hardware generation.

HUD_ROTATION.name: HUD image rotation
HUD_ROTATION.description: Enables rotation of the HUD display image, used to compensate for optical path geometry when the projector unit requires a rotated raster.

HUD_POSITION.name: HUD position adjustment available
HUD_POSITION.description: Enables the user-accessible position adjustment function for the HUD. When set, the system supports HUD position control (used in conjunction with the specific slider controls in bytes 9-10).

HUD_ACTIVATION.name: HUD activation (fitted/activated)
HUD_ACTIVATION.description: Marks the HUD as activated/enabled in the system — the primary fitment activation bit distinct from HUD_VERBAUT. When set, the head-up display subsystem initialises and presents HUD-related menus.

HUD_SPEEDCONTROL.name: HUD speed control display
HUD_SPEEDCONTROL.description: Enables display of the active speed control set-speed (cruise control or speed limiter) as a content element in the HUD. The named firmware value NICHT_AKTIV (not active) is the default/off state.

NAVI_HUD_AVAILABLE.name: Navigation HUD available
NAVI_HUD_AVAILABLE.description: Declares that navigation turn-by-turn content is available for display in the HUD on this vehicle. Enables routing instructions (arrows, distance to manoeuvre) in the HUD.

JUNCTION_VIEW_HUD.name: Junction View in HUD
JUNCTION_VIEW_HUD.description: Enables the Junction View (detailed intersection guidance graphic) to be shown in the HUD in addition to or instead of the standard navigation arrow. Requires Navigation HUD to be available.

HUD_VERBAUT.name: Head-up display installed
HUD_VERBAUT.description: Tells the head unit a head-up display (HUD) is installed, which enables the HUD menus and settings. Enable it only when the car has a HUD.

HUD_RES.name: Undocumented field (HUD_RES)
HUD_RES.description: Purpose not determined from available sources. Although 'RES' superficially suggests resolution, a dedicated resolution field (HUD_AUFLOESUNG) already exists at byte 3; RES most likely denotes a reserved or unspecified field. No enum values are defined.

HUD_GENERATION.name: HUD hardware generation
HUD_GENERATION.description: Selects the generation of the HUD projector hardware fitted. Used by the system to select correct display parameters, calibration, and feature support for the installed unit.

JUNCTION_VIEW_HUD_DAY.name: HUD content: junction view (day)
JUNCTION_VIEW_HUD_DAY.description: Setting for the junction view in the head-up display, for daytime. Best left unchanged.

HUD_AUFLOESUNG.name: HUD image resolution
HUD_AUFLOESUNG.description: Sets the image resolution the head unit uses for navigation graphics in the head-up display, to suit the HUD generation. Best left unchanged.

HUD_RB_KONFIGURATION.name: HUD radio-button (content selector) configuration
HUD_RB_KONFIGURATION.description: Selects which radio-button layout/set is presented in the HUD content selector (the on-screen control that lets the driver choose what to display). KEINE_RADIOBUTTONS means no radio-button selector is shown.

DISPLAYTIME_LIST_HUD_KOMBI.name: HUD/cluster display dwell time
DISPLAYTIME_LIST_HUD_KOMBI.description: Sets how long a HUD/instrument-cluster popup or notification is shown before automatically dismissing. The only named firmware value is WERT_1_250MS (value 1 = 250 ms); higher values select longer dwell times.

HUD_CB_EIN_AUS.name: HUD checkbox: on/off control
HUD_CB_EIN_AUS.description: Enables the master on/off checkbox in the HUD section of the iDrive settings menu, allowing the driver to completely enable or disable the head-up display.

HUD_CB_SHOWROOM_MODE.name: HUD checkbox: showroom mode
HUD_CB_SHOWROOM_MODE.description: Enables the showroom/demonstration mode checkbox in HUD settings. When active, the HUD can be operated in showroom mode for dealer demonstration purposes.

HUD_CB_CCM.name: HUD menu: Check Control checkbox
HUD_CB_CCM.description: Adds a Check Control checkbox to the head-up display settings, letting the driver choose whether Check Control messages, the car's warning and status notices, also appear in the HUD.

HUD_CB_LISTEN.name: HUD checkbox: content list
HUD_CB_LISTEN.description: Enables a content-list selection checkbox in the HUD iDrive settings, allowing the driver to toggle which content categories appear in the HUD display list.

HUD_CB_TEMPOLIMIT.name: HUD checkbox: speed limit display
HUD_CB_TEMPOLIMIT.description: Enables the speed-limit (Tempolimit) checkbox in the HUD iDrive settings, letting the driver choose whether the current speed limit is shown in the HUD.

HUD_CB_ABSTANDSINFO.name: HUD checkbox: following-distance info
HUD_CB_ABSTANDSINFO.description: Enables the Abstandsinfo (following-distance information) checkbox in HUD settings, letting the driver choose whether ACC gap-to-vehicle-ahead is shown in the HUD.

HUD_CB_SPEEDLIMITINFO.name: HUD checkbox: speed-limit info
HUD_CB_SPEEDLIMITINFO.description: Enables the speed-limit-info checkbox in HUD iDrive settings (distinct from the alert/warning variant; may relate to advisory/road-sign-sourced speed limit display).

HUD_STANDANSICHT.name: HUD standstill view enable
HUD_STANDANSICHT.description: Enables a static/standstill display view in the HUD when the vehicle is at a standstill. Controls whether the HUD shows content while stationary (sub-bits in this byte select which content).

HUD_STAND_KEINE_ANZEIGE.name: HUD standstill view: no display
HUD_STAND_KEINE_ANZEIGE.description: When the HUD standstill view is active, this bit selects 'no content' (blank) as the standstill screen, overriding other standstill content bits.

HUD_STAND_NAVIGATION.name: HUD standstill view: navigation
HUD_STAND_NAVIGATION.description: Selects navigation content (e.g. destination, next manoeuvre) as the HUD content displayed when the vehicle is stationary.

HUD_STAND_EFFIZIENZ.name: HUD standstill view: efficiency/EfficientDynamics
HUD_STAND_EFFIZIENZ.description: Selects EfficientDynamics/efficiency data (e.g. current range, energy flow) as the HUD content displayed when the vehicle is stationary.

HUD_STAND_TERMINE.name: HUD standstill view: calendar/appointments
HUD_STAND_TERMINE.description: Selects calendar appointments (Termine) as the HUD content displayed when the vehicle is stationary, showing upcoming calendar events.

HUD_SLIDE_HELLIGKEIT.name: HUD brightness slider
HUD_SLIDE_HELLIGKEIT.description: Enables the brightness adjustment slider in the HUD iDrive settings menu, allowing the driver to manually adjust HUD image brightness.

HUD_SLIDE_HOEHE.name: HUD height adjustment slider
HUD_SLIDE_HOEHE.description: Enables the height (Hoehe) adjustment slider in the HUD iDrive settings menu, allowing the driver to raise or lower the projected HUD image to suit their seating position.

HUD_SLIDE_ROTATION.name: HUD rotation adjustment slider
HUD_SLIDE_ROTATION.description: Enables the rotation/tilt adjustment slider in the HUD iDrive settings menu, allowing the driver to correct the rotational angle of the projected HUD image.

BASIS_KOMBI_MMI_LIST.name: Cluster MMI list mode (basic)
BASIS_KOMBI_MMI_LIST.description: Selects whether the instrument cluster uses a basic/simplified MMI list layout. Enabled when the car lacks a professional navigation system (SA 609) and the high-spec KOMBI variant (6WA).

ECO_CSC_KOMBI.name: Cluster ECO display (CSC)
ECO_CSC_KOMBI.description: Setting for efficiency information shown in the instrument cluster (CSC). Best left unchanged.

LOUPE_TACHO_KOMBI.name: Loupe (magnified needle) speedometer in cluster
LOUPE_TACHO_KOMBI.description: Enables the loupe/magnified-needle (Lupenzeiger) speedometer display style in the instrument cluster, which renders the speedometer with a large stylized analog needle sweep.

DRIVE_MODE_KOMBI.name: Drive mode display in cluster
DRIVE_MODE_KOMBI.description: Enables the driving mode (COMFORT/SPORT/ECO PRO) status indicator in the instrument cluster. When active, the selected drive mode is shown in the cluster.

CALMING_KOMBI.name: Calming display mode for cluster
CALMING_KOMBI.description: Enables the 'calming' visual mode in the instrument cluster, which reduces or simplifies displayed information (associated with Eco Pro mode calm-driving animations). Firmware enum value NICHT_AKTIV = not active.

MFID_KOMBI_VARIANT.name: MFID cluster display variant
MFID_KOMBI_VARIANT.description: Selects a variant of the multi-function instrument display (MFID) layout in the cluster. Determines which graphical/content variant of the cluster screen is used.

KOMBIGUIDING_SCHALTBAR.name: Navigation guidance switchable in cluster
KOMBIGUIDING_SCHALTBAR.description: Enables the switchable turn-by-turn navigation guidance display (arrow/maneuver info) in the instrument cluster. Requires a navigation system (SA 606 or 609) to be fitted.

KOMBI_CIC.name: Cluster CIC generation flag
KOMBI_CIC.description: 2-bit field relating to the CIC (Car Information Computer) generation compatibility of the instrument cluster. Only one enum value is known from firmware: KOMBI_HIGH (high-specification cluster variant). Other values are not documented.

EINHEITEN_MASTER.name: Units master source
EINHEITEN_MASTER.description: Determines which ECU is the master for unit settings (metric/imperial, etc.). Only one enum value is documented from firmware: HMI (iDrive head unit as master). Other values are not individually documented.

RANGE_VALUE_KOMBI_NEU.name: Range figures in cluster
RANGE_VALUE_KOMBI_NEU.description: Chooses which range figures the instrument cluster shows: the minimum range, the maximum range or both. Check only figures the car's cluster can show.

MICROMAP_KOMBI.name: Micro map in cluster
MICROMAP_KOMBI.description: Enables a small navigation map (mini-map / micromap) overlay in the instrument cluster display. Requires navigation system hardware.

KOMBI_RES.name: Cluster screen resolution type (RES)
KOMBI_RES.description: 2-bit field specifying the display resolution type/class of the instrument cluster screen. No individual enum values are documented for this field from available sources.

KOMBI_AUFLOESUNG.name: Cluster resolution switch
KOMBI_AUFLOESUNG.description: Setting for the resolution of the navigation map graphics the head unit draws for the instrument cluster. Best left unchanged.

WBK_JINGLE_REQUEST.name: Welcome jingle request target (WBK)
WBK_JINGLE_REQUEST.description: Single-bit field indicating whether the instrument cluster (KOMBI) is the target for the welcome/startup jingle sound. When set, the cluster plays the startup chime.

ID5_COLOR_SET.name: iDrive 5 color set
ID5_COLOR_SET.description: Uses the iDrive 5 color scheme for the navigation map graphics the head unit draws for the instrument cluster. Best left unchanged.

DEBOUNCE_KOMBI_BASIS.name: Cluster phone list update delay
DEBOUNCE_KOMBI_BASIS.description: Sets the short delay the head unit waits before it updates the phone list shown in the instrument cluster. Best left unchanged.

KI_KOMBI_VARIANT.name: Cluster hardware variant code (KI)
KI_KOMBI_VARIANT.description: 6-bit code identifying the specific instrument cluster (KI = Kombiinstrument) hardware variant installed. Determines cluster feature set and display capabilities.

KI_TAFEL_KONFIGURATION.name: Cluster panel configuration (KI Tafel)
KI_TAFEL_KONFIGURATION.description: Configures the instrument cluster panel/display layout (Tafel = panel/board). Controls how the cluster's display area is structured or segmented.

KI_BRIGHTNESS.name: Cluster brightness control enabled
KI_BRIGHTNESS.description: Enables head-unit brightness control for the instrument cluster. When active, the HU can send brightness/backlight level commands to the cluster.

KI_DISP_RB_PRESELECT.name: Cluster display mode choices
KI_DISP_RB_PRESELECT.description: Sets which instrument cluster display modes the driver can pick in the central display's instrument cluster settings: standard, a reduced view that shows less, and an individual view.

KI_DISP_CB_FAHRMODUSANSICHT.name: Cluster checkbox: drive mode view
KI_DISP_CB_FAHRMODUSANSICHT.description: Enables the drive mode view (Fahrmodusansicht) checkbox in the cluster display options, allowing the user to toggle the driving mode indicator in the cluster info area.

KI_DISP_CB_STRECKENUEBERSICHT.name: Cluster checkbox: route overview
KI_DISP_CB_STRECKENUEBERSICHT.description: Enables the route overview (Streckenuebersicht) checkbox in cluster display options, allowing the user to show a simplified route/navigation overview in the cluster.

KI_DISP_CB_ADDITIONAL_SIGN.name: Cluster checkbox: additional road signs
KI_DISP_CB_ADDITIONAL_SIGN.description: Enables the additional road sign display checkbox in the cluster, allowing supplementary traffic sign information (e.g. speed limit warnings) to be shown.

KI_DISP_CB_TACHOZEIGERBAND.name: Cluster checkbox: speedometer needle band
KI_DISP_CB_TACHOZEIGERBAND.description: Enables the speedometer needle band (Tachozeigerband) display checkbox in the cluster, which shows a colored band or sweep around the analog speedometer needle.

KI_DISP_CB_M_FAHRDYNAMIK.name: Cluster checkbox: M dynamic driving info
KI_DISP_CB_M_FAHRDYNAMIK.description: Enables the M-model dynamic driving information checkbox (Fahrdynamik) in the cluster, making performance metrics (lateral g-force, engine output etc.) available in the cluster display.

KI_DISP_CB_SPA.name: Cluster checkbox: Sport Performance Analyzer
KI_DISP_CB_SPA.description: Enables the Sport Performance Analyzer (SPA) checkbox in the cluster display options. SPA provides real-time performance metrics in the cluster for M/sport vehicles.

KI_DISP_CB_SPEED_DIGITAL.name: Cluster checkbox: digital speed display
KI_DISP_CB_SPEED_DIGITAL.description: Enables the digital speed readout checkbox in the cluster display options, allowing the driver to toggle a numeric speed display alongside or instead of the analog speedometer.

KI_DISP_CB_CLOCK.name: Cluster checkbox: clock display
KI_DISP_CB_CLOCK.description: Enables the clock/time display checkbox in the cluster info area options, allowing the current time to be shown in the instrument cluster.

KI_DISP_CB_BC.name: Cluster checkbox: trip computer (BC) display
KI_DISP_CB_BC.description: Enables the trip computer / board computer (BC = Bordcomputer) checkbox in the cluster, making on-board computer info pages (fuel economy, range, etc.) accessible in the cluster.

KI_DISP_CB_HMI_BC_ANKUNFTSZEIT_DISTANCE_.name: Cluster checkbox: trip computer arrival time and distance
KI_DISP_CB_HMI_BC_ANKUNFTSZEIT_DISTANCE_.description: Enables the arrival time and remaining distance trip computer fields in the cluster display. These are navigation-integrated BC fields showing ETA and distance to destination.

KI_DISP_CB_BC_RANGE_ENABLE.name: Cluster checkbox: trip computer range display
KI_DISP_CB_BC_RANGE_ENABLE.description: Enables the remaining fuel/energy range field in the cluster trip computer display. Shows estimated driving range remaining.

KI_DISP_CB_BC_MOM_VERBR_VERBRENNER_ENABL.name: Cluster checkbox: instantaneous fuel consumption (combustion)
KI_DISP_CB_BC_MOM_VERBR_VERBRENNER_ENABL.description: Enables the real-time/momentary fuel consumption display for the combustion engine in the cluster trip computer. Firmware enum value NICHT_AKTIV = not active (off).

KI_DISP_CB_BC_MOM_VERBR_ELEKTR_ENABLE.name: Cluster checkbox: instantaneous electric consumption
KI_DISP_CB_BC_MOM_VERBR_ELEKTR_ENABLE.description: Enables the real-time/momentary electric energy consumption display in the cluster trip computer. Applicable to hybrid/EV vehicles.

KI_DISP_CB_BC_AVERAGE_SPEED_CONS_ENABLE.name: Cluster checkbox: average speed and consumption
KI_DISP_CB_BC_AVERAGE_SPEED_CONS_ENABLE.description: Enables the average speed and average fuel/energy consumption fields in the cluster trip computer display.

KI_DISP_CB_MOTOR_TEMP_BC_ENABLE.name: Cluster checkbox: engine coolant temperature
KI_DISP_CB_MOTOR_TEMP_BC_ENABLE.description: Enables the engine coolant/oil temperature display checkbox in the cluster trip computer. When active, engine temperature is shown as a BC field.

KI_DISP_CB_BC_EDA_ENABLE.name: Cluster checkbox: EDA trip counter enable
KI_DISP_CB_BC_EDA_ENABLE.description: Enables the EDA (abbreviated eco/efficiency display counter) checkbox in the cluster trip computer. EDA full expansion is not confirmed in available sources but is context-consistent with eco-driving efficiency tracking.

KI_DISP_CB_HMI_BC_SOC_ENABLE.name: Cluster checkbox: battery state-of-charge display
KI_DISP_CB_HMI_BC_SOC_ENABLE.description: Enables the high-voltage battery state-of-charge (SOC) display in the cluster trip computer. Relevant for hybrid/EV vehicles.

KI_DISP_CB_HMI_BC_E_COUNTER_AVG_SPEED.name: Cluster checkbox: electric trip counter average speed
KI_DISP_CB_HMI_BC_E_COUNTER_AVG_SPEED.description: Enables the average speed counter for the electric (EV) trip segment in the cluster trip computer. Tracks average speed over an electric-driving trip.

KI_DISP_BC_AVG_CONSUMPTION_ELECTRIC.name: Cluster: average electric energy consumption display
KI_DISP_BC_AVG_CONSUMPTION_ELECTRIC.description: Enables display of average electric energy consumption (kWh/100km or similar) in the cluster trip computer area.
